items.p: dharmakshetre kurukshetre samaveta yuyutsavah mamakah pandavashchaiva kimakurvata sanjaya
items.e: Dhritarashtra said: O Sanjaya, what did my sons and the sons of Pandu do, assembled on the holy field of Kurukshetra and eager for battle?
items.h: धृतराष्ट्र संजय से कुरुक्षेत्र का हाल पूछते हैं

items.p: drishtva tu pandavanikam vyudham duryodhanastada acharyamupasangamya raja vachanamabravit
items.e: Sanjaya said: Seeing the Pandava army arranged in battle formation, King Duryodhana went to Dronacharya and spoke these words.
items.h: पाण्डव सेना देखकर दुर्योधन द्रोणाचार्य के पास जाता है

items.p: pashyaitam panduputranamacharya mahatim chamum vyudham drupadaputrena tava shishyena dhimata
items.e: O teacher, look at this great army of the sons of Pandu, arranged in battle formation by your wise disciple, the son of Drupada.
items.h: दुर्योधन द्रोण को धृष्टद्युम्न द्वारा सजाई पाण्डव सेना दिखाता है

items.p: atra shura maheshvasa bhimarjunasama yudhi yuyudhano viratashcha drupadashcha maharathah
items.e: Here in the Pandava army are mighty warriors, great archers, equal to Bhima and Arjuna in battle: Satyaki, Virata, and the great chariot-warrior...
items.h: दुर्योधन पाण्डव सेना के भीम-अर्जुन जैसे महारथियों को गिनाता है

items.p: dhrishtaketushchekitanah kashirajashcha viryavan purujitkuntibhojashcha shaibyashcha narapungavah
items.e: Dhृष्टकेतु, Chekitana, and the valiant king of Kashi; Purujit, Kuntibhoja, and Shaibya, the best among men.
items.h: धृष्टकेतु, चेकितान, काशिराज, पुरुजित्, कुन्तिभोज और शैब्य के नाम

items.p: yudhamanyushcha vikranta uttamaujashcha viryavan saubhadro draupadeyashcha sarva eva maharathah
items.e: Yudhamanyu, brave and powerful, Uttamaujas, brave and powerful, Subhadra's son, and the sons of Draupadi — all of them are great warriors.
items.h: युधामन्यु, उत्तमौजा, अभिमन्यु और द्रौपदी के पुत्र, सब महारथी

items.s: अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम
items.p: asmakam tu vishishta ye tannibodha dvijottama nayaka mama sainyasya sangyartham tanbravimi te
items.e: O best of the twice-born, note also our own chief warriors. I name them to remind you of our army.
items.h: दुर्योधन अब अपनी सेना के प्रमुख नायकों को गिनाता है

items.p: bhavanbhishmashcha karnashcha kripashcha samitinjayah ashvatthama vikarnashcha saumadattistathaiva cha
items.e: Bhishma, Karna, Kripa, Ashvatthama, Vikarna, and the son of Somadatta are also there.
items.h: द्रोण, भीष्म, कर्ण, कृप, अश्वत्थामा, विकर्ण और भूरिश्रवा

items.s: अन्ये च बहवः शूरा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः
items.p: anye cha bahavah shura madarthe tyaktajivitah nanashastrapraharanah sarve yuddhavisharadah
items.e: Besides these, many heroes have given up their lives for my sake. They wield many kinds of weapons and are all skilled in warfare.
items.h: मेरे लिए प्राण देने को तैयार अनेक कुशल योद्धा हैं

items.p: aparyaptam tadasmakam balam bhishmabhirakshitam paryaptam tvidametesham balam bhimabhirakshitam
items.e: Our force, guarded by Bhishma, is insufficient; their force, guarded by Bhima, is sufficient.
items.h: भीष्म से रक्षित हमारी सेना अपर्याप्त, भीम से रक्षित उनकी पर्याप्त

items.p: ayaneshu cha sarveshu yathabhagamavasthitah bhishmamevabhirakshantu bhavantah sarva eva hi
items.e: Remain at your stations on every front and protect Bhishma from all sides.
items.h: सब अपने मोर्चे पर डटकर भीष्म की ही रक्षा करें

items.p: tasya sanjanayanharsham kuruvriddhah pitamahah sinhanadam vinadyochchaih shankham dadhmau pratapavan
items.e: The elder of the Kuru clan, the powerful grandfather Bhishma, roared like a lion and blew his conch loudly, filling Duryodhana with joy.
items.h: दुर्योधन को हर्षित करने के लिए भीष्म सिंहनाद कर शंख बजाते हैं

items.p: tatah shankhashcha bheryashcha panavanakagomukhah sahasaivabhyahanyanta sa shabdastumulobhavat
items.e: Then conches, kettledrums, drums, and trumpets burst forth at once. Their sound became thunderous.
items.h: शंख, भेरी, ढोल, नगाड़े और नरसिंघे एक साथ बज उठे

items.p: tatah shvetairhayairyukte mahati syandane sthitau madhavah pandavashchaiva divyau shankhau pradadhmatuh
items.e: Then, seated on the great chariot yoked with white horses, Madhava and Pandava blew their divine conches.
items.h: सफ़ेद घोड़ों वाले रथ पर श्रीकृष्ण और अर्जुन दिव्य शंख बजाते हैं

items.p: panchajanyam hrishikesho devadattam dhananjayah paundram dadhmau mahashankham bhimakarma vrikodarah
items.e: Hrisikesha Krishna blew the Panchajanya, Dhananjaya Arjuna blew the Devadatta, and Bhima of mighty deeds blew the great conch Paundra.
items.h: श्रीकृष्ण का पाञ्चजन्य, अर्जुन का देवदत्त, भीम का पौण्ड्र शंख

items.p: anantavijayam raja kuntiputro yudhishthirah nakulah sahadevashcha sughoshamanipushpakau
items.e: King Yudhishthira, son of Kunti, blew the Anantavijaya; Nakula and Sahadeva blew the Sughosha and Manipushpaka.
items.h: युधिष्ठिर का अनन्तविजय, नकुल-सहदेव के सुघोष और मणिपुष्पक शंख

items.p: kashyashcha parameshvasah shikhandi cha maharathah dhrishtadyumno viratashcha satyakishchaparajitah
items.e: The great archer from Kashi, Shikhandi the great warrior, Dhrishtadyumna, Virata, and invincible Satyaki.
items.h: काशिराज, शिखण्डी, धृष्टद्युम्न, विराट और अजेय सात्यकि भी शंख बजाते हैं

items.p: drupado draupadeyashcha sarvashah prithivipate saubhadrashcha mahabahuh shankhandadhmuh prithakprithak
items.e: Drupada, Draupadi's sons, and mighty Abhimanyu each blew their conches separately, O lord of the earth.
items.h: द्रुपद, द्रौपदी के पुत्र और अभिमन्यु अलग-अलग शंख बजाते हैं

items.p: sa ghosho dhartarashtranam hridayani vyadarayat nabhashcha prithivim chaiva tumulo vyanunadayan
items.e: That terrible sound split the hearts of Dhritarashtra's side, echoing through sky and earth.
items.h: पाण्डवों के शंखनाद ने कौरवों के हृदय विदीर्ण कर दिए

items.p: atha vyavasthitan drishtva dhartarashtrankapidhvajah pravritte shastrasampate dhanurudyamya pandavah
items.e: Then, seeing the sons of Dhritarashtra standing in battle order while the weapons were about to begin, Arjuna lifted his bow.
items.h: शस्त्र चलने से ठीक पहले कपिध्वज अर्जुन गाण्डीव उठाते हैं

items.p: hrishikesham tada vakyamidamaha mahipate senayorubhayormadhye ratham sthapaya mechyuta
items.e: Arjuna said: O Hrishikesha, place my chariot between the two armies, O Achyuta, until I can look at these men who wish to fight and see with whom I...
items.h: अर्जुन रथ को दोनों सेनाओं के बीच खड़ा करवाना चाहते हैं

items.p: yavadetanniriksheham yoddhukamanavasthitan kairmaya saha yoddhavyamasminranasamudyame
items.e: Arjuna said: O Achyuta, keep my chariot between the two armies until I can inspect these men standing here, eager for battle, and see with whom I...
items.h: अर्जुन देखना चाहते हैं कि किन-किन से युद्ध करना है

items.p: yotsyamananaveksheham ya etetra samagatah dhartarashtrasya durbuddheryuddhe priyachikirshavah
items.e: I want to see those who have gathered here, eager to fight and wishing to please the evil-minded son of Dhritarashtra.
items.h: दुर्योधन का प्रिय चाहने वाले इन योद्धाओं को मैं देख लूँ

items.p: evamukto hrishikesho gudakeshena bharata senayorubhayormadhye sthapayitva rathottamam
items.e: Sanjaya said: Spoken to thus by Gudakesha, Hrishikesha stationed the finest chariot between the two armies, in front of Bhishma, Drona, and all the...
items.h: श्रीकृष्ण उत्तम रथ को दोनों सेनाओं के बीच खड़ा करते हैं

items.p: bhishmadronapramukhatah sarvesham cha mahikshitam uvacha partha pashyaitansamavetankuruniti
items.e: Standing before Bhishma, Drona, and all the rulers, Krishna said, "O Partha, behold these assembled Kurus."
items.h: भीष्म-द्रोण के सामने श्रीकृष्ण कहते हैं: पार्थ, इन कौरवों को देखो

items.p: tatrapashyatsthitanparthah pitrinatha pitamahan acharyanmatulanbhratrinputranpautransakhinstatha
items.e: Then Arjuna, son of Pritha, saw fathers, grandfathers, teachers, maternal uncles, brothers, sons, grandsons, friends, fathers-in-law, and...
items.h: अर्जुन दोनों सेनाओं में अपने ही स्वजनों को खड़ा देखते हैं

items.p: shvashuransuhridashchaiva senayorubhayorapi tansamikshya sa kaunteyah sarvanbandhunavasthitan
items.e: Seeing all his relatives standing there, Arjuna sank into grief and spoke in fear.
items.h: सब बंधुओं को सामने देखकर अर्जुन विषाद से भर जाते हैं

items.p: kripaya parayavishto vishidannidamabravit drishtvemam svajanam krishna yuyutsum samupasthitam
items.e: Arjuna said: Seeing my own people gathered here, eager for battle, I am overcome with pity and grief, O Krishna.
items.h: युद्ध को तैयार स्वजनों को देखकर अर्जुन व्याकुल होकर बोलते हैं

items.s: सीदन्ति मम गात्राणि मुखं च परिशुष्यति
items.p: sidanti mama gatrani mukham cha parishushyati vepathushcha sharire me romaharshashcha jayate
items.e: My limbs are failing, my mouth is drying up, my body trembles, and my hair stands on end.
items.h: अर्जुन के अंग शिथिल, मुख सूखा, शरीर काँपता, रोंगटे खड़े

items.p: gandivam sransate hastattvakchaiva paridahyate na cha shaknomyavasthatum bhramativa cha me manah
items.e: My bow slips from my hand. My skin burns. I cannot stand steady, and my mind reels.
items.h: गाण्डीव हाथ से फिसलता है, त्वचा जलती है, मन भ्रमित

items.p: nimittani cha pashyami viparitani keshava na cha shreyonupashyami hatva svajanamahave
items.e: O Keshava, I see only inauspicious signs, and I see no good in killing my own people in battle.
items.h: अर्जुन को अपशकुन दिखते हैं, स्वजनों को मारने में कल्याण नहीं

items.s: न काङ्क्षे विजयं कृष्ण न च राज्यं सुखानि च
items.p: na kankshe vijayam krishna na cha rajyam sukhani cha kim no rajyena govinda kim bhogairjivitena va
items.e: I do not desire victory, Krishna, nor kingdom, nor pleasures. What use is kingdom to us, Govinda? What use are pleasures or even life?
items.h: अर्जुन को न विजय चाहिए, न राज्य, न सुख

items.s: येषामर्थे काङ्क्षितं नो राज्यं भोगाः सुखानि च
items.p: yeshamarthe kankshitam no rajyam bhogah sukhani cha ta imevasthita yuddhe prananstyaktva dhanani cha
items.e: Those for whom we wanted kingdom, pleasures, and comfort stand here in battle, ready to give up life and wealth.
items.h: जिनके लिए राज्य-सुख चाहिए, वही प्राण त्यागकर युद्ध में खड़े हैं

items.p: acharyah pitarah putrastathaiva cha pitamahah matulah shchashurah pautrah shyalah sambandhinastatha
items.e: Teachers, fathers, sons, grandfathers, maternal uncles, fathers-in-law, grandsons, brothers-in-law, and other relatives.
items.h: सामने आचार्य, पिता, पुत्र, पितामह, मामा, ससुर, पौत्र, साले खड़े हैं

items.p: etanna hantumichchhami ghnatopi madhusudana api trailokyarajyasya hetoh kim nu mahikrite
items.e: I do not want to kill these people, even if they kill me, O Madhusudana. Not even for the rule of the three worlds, much less for the earth.
items.h: तीनों लोकों के राज्य के लिए भी इन्हें नहीं मारना चाहता

items.p: nihatya dhartarashtrannah ka pritih syajjanardana papamevashrayedasmanhatvaitanatatayinah
items.e: O Janardana, what joy would come to us by killing these sons of Dhritarashtra? Killing these aggressors would only bring us sin.
items.h: धृतराष्ट्र के पुत्रों को मारकर क्या सुख, पाप ही लगेगा

items.p: tasmannarha vayam hantum dhartarashtransvabandhavan svajanam hi katham hatva sukhinah syama madhava
items.e: Therefore, we are not fit to kill our own kinsmen, the sons of Dhritarashtra. How could we be happy after killing our relatives, O Madhava?
items.h: अपने बांधवों को मारना हमें उचित नहीं, फिर सुख कैसे मिलेगा

items.p: yadyapyete na pashyanti lobhopahatachetasah kulakshayakritam dosham mitradrohe cha patakam
items.e: Though greed has blinded them, they do not see the fault in destroying a family or the wrong in betraying friends.
items.h: लोभ से अंधे कौरव कुलनाश और मित्रद्रोह का दोष नहीं देखते

items.p: katham na gyeyamasmabhih papadasmannivartitum kulakshayakritam dosham prapashyadbhirjanardana
items.e: Why should we not turn away from this sin, when we clearly see the fault in destroying the family, O Janardana?
items.h: दोष जानते हुए भी हम इस पाप से क्यों न बचें

items.p: kulakshaye pranashyanti kuladharmah sanatanah dharme nashte kulam kritsnamadharmobhibhavatyuta
items.e: When a family falls apart, its ancient duties disappear. When duty is lost, wrongdoing overtakes the whole family.
items.h: कुल के नाश से कुलधर्म नष्ट होते हैं और अधर्म फैलता है

items.p: adharmabhibhavatkrishna pradushyanti kulastriyah strishu dushtasu varshneya jayate varnasankarah
items.e: When lawlessness grows, the women of the family are corrupted. When women are corrupted, mixed social disorder is born.
items.h: अधर्म बढ़ने पर कुल की स्त्रियाँ दूषित और वर्णसंकर उत्पन्न होते हैं

items.p: sankaro narakayaiva kulaghnanam kulasya cha patanti pitaro hyesham luptapindodakakriyah
items.e: Mixed lineage leads the destroyers of family to ruin, and their ancestors fall because offerings of food and water stop.
items.h: वर्णसंकर कुलघातियों और कुल को नरक में ले जाता है

items.p: doshairetaih kulaghnanam varnasankarakarakaih utsadyante jatidharmah kuladharmashcha shashvatah
items.e: Because of these faults that create mixed social order, the eternal duties of family and community are destroyed.
items.h: इन दोषों से सनातन कुलधर्म और जातिधर्म नष्ट हो जाते हैं

items.p: utsannakuladharmanam manushyanam janardana narakeniyatam vaso bhavatityanushushruma
items.e: O Janardana, we have always heard that those whose family duties are destroyed dwell long in a lower realm.
items.h: कुलधर्म नष्ट करने वालों का नरक में लंबा वास, ऐसा सुना है

items.s: अहो बत महत्पापं कर्तुं व्यवसिता वयम्
items.p: aho bata mahatpapam kartum vyavasita vayam yadrajyasukhalobhena hantum svajanamudyatah
items.e: Alas, we have resolved to commit a grave wrong—driven by greed for kingdom and pleasure, we are ready to kill our own kin.
items.h: राज्य-सुख के लोभ में स्वजनों को मारने चले, कितना बड़ा पाप

items.p: yadi mamapratikaramashastram shastrapanayah dhartarashtra rane hanyustanme kshemataram bhavet
items.e: If the armed sons of Dhritarashtra were to kill me in battle while I stood unresisting and without weapons, that would be far better for me.
items.h: निहत्थे मुझे कौरव मार दें, तो वह भी मेरे लिए हितकर

items.p: evamuktvarjunah sankhye rathopastha upavishat visrijya sasharam chapam shokasanvignamanasah
items.e: Sanjaya said: Saying this, Arjuna sat down on the chariot seat in the midst of the battlefield, casting aside his bow and arrows, his mind...
items.h: धनुष-बाण छोड़कर शोक से व्याकुल अर्जुन रथ में बैठ जाते हैं

items.p: tam tatha kripayavishtamashrupurnakulekshanam vishidantamidam vakyamuvacha madhusudanah
items.e: Sanjaya said: To Arjuna, overcome by pity, his eyes full of tears and clouded with grief, Madhusudana spoke these words.
items.h: आँसुओं में डूबे, विषाद से भरे अर्जुन से श्रीकृष्ण बोलने लगे

items.p: kutastva kashmalamidam vishame samupasthitam anaryajushtamasvargyamakirtikaramarjuna
items.e: Krishna said: Arjuna, where has this delusion come from in this crisis? Noble people do not follow it. It does not lead upward, and it brings...
items.h: श्रीकृष्ण पूछते हैं: इस कठिन घड़ी में यह मोह कहाँ से आया

items.s: क्लैब्यं मा स्म गमः पार्थ नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते
items.p: klaibyam ma sma gamah partha naitattvayyupapadyate kshudram hridayadaurbalyam tyaktvottishtha parantapa
items.e: Do not yield to weakness, Partha. It does not suit you. Cast off this petty weakness of heart and rise, scorcher of foes.
items.h: हृदय की तुच्छ दुर्बलता छोड़ो, हे परंतप, उठ खड़े हो

items.s: कथं भीष्ममहं संख्ये द्रोणं च मधुसूदन
items.p: katham bhishmamaham sankhye dronam cha madhusudana ishubhih pratiyotsyami pujarhavarisudana
items.e: Arjuna said: How can I fight Bhishma and Drona with arrows in battle, O Madhusudana? They are worthy of worship, O destroyer of enemies.
items.h: अर्जुन पूछते हैं: पूज्य भीष्म और द्रोण पर बाण कैसे चलाऊँ

items.s: गुरूनहत्वा हि महानुभावान्श्रेयो भोक्तुं भैक्ष्यमपीह लोके
items.p: gurunahatva hi mahanubhavanshreyo bhoktum bhaikshyamapiha loke hatvarthakamanstu gurunihaivabhunjiya bhogan rudhirapradigdhan
items.e: It is better to live on alms in this world than to kill these great teachers. If I kill them, the pleasures I enjoy here will be stained with blood...
items.h: गुरुजनों को मारने से अच्छा भिक्षा माँगकर जीना, अर्जुन का तर्क

items.s: न चैतद्विद्मः कतरन्नो गरीयोयद्वा जयेम यदि वा नो जयेयुः
items.p: na chaitadvidmah kataranno gariyoyadva jayema yadi va no jayeyuh yaneva hatva na jijivishamastevasthitah pramukhe dhartarashtrah
items.e: We do not know which is better for us: to fight or not to fight. We do not even know whether we will conquer them or they us. The sons of...
items.h: लड़ें या न लड़ें, क्या बेहतर है, अर्जुन यह भी नहीं जानते

items.p: karpanyadoshopahatasvabhavahprichchhami tvam dharmasammudhachetah yachchhreyah syannishchitam bruhi tanmeshishyasteham shadhi mam tvam prapannam
items.e: My nature is overwhelmed by weakness, and my mind is confused about duty. I ask you: tell me with certainty what is best for me. I am your student...
items.h: मैं आपका शिष्य हूँ, शरण में हूँ, मुझे निश्चित मार्ग बताइए

items.p: na hi prapashyami mamapanudyadyachchhokamuchchhoshanamindriyanam avapya bhumavasapatnamriddhamrajyam suranamapi chadhipatyam
items.e: Even if I gained an unrivaled, prosperous kingdom on earth or lordship over the gods, I see nothing that could remove this grief that dries up my...
items.h: राज्य या स्वर्ग का अधिकार भी यह शोक नहीं मिटा सकता

items.p: evamuktva hrishikesham gudakeshah parantapa na yotsya iti govindamuktva tushnim babhuva ha
items.e: Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus to Hrishikesha, Gudakesha, the scorcher of foes, said to Govinda, “I will not fight,” and fell silent.
items.h: 'मैं युद्ध नहीं करूँगा' कहकर अर्जुन चुप हो गए

items.p: tamuvacha hrishikeshah prahasanniva bharata senayorubhayormadhye vishidantamidam vachah
items.e: Hṛṣīkeśa spoke to the grieving Arjuna, smiling slightly, in the midst of the two armies.
items.h: दोनों सेनाओं के बीच, शोक में डूबे अर्जुन से मुस्कुराते श्रीकृष्ण बोले

items.p: ashochyananvashochastvam pragyavadanshcha bhashase gatasunagatasunshcha nanushochanti panditah
items.e: The Blessed Lord said: You grieve for what should not be grieved for, yet speak words of wisdom. The wise do not grieve for the dead or the living.
items.h: जिनका शोक नहीं करना चाहिए, उनका शोक कर रहे हो

items.s: न त्वेवाहं जातु नासं न त्वं नेमे जनाधिपाः
items.p: na tvevaham jatu nasam na tvam neme janadhipah na chaiva na bhavishyamah sarve vayamatah param
items.e: I was never absent, nor were you, nor these kings. Nor will any of us cease to be in the future.
items.h: न कभी मैं नहीं था, न तुम, न ये राजा

items.p: dehinosminyatha dehe kaumaram yauvanam jara tatha dehantarapraptirdhirastatra na muhyati
items.e: Just as the embodied one passes through childhood, youth, and old age in this body, so too it passes into another body. The wise are not deluded by...
items.h: जैसे बचपन, जवानी, बुढ़ापा, वैसे ही दूसरा शरीर मिलना

items.p: matrasparshastu kaunteya shitoshnasukhaduhkhadah agamapayinonityastanstitikshasva bharata
items.e: Contacts with the senses, O son of Kunti, bring heat and cold, pleasure and pain. They come and go; they are impermanent. Endure them, O Bharata.
items.h: सर्दी-गर्मी, सुख-दुख आते जाते हैं, उन्हें सहन करो

items.s: यं हि न व्यथयन्त्येते पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ
items.p: yam hi na vyathayantyete purusham purusharshabha samaduhkhasukham dhiram somritatvaya kalpate
items.e: The wise person who is not shaken by these, and remains equal in pain and pleasure, becomes fit for freedom.
items.h: सुख-दुख में सम रहने वाला धीर पुरुष अमृतत्व के योग्य

items.s: नासतो विद्यते भावो नाभावो विद्यते सतः
items.p: nasato vidyate bhavo nabhavo vidyate satah ubhayorapi drishtontastvanayostattvadarshibhih
items.e: The unreal has no being; the real has no nonbeing. Seers have understood the boundary of both.
items.h: असत् का अस्तित्व नहीं, सत् का अभाव नहीं

items.s: अविनाशि तु तद्विद्धि येन सर्वमिदं ततम्
items.p: avinashi tu tadviddhi yena sarvamidam tatam vinashamavyayasyasya na kashchit kartumarhati
items.e: Know that to be imperishable by which this entire world is pervaded. No one can destroy this imperishable reality.
items.h: सारे जगत में व्याप्त तत्त्व अविनाशी है, उसे कोई नहीं मिटा सकता

items.p: antavanta ime deha nityasyoktah sharirinah anashinoprameyasya tasmadyudhyasva bharata
items.e: These bodies are said to be finite, but the embodied being is eternal, indestructible, and immeasurable. Therefore, fight, Arjuna.
items.h: शरीर नश्वर हैं, आत्मा नित्य है, इसलिए हे भारत युद्ध करो

items.s: य एनं वेत्ति हन्तारं यश्चैनं मन्यते हतम्
items.p: ya enam vetti hantaram yashchainam manyate hatam ubhau tau na vijanito nayam hanti na hanyate
items.e: Whoever thinks this imperishable being is the killer, and whoever thinks it is killed, both do not understand. It neither kills nor is killed.
items.h: आत्मा न मारती है, न मारी जाती है

items.s: न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचिन्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः
items.p: na jayate mriyate va kadachinnayam bhutva bhavita va na bhuyah ajo nityah shashvatoyam puranona hanyate hanyamane sharire
items.e: It is never born and never dies. It did not come into being, and it will not cease. Unborn, eternal, everlasting, ancient, it is not destroyed when...
items.h: आत्मा अजन्मा, नित्य, शाश्वत, पुरातन है, शरीर मरने पर नहीं मरती
items.a: na jayate mriyate va | na jayate mriyate

items.p: vedavinashinam nityam ya enamajamavyayam katham sa purushah partha kam ghatayati hanti kam
items.e: One who knows the imperishable, eternal, unborn, and unchanging cannot think of killing or causing death.
items.h: आत्मा को अविनाशी जानने वाला किसे मारे, किसे मरवाए

items.s: वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहायनवानि गृह्णाति नरोऽपराणि
items.p: vasansi jirnani yatha vihayanavani grihnati naroparani tatha sharirani vihaya jirnanyanyani sanyati navani dehi
items.e: As a person discards worn-out clothes and puts on new ones, the embodied being discards worn-out bodies and enters new ones.
items.h: पुराने कपड़े छोड़ नए पहनने की तरह आत्मा नया शरीर लेती है

items.s: नैनं छिन्दन्ति शस्त्राणि नैनं दहति पावकः
items.p: nainam chhindanti shastrani nainam dahati pavakah na chainam kledayantyapo na shoshayati marutah
items.e: Weapons cannot cut it, fire cannot burn it, water cannot wet it, and wind cannot dry it.
items.h: शस्त्र, आग, जल और हवा आत्मा को छू भी नहीं सकते
items.t: atman indestructible self kurukshetra physical elements immortality

items.p: achchhedyoyamadahyoyamakledyoshoshya eva cha nityah sarvagatah sthanurachaloyam sanatanah
items.e: This embodied self cannot be cut, burned, wetted, or dried. It is eternal, all-pervading, unmoving, fixed, and timeless.
items.h: आत्मा अच्छेद्य, अदाह्य, नित्य, सर्वव्यापी, अचल और सनातन है

items.p: avyaktoyamachintyoyamavikaryoyamuchyate tasmadevam viditvainam nanushochitumarhasi
items.e: It is unseen, beyond thought, and said to be unchanged. Therefore, knowing it this way, you should not grieve.
items.h: आत्मा अव्यक्त, अचिंत्य और अविकारी है, ऐसा जानकर शोक मत करो

items.s: अथ चैनं नित्यजातं नित्यं वा मन्यसे मृतम्
items.p: atha chainam nityajatam nityam va manyase mritam tathapi tvam mahabaho naivam shochitumarhasi
items.e: O mighty-armed one, even if you think this embodied being is always born and always dies, you still should not grieve like this.
items.h: आत्मा को बार बार जन्मने-मरने वाली मानो, तब भी शोक उचित नहीं

items.s: जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्ध्रुवं जन्म मृतस्य च
items.p: jatasya hi dhruvo mrityurdhruvam janma mritasya cha tasmadapariharyerthe na tvam shochitumarhasi
items.e: For what is born, death is certain; for what dies, birth is certain. What cannot be avoided should not be grieved over.
items.h: जन्मे की मृत्यु और मरे का जन्म निश्चित, फिर शोक कैसा
items.a: jatasya hi dhruvo mrityur | jatasya hi dhruvo

items.p: avyaktadini bhutani vyaktamadhyani bharata avyaktanidhananyeva tatra ka paridevana
items.e: All beings are unmanifest before birth and unmanifest after death; they are manifest only in between. Why grieve over that?
items.h: प्राणी आदि और अंत में अप्रकट, बीच में प्रकट, फिर शोक कैसा

items.p: ashcharyavatpashyati kashchidenamashcharyavadvadati tathaiva chanyah ashcharyavachchainamanyah shrrinotishrutvapyenam veda na chaiva kashchit
items.e: Some behold the inner being as wondrous; some speak of it as wondrous; some hear of it as wondrous; and even after hearing, no one truly knows it.
items.h: आत्मा को सब आश्चर्य से देखते, कहते, सुनते, फिर भी नहीं जानते

items.p: dehi nityamavadhyoyam dehe sarvasya bharata tasmatsarvani bhutani na tvam shochitumarhasi
items.e: O descendant of Bharata, the embodied one in every body is eternal and cannot be slain. Therefore you should not grieve for any being.
items.h: सबके भीतर आत्मा अवध्य है, किसी प्राणी के लिए शोक मत करो

items.p: svadharmamapi chavekshya na vikampitumarhasi dharmyaddhi yuddhachhreyonyatkshatriyasya na vidyate
items.e: Considering your own duty, you should not waver. For a warrior, no action is more beneficial than a righteous battle.
items.h: स्वधर्म देखकर भी डगमगाना ठीक नहीं, धर्मयुद्ध क्षत्रिय का परम कल्याण

items.p: yadrichchhaya chopapannam svargadvaramapavritam sukhinah kshatriyah partha labhante yuddhamidrisham
items.e: An unbidden battle is an open gate to higher realms. O Partha, fortunate are the warriors who receive such a war.
items.h: अपने आप मिला ऐसा धर्मयुद्ध स्वर्ग का खुला द्वार है

items.s: अथ चैत्त्वमिमं धर्म्यं संग्रामं न करिष्यसि
items.p: atha chaittvamimam dharmyam sangramam na karishyasi tatah svadharmam kirtim cha hitva papamavapsyasi
items.e: If you do not fight this righteous war, you will abandon your duty and honor and incur blame.
items.h: यह धर्मयुद्ध नहीं करोगे तो स्वधर्म और कीर्ति खोकर पाप पाओगे

items.p: akirtim chapi bhutani kathayishyanti tevyayam sambhavitasya chakirtirmaranadatirichyate
items.e: And all beings will speak of your everlasting disgrace. For an honored person, disgrace is worse than death.
items.h: लोग सदा तुम्हारी अपकीर्ति गाएँगे, सम्मानित के लिए यह मृत्यु से बढ़कर

items.p: bhayadranaduparatam mansyante tvam maharathah yesham cha tvam bahumato bhutva yasyasi laghavam
items.e: The great warriors will think you withdrew from battle out of fear. Those who once held you in high regard will see you as small.
items.h: महारथी तुम्हें डरकर भागा मानेंगे, तुम्हारा सम्मान घट जाएगा

items.p: avachyavadanshcha bahun vadishyanti tavahitah nindantastava samarthyam tato duhkhataram nu kim
items.e: Your enemies will speak many unworthy words, mocking your strength. What could be more painful than that?
items.h: शत्रु तुम्हारी सामर्थ्य की निंदा करेंगे, इससे बड़ा दुख क्या होगा

items.s: हतो वा प्राप्स्यसि स्वर्गं जित्वा वा भोक्ष्यसे महीम्
items.p: hato va prapsyasi svargam jitva va bhokshyase mahim tasmaduttishtha kaunteya yuddhaya kritanishchayah
items.e: If you are killed, you will attain heaven; if you win, you will enjoy the kingdom. Therefore, rise, Kaunteya, and fight with resolve.
items.h: मरे तो स्वर्ग, जीते तो राज्य; इसलिए दृढ़ निश्चय से उठो

items.p: sukhaduhkhe same kritva labhalabhau jayajayau tato yuddhaya yujyasva naivam papamavapsyasi
items.e: Treat pleasure and pain, gain and loss, victory and defeat alike. Then enter the battle; you will not incur wrongdoing.
items.h: सुख-दुख, लाभ-हानि, जीत-हार को समान मानकर कर्म करो
items.a: sukha duhkhe same kritva | sukha dukhe same kritva

items.s: एषा तेऽभिहिता सांख्ये बुद्धिर्योगे त्विमां श्रृणु
items.p: esha tebhihita sankhye buddhiryoge tvimam shrrinu buddhyayukto yaya partha karmabandham prahasyasi
items.e: This wisdom has been taught to you in Sankhya. Now hear it in yoga. Equipped with this understanding, Arjuna, you will cast off the bondage of action.
items.h: ज्ञान की बात सुन ली, अब कर्मयोग की समबुद्धि सुनो

items.p: nehabhikramanashosti pratyavayo na vidyate svalpamapyasya dharmasya trayate mahato bhayat
items.e: In this human world, no effort toward this steady wisdom is ever lost. No harmful result comes from it. Even a little practice of this dharma...
items.h: कर्मयोग का थोड़ा-सा पालन भी बड़े भय से बचाता है

items.p: vyavasayatmika buddhirekeha kurunandana bahushakha hyanantashcha buddhayovyavasayinam
items.e: O son of the Kurus, the resolute intellect is one-pointed here. The intellect of the irresolute is many-branched and endless.
items.h: निश्चय वाली बुद्धि एक होती है, अनिश्चयी की अनंत शाखाएँ

items.p: yamimam pushpitam vacham pravadantyavipashchitah vedavadaratah partha nanyadastiti vadinah
items.e: The unwise speak flowery words. They delight in the ritual sections of the Vedas and say nothing else exists.
items.h: अविवेकी लोग भोग का वादा करने वाली सजी-धजी वाणी बोलते हैं

items.p: kamatmanah svargapara janmakarmaphalapradam kriyavisheshabahulam bhogaishvaryagatim prati
items.e: Those without clear seeing speak flowery words that promise birth and action-fruit, and describe many rites for enjoyment and power.
items.h: कामना-भरे लोग स्वर्ग और भोग दिलाने वाले कर्मकांड ही सराहते हैं
items.t: kamatmānaḥ svargapara flowery speech ritualism desire-driven action

items.p: bhogaishvaryaprasaktanam tayapahritachetasam vyavasayatmika buddhih samadhau na vidhiyate
items.e: For those whose minds are carried away by pleasure and power, steadfast determination in meditation does not arise.
items.h: भोग और ऐश्वर्य में आसक्त मन की बुद्धि स्थिर नहीं होती

items.p: traigunyavishaya veda nistraigunyo bhavarjuna nirdvandvo nityasattvastho niryogakshema atmavan
items.e: The Vedas deal with the three qualities. Arjuna, rise beyond the three qualities, beyond opposites, fixed in lasting reality, free from concern for...
items.h: वेद तीन गुणों की बात करते हैं, तुम गुणों से ऊपर उठो

items.p: yavanartha udapane sarvatah samplutodake tavansarveshu vedeshu brahmanasya vijanatah
items.e: For one who understands, all the Vedas are as useful as a small puddle when a great reservoir of water is at hand.
items.h: जैसे सरोवर पाकर कुएँ की ज़रूरत नहीं, वैसे ज्ञानी को वेदों की

items.p: karmanyevadhikaraste ma phaleshu kadachana ma karmaphalaheturbhurma te sangostvakarmani
items.e: You have a right to action alone, never to its fruits. Do not become the cause of the result, and do not cling to inaction.
items.h: तुम्हारा अधिकार केवल कर्म पर है, उसके फलों पर कभी नहीं

items.s: योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय
items.p: yogasthah kuru karmani sangam tyaktva dhananjaya siddhyasiddhyoh samo bhutva samatvam yoga uchyate
items.e: O Dhananjaya, perform actions while established in yoga, abandoning attachment. Remain equal in success and failure, for equanimity is called yoga.
items.h: आसक्ति छोड़, सफलता-असफलता में सम रहकर कर्म करो; समता ही योग है
items.a: yogasthah kuru karmani | samatvam yoga uchyate

items.p: durena hyavaram karma buddhiyogaddhananjaya buddhau sharanamanvichchha kripanah phalahetavah
items.e: Action driven by craving is far below the steadiness of clear discernment. Seek refuge in clear discernment, for those who chase results are pitiable.
items.h: समबुद्धि के आगे सकाम कर्म छोटा है; फल के लोभी दीन हैं

items.p: buddhiyukto jahatiha ubhe sukritadushkrite tasmadyogaya yujyasva yogah karmasu kaushalam
items.e: One who is united with clear discernment casts off both good and bad deeds in this life. Therefore, devote yourself to yoga, for yoga is skill in...
items.h: समबुद्धि पुण्य-पाप दोनों से छुड़ाती है, योग ही कर्मों में कुशलता है
items.a: yogah karmasu kaushalam | yoga karmasu kaushalam

items.s: कर्मजं बुद्धियुक्ता हि फलं त्यक्त्वा मनीषिणः
items.p: karmajam buddhiyukta hi phalam tyaktva manishinah janmabandhavinirmuktah padam gachchhantyanamayam
items.e: Wise people, united in clarity, abandon the fruit born of action and reach the flawless state, free from the bondage of birth.
items.h: समबुद्धि वाले ज्ञानी कर्मफल छोड़कर जन्म-बंधन से मुक्त होते हैं

items.p: yada te mohakalilam buddhirvyatitarishyati tada gantasi nirvedam shrotavyasya shrutasya cha
items.e: When your intellect crosses the swamp of delusion, you will grow dispassionate toward what has been heard and what remains to be heard.
items.h: बुद्धि मोह का दलदल पार करे, तब भोगों से वैराग्य होता है

items.p: shrutivipratipanna te yada sthasyati nishchala samadhavachala buddhistada yogamavapsyasi
items.e: When your intellect, unmoved by conflicting teachings, becomes steady in complete stillness, you will attain yoga.
items.h: मतभेदों से भटकी बुद्धि परमात्मा में अचल हो, तब योग मिलता है

items.p: sthitapragyasya ka bhasha samadhisthasya keshava sthitadhih kim prabhasheta kimasita vrajeta kim
items.e: Arjuna said: O Kesava, what are the marks of one whose wisdom is steady and who is absorbed in stillness? How does a person of steady understanding...
items.h: अर्जुन का प्रश्न: स्थितप्रज्ञ के लक्षण क्या, वह कैसे बोलता-बैठता-चलता है

items.s: प्रजहाति यदा कामान् सर्वान् पार्थ मनोगतान्
items.p: prajahati yada kaman sarvan partha manogatan atmanyevatmana tushtah sthitapragyastadochyate
items.e: The divine said: When a person gives up all desires that arise in the mind, and is satisfied in the true self by the true self alone, that person is...
items.h: जो मन की सब कामनाएँ छोड़कर अपने-आप में संतुष्ट है, वह स्थितप्रज्ञ

items.p: duhkheshvanudvignamanah sukheshu vigatasprihah vitaragabhayakrodhah sthitadhirmuniruchyate
items.e: The steady-minded sage is unshaken by sorrow, free from craving in joy, and beyond attachment, fear, and anger.
items.h: दुख में अविचल, सुख में निःस्पृह, राग-भय-क्रोध रहित मुनि स्थिरबुद्धि है

items.p: yah sarvatranabhisnehastattatprapya shubhashubham nabhinandati na dveshti tasya pragya pratishthita
items.e: One who feels no clinging anywhere, and neither rejoices nor hates when good or bad comes, has steady wisdom.
items.h: शुभ में हर्ष नहीं, अशुभ में द्वेष नहीं: उसकी बुद्धि स्थिर है

items.p: yada sanharate chayam kurmonganiva sarvashah indriyanindriyarthebhyastasya pragya pratishthita
items.e: When this one draws the senses fully back from sense-objects, like a tortoise withdrawing its limbs, wisdom is steady.
items.h: कछुए की तरह इंद्रियों को विषयों से समेट ले, तब बुद्धि स्थिर

items.p: vishaya vinivartante niraharasya dehinah rasavarjam rasopyasya param drishtva nivartate
items.e: Objects fall away from the self-denying person, but the taste for them remains. For the one who has seen the supreme reality, even that taste falls...
items.h: उपवास से विषय छूटते हैं, रस परमात्मा के अनुभव से ही

items.p: yatato hyapi kaunteya purushasya vipashchitah indriyani pramathini haranti prasabham manah
items.e: Even for a wise person who strives, the turbulent senses can forcibly carry away the mind.
items.h: प्रयत्न करते विद्वान का मन भी इंद्रियाँ बलपूर्वक हर लेती हैं

items.s: तानि सर्वाणि संयम्य युक्त आसीत मत्परः
items.p: tani sarvani sanyamya yukta asita matparah vashe hi yasyendriyani tasya pragya pratishthita
items.e: Having restrained all the senses, the disciplined one should sit devoted to Me. For one whose senses are under control, wisdom is firmly established.
items.h: सब इंद्रियों को वश में कर, मेरे परायण होकर बैठो

items.p: dhyayato vishayanpunsah sangasteshupajayate sangat sanjayate kamah kamatkrodhobhijayate
items.e: Thinking about sense objects creates attachment to them. Attachment gives rise to desire; desire gives rise to anger.
items.h: विषयों के चिंतन से आसक्ति, आसक्ति से कामना, कामना से क्रोध

items.p: krodhadbhavati sammohah sammohatsmritivibhramah smritibhranshad buddhinasho buddhinashatpranashyati
items.e: From anger comes delusion; from delusion, confusion of memory; from confusion of memory, loss of discernment; from loss of discernment, ruin.
items.h: क्रोध से सम्मोह, फिर स्मृतिभ्रंश, बुद्धिनाश और अंत में पतन

items.p: ragadveshaviyuktaistu vishayanindriyaishcharan atmavashyairvidheyatma prasadamadhigachchhati
items.e: The disciplined person, moving among objects with senses under control and free from attraction and aversion, attains serenity.
items.h: वश की इंद्रियों से राग-द्वेष बिना विषय बरतने वाला निर्मलता पाता है

items.p: prasade sarvaduhkhanam hanirasyopajayate prasannachetaso hyashu buddhih paryavatishthate
items.e: In inner clarity, all suffering falls away. For one whose mind is clear, understanding settles quickly.
items.h: निर्मल मन में सब दुख मिटते हैं, बुद्धि जल्दी स्थिर होती है

items.p: nasti buddhirayuktasya na chayuktasya bhavana na chabhavayatah shantirashantasya kutah sukham
items.e: A restless mind has no steady discernment, no steady purpose, no peace, and without peace, no happiness.
items.h: असंयमी को न बुद्धि, न भावना, न शांति; अशांत को सुख कहाँ

items.p: indriyanam hi charatam yanmanonuvidhiyate tadasya harati pragyam vayurnavamivambhasi
items.e: As the winds carry a boat on water, even one roaming sense can sweep away the mind's discernment.
items.h: एक इंद्रिय के पीछे चला मन बुद्धि को बहा ले जाता है

items.p: tasmadyasya mahabaho nigrihitani sarvashah indriyanindriyarthebhyastasya pragya pratishthita
items.e: Therefore, O mighty-armed one, the wisdom of one whose senses are fully restrained from sense-objects is steady.
items.h: जिसकी इंद्रियाँ विषयों से पूरी तरह वश में हैं, उसकी बुद्धि स्थिर

items.s: या निशा सर्वभूतानां तस्यां जागर्ति संयमी
items.p: ya nisha sarvabhutanam tasyam jagarti sanyami yasyam jagrati bhutani sa nisha pashyato muneh
items.e: What is night for all beings is wakefulness for the self-controlled one. What all beings wake toward is night for the seer who knows the real.
items.h: सबकी रात में संयमी जागता है, सबके जागने में उसकी रात

items.p: apuryamanamachalapratishthansamudramapah pravishanti yadvat tadvatkama yam pravishanti sarvesa shantimapnoti na kamakami
items.e: As rivers flow into the sea and the sea remains steady, so desires may enter a disciplined person without disturbing inner peace. The person who...
items.h: जैसे नदियाँ समुद्र में समाती हैं, भोग स्थितप्रज्ञ को विचलित नहीं करते

items.p: vihaya kamanyah sarvanpumanshcharati nihsprihah nirmamo nirahankarah sa shantimadhigachchhati
items.e: One who gives up all desires, moves without craving, without possessiveness, and without ego, attains peace.
items.h: सब कामनाएँ छोड़, ममता-अहंकार रहित होकर जीने वाला शांति पाता है

items.s: एषा ब्राह्मी स्थितिः पार्थ नैनां प्राप्य विमुह्यति
items.p: esha brahmi sthitih partha nainam prapya vimuhyati sthitvasyamantakalepi brahmanirvanamrichchhati
items.e: Arjuna, this is the Brahmic state. Having reached it, one is never deluded. Remaining established in it even at the end of life, one attains freedom...
items.h: यह ब्राह्मी स्थिति है; अंत समय में भी मिले तो ब्रह्म-निर्वाण

items.p: jyayasi chetkarmanaste mata buddhirjanardana tatkim karmani ghore mam niyojayasi keshava
items.e: Arjuna said: O Janardana, if you consider understanding superior to action, then why do you urge me to this terrible action, O Keshava? Your mixed...
items.h: अर्जुन का प्रश्न: बुद्धि श्रेष्ठ है तो घोर कर्म क्यों?

items.p: vyamishreneva vakyena buddhim mohayasiva me tadekam vada nishchitya yena shreyohamapnuyam
items.e: Arjuna said: Your words seem mixed and confusing to me. Tell me one thing clearly, so I may find the highest good.
items.h: मिली-जुली बातों से उलझा हूँ, एक निश्चित बात कहिए

items.p: lokesmindvividha nishtha pura prokta mayanagha gyanayogena sankhyanam karmayogena yoginam
items.e: The divine said: In this world, I have already taught two kinds of steadfast practice: the path of knowledge for the contemplative, and the path of...
items.h: दो निष्ठाएँ: ज्ञानियों के लिए ज्ञानयोग, योगियों के लिए कर्मयोग

items.p: na karmanamanarambhannaishkarmyam purushoshnute na cha sannyasanadeva siddhim samadhigachchhati
items.e: A person does not reach actionless freedom by avoiding action, nor by renouncing action alone does one reach perfection.
items.h: कर्म छोड़ देने भर से न निष्कर्मता मिलती, न सिद्धि

items.p: na hi kashchitkshanamapi jatu tishthatyakarmakrit karyate hyavashah karma sarvah prakritijairgunaih
items.e: No one can remain without action even for a moment. Everyone is driven to act by the qualities born of nature.
items.h: कोई भी एक क्षण भी बिना कर्म किए नहीं रहता

items.s: कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन्
items.p: karmendriyani sanyamya ya aste manasa smaran indriyarthanvimudhatma mithyacharah sa uchyate
items.e: One who restrains the organs of action but keeps thinking of sense objects in the mind is deluded and called a hypocrite.
items.h: इंद्रियाँ रोककर मन से विषय सोचने वाला मिथ्याचारी है

items.p: yastvindriyani manasa niyamyarabhaterjuna karmendriyaih karmayogamasaktah sa vishishyate
items.e: Arjuna, the one who restrains the senses with the mind and begins karma yoga without attachment is श्रेष्ठ.
items.h: मन से इंद्रियाँ साधकर, अनासक्त कर्मयोग करने वाला श्रेष्ठ है

items.s: नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः
items.p: niyatam kuru karma tvam karma jyayo hyakarmanah sharirayatrapi cha te na prasiddhyedakarmanah
items.e: Do the duty prescribed for you. Action is better than inaction, and even your body cannot be sustained by inaction.
items.h: नियत कर्म करो, कर्म न करने से कर्म श्रेष्ठ है
items.t: karma yoga niyata karma duty inaction kurukshetra

items.p: yagyarthatkarmanonyatra lokoyam karmabandhanah tadartham karma kaunteya muktasangah samachara
items.e: Actions done for sacrifice free a person; actions done for personal gain bind. Therefore, Arjuna, do your duty without attachment for that purpose...
items.h: यज्ञ के लिए किया कर्म बाँधता नहीं, अनासक्त होकर करो

items.p: sahayagyah prajah srishtva purovacha prajapatih anena prasavishyadhvamesha vostvishtakamadhuk
items.e: In the beginning, Prajapati created beings together with sacrifice and said: “By this, you shall prosper. May this sacrifice be the wish-fulfilling...
items.h: प्रजापति ने यज्ञ सहित प्रजा रची और आशीर्वाद दिया

items.p: devanbhavayatanena te deva bhavayantu vah parasparam bhavayantah shreyah paramavapsyatha
items.e: By nurturing the radiant beings through this duty, let them nurture you. Nurturing one another, you will attain the highest good.
items.h: यज्ञ से देवों को बढ़ाओ, देव तुम्हें; परस्पर से श्रेय

items.p: ishtanbhoganhi vo deva dasyante yagyabhavitah tairdattanapradayaibhyo yo bhunkte stena eva sah
items.e: The radiant beings, nourished by sacrifice, will give you the enjoyments you need. One who enjoys their gifts without offering back is a thief.
items.h: देवों का दिया उन्हें अर्पित किए बिना भोगने वाला चोर है

items.p: yagyashishtashinah santo muchyante sarvakilbishaih bhunjate te tvagham papa ye pachantyatmakaranat
items.e: Those who eat the leftovers of sacrifice are freed from all faults. Those who cook only for themselves eat only wrongdoing.
items.h: यज्ञ का शेष खाने वाले मुक्त, केवल अपने लिए पकाने वाले पापी

items.p: annadbhavanti bhutani parjanyadannasambhavah yagyadbhavati parjanyo yagyah karmasamudbhavah
items.e: All beings arise from food. Food comes from rain. Rain comes from sacrifice. Sacrifice arises from action.
items.h: अन्न से प्राणी, वर्षा से अन्न, यज्ञ से वर्षा

items.p: karma brahmodbhavam viddhi brahmaksharasamudbhavam tasmatsarvagatam brahma nityam yagye pratishthitam
items.e: Know that action comes from the Vedas, and the Vedas come from the imperishable. Therefore, the all-pervading supreme reality is always established...
items.h: कर्म वेद से, वेद अक्षर से; ब्रह्म यज्ञ में प्रतिष्ठित

items.p: evam pravartitam chakram nanuvartayatiha yah aghayurindriyaramo mogham partha sa jivati
items.e: O Partha, the one who does not follow this cycle set in motion here lives in vain, delighting only in the senses and living a life of wrongdoing.
items.h: सृष्टि-चक्र के अनुसार न चलने वाले का जीवन व्यर्थ है

items.p: yastvatmaratireva syadatmatriptashcha manavah atmanyeva cha santushtastasya karyam na vidyate
items.e: The person who delights in the true self, is satisfied in the true self, and is content in the true self has no duty left.
items.h: जो आत्मा में ही तृप्त और संतुष्ट है, उसका कोई कर्तव्य नहीं

items.p: naiva tasya kritenartho nakriteneha kashchana na chasya sarvabhuteshu kashchidarthavyapashrayah
items.e: For the perfected person, no purpose remains in doing, and no purpose remains in not doing. No being in the world is a source of personal gain.
items.h: ऐसे ज्ञानी का करने-न-करने से, किसी से कोई प्रयोजन नहीं

items.p: tasmadasaktah satatam karyam karma samachara asakto hyacharankarma paramapnoti purushah
items.e: Therefore, always perform your duty without attachment; by acting without attachment, a person reaches the supreme.
items.h: इसलिए अनासक्त होकर निरंतर कर्तव्य कर्म करते रहो
items.t: nishkama karma attachment duty kurukshetra karma yoga

items.p: karmanaiva hi sansiddhimasthita janakadayah lokasangrahamevapi sampashyankartumarhasi
items.e: Janaka and others attained perfection through action itself. You should act too, while keeping the welfare of the world in view.
items.h: जनक आदि ने कर्म से सिद्धि पाई; लोकसंग्रह हेतु कर्म करो

items.p: yadyadacharati shreshthastattadevetaro janah sa yatpramanam kurute lokastadanuvartate
items.e: Whatever the best person does, others follow. Whatever standard they set, the world copies.
items.h: श्रेष्ठ जैसा आचरण करता है, लोग वैसा ही करते हैं
items.a: yad yad acharati shreshthas | yad yad acharati | yadyad acharati

items.s: न मे पार्थास्ति कर्तव्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु किञ्चन
items.p: na me parthasti kartavyam trishu lokeshu kinchana nanavaptamavaptavyam varta eva cha karmani
items.e: O Partha, there is nothing in the three worlds that I must do, and nothing I have not yet gained that must be gained. Yet I remain engaged in action.
items.h: मेरे लिए कुछ कर्तव्य नहीं, फिर भी मैं कर्म में लगा हूँ

items.s: यदि ह्यहं न वर्तेयं जातु कर्मण्यतन्द्रितः
items.p: yadi hyaham na varteyam jatu karmanyatandritah mama vartmanuvartante manushyah partha sarvashah
items.e: For if I ever stopped acting with care, people would follow my path in every way, Arjuna.
items.h: यदि मैं सावधान होकर कर्म न करूँ, लोग वही राह पकड़ेंगे

items.s: उत्सीदेयुरिमे लोका न कुर्यां कर्म चेदहम्
items.p: utsideyurime loka na kuryam karma chedaham sankarasya cha karta syamupahanyamimah prajah
items.e: If I did not act, these worlds would fall into ruin. I would create disorder and destroy these people.
items.h: मैं कर्म छोड़ूँ तो लोक नष्ट हों, मर्यादा बिगड़े

items.p: saktah karmanyavidvanso yatha kurvanti bharata kuryadvidvanstathasaktashchikirshurlokasangraham
items.e: As the ignorant act with attachment to action, so should the wise act without attachment, seeking the welfare of the world.
items.h: ज्ञानी भी लोकसंग्रह हेतु कर्म करे, पर अनासक्त होकर

items.p: na buddhibhedam janayedagyanam karmasanginam joshayetsarvakarmani vidvan yuktah samacharan
items.e: An awakened person should not unsettle the minds of those attached to action. Instead, acting skillfully, such a person should engage them in all...
items.h: ज्ञानी कर्मासक्त लोगों में बुद्धिभेद न करे, स्वयं कर्म करे
items.t: lokasangraha buddhibheda karma-sanga wise conduct guided action

items.p: prakriteh kriyamanani gunaih karmani sarvashah ahankaravimudhatma kartahamiti manyate
items.e: All actions are carried out in every way by the qualities of nature. Deluded by ego, a person thinks, 'I am the doer.'
items.h: कर्म प्रकृति के गुण करते हैं, अहंकारी स्वयं को कर्ता मानता है

items.p: tattvavittu mahabaho gunakarmavibhagayoh guna guneshu vartanta iti matva na sajjate
items.e: The one who truly understands the division of qualities and actions does not cling, seeing that qualities act upon qualities.
items.h: तत्त्वज्ञ जानता है गुण गुणों में बरतते हैं, आसक्त नहीं होता

items.p: prakritergunasammudhah sajjante gunakarmasu tanakritsnavido mandankritsnavinna vichalayet
items.e: The ignorant, deluded by the qualities of nature, cling to actions born of those qualities. The wise should not unsettle those who do not yet...
items.h: गुणों से मोहित अधूरे जानकारों को पूर्ण ज्ञानी विचलित न करे

items.p: mayi sarvani karmani sannyasyadhyatmachetasa nirashirnirmamo bhutva yudhyasva vigatajvarah
items.e: Surrender all actions to me with the disciplined mind. Free from desire, possessiveness, and sorrow, fight.
items.h: सब कर्म मुझे अर्पित कर, निष्काम और निर्मम होकर युद्ध करो

items.p: ye me matamidam nityamanutishthanti manavah shraddhavantonasuyanto muchyante tepi karmabhih
items.e: Those who always follow this teaching of Mine with trust and without fault-finding are freed from the bonds of action.
items.h: श्रद्धा से, दोष-दृष्टि बिना इस मत पर चलने वाले मुक्त होते

items.p: ye tvetadabhyasuyanto nanutishthanti me matam sarvagyanavimudhanstanviddhi nashtanachetasah
items.e: But those who, finding fault with this teaching, do not follow it—know them to be deluded in all knowledge and ruined in understanding.
items.h: इस मत में दोष देखकर न चलने वालों को नष्ट समझो

items.p: sadrisham cheshtate svasyah prakritergyanavanapi prakritim yanti bhutani nigrahah kim karishyati
items.e: Even the wise act according to their own nature. All beings follow nature; what can restraint do?
items.h: ज्ञानी भी स्वभाव के अनुसार चलता है; हठ क्या करेगा

items.p: indriyasyendriyasyarthe ragadveshau vyavasthitau tayorna vashamagachchhettau hyasya paripanthinau
items.e: Attachment and aversion sit in every sense-object. Do not come under their power, for they are your enemies on the path.
items.h: हर इंद्रिय के विषय में राग-द्वेष बैठे हैं; उनके वश न हो

items.p: shreyansvadharmo vigunah paradharmatsvanushthitat svadharme nidhanam shreyah paradharmo bhayavahah
items.e: Better is one's own duty, though imperfect, than another's duty well performed. Better death in one's own duty; another's duty is dangerous.
items.h: गुणहीन स्वधर्म भी अच्छी तरह निभाए परधर्म से श्रेष्ठ

items.s: अथ केन प्रयुक्तोऽयं पापं चरति पूरुषः
items.p: atha kena prayuktoyam papam charati purushah anichchhannapi varshneya baladiva niyojitah
items.e: Arjuna said: O descendant of the Vrishni clan, what drives a person to commit wrongdoing, even unwillingly, as if forced?
items.h: अर्जुन पूछते हैं: न चाहते हुए भी मनुष्य पाप क्यों करता है?
items.t: inner conflict compulsion arjuna-question moral struggle rajas

items.p: kama esha krodha esha rajogunasamudbhavah mahashano mahapapma viddhyenamiha vairinam
items.e: Krishna said: Desire, born of rajas, turns into anger. It is all-consuming and deeply destructive. Know it as your enemy here.
items.h: रजोगुण से जन्मा काम ही क्रोध बनता है, यही शत्रु है

items.p: dhumenavriyate vahniryathadarsho malena cha yatholbenavrito garbhastatha tenedamavritam
items.e: As fire is covered by smoke, a mirror by dust, and a womb by a membrane, so clear seeing is covered by desire.
items.h: जैसे धुएँ से आग, वैसे काम से ज्ञान ढका है

items.p: avritam gyanametena gyanino nityavairina kamarupena kaunteya dushpurenanalena cha
items.e: O son of Kunti, wisdom is covered by this desire, the eternal enemy of the wise, as fire is never satisfied.
items.h: कभी न भरने वाली आग जैसा काम ज्ञानी का नित्य शत्रु
items.t: kama buddhi avidya inner conflict desire

items.p: indriyani mano buddhirasyadhishthanamuchyate etairvimohayatyesha gyanamavritya dehinam
items.e: The senses, the mind, and the discerning mind are said to be its seat. Through them, it deludes the embodied person by veiling understanding.
items.h: इंद्रियाँ, मन और बुद्धि काम के निवास-स्थान हैं

items.p: tasmattvamindriyanyadau niyamya bharatarshabha papmanam prajahi hyenam gyanavigyananashanam
items.e: Therefore, O best of the Bharatas, first control the senses, and then destroy this great sinner, the destroyer of knowledge and wisdom.
items.h: पहले इंद्रियों को वश करो, फिर ज्ञान-नाशक काम को मारो

items.p: indriyani paranyahurindriyebhyah param manah manasastu para buddhiryo buddheh paratastu sah
items.e: The senses are higher than the body; the mind is higher than the senses; the discerning mind is higher than the mind. And beyond the discerning mind...
items.h: इंद्रियों से मन, मन से बुद्धि, बुद्धि से परे आत्मा

items.p: evam buddheh param buddhva sanstabhyatmanamatmana jahi shatrum mahabaho kamarupam durasadam
items.e: Thus, knowing the higher beyond the intellect, steady the lower self by the higher self, and destroy that enemy in the form of desire, which is hard...
items.h: बुद्धि से परे को जानकर, मन साधकर कामरूपी शत्रु मारो

items.p: imam vivasvate yogam proktavanahamavyayam vivasvan manave praha manurikshvakavebravit
items.e: The Lord said: I taught this imperishable yoga to Vivasvan. Vivasvan taught it to Manu, and Manu taught it to Ikshvaku.
items.h: श्रीभगवान् बोले मैंने इस अविनाशी योगको सूर्यसे कहा था । फिर सूर्यने अपने पुत्र वैवस्वत...

items.p: evam paramparapraptamimam rajarshayo viduh sa kaleneha mahata yogo nashtah parantapa
items.e: O scorcher of foes, this yoga was known by the royal sages through an unbroken lineage. In the course of great time, this yoga was lost in this world.
items.h: हे परंतप इस तरह परम्परासे प्राप्त इस कर्मयोग को राजर्षियोंने जाना । परन्तु बहुत समय बीत...

items.s: स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः
items.p: sa evayam maya tedya yogah proktah puratanah bhaktosi me sakha cheti rahasyam hyetaduttamam
items.e: Because you are my devotee and my friend, I have taught you today this ancient yoga. It is a supreme secret.
items.h: तू मेरा भक्त और प्रिय सखा है, इसलिये वही यह पुरातन योग आज मैंने तुझसे कहा है क्योंकि यह...

items.s: अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः
items.p: aparam bhavato janma param janma vivasvatah kathametadvijaniyam tvamadau proktavaniti
items.e: Arjuna said: Your birth is recent, while the birth of the Sun is ancient. How am I to understand that you taught this yoga at the beginning of...
items.h: अर्जुन बोले आपका जन्म तो अभीका है और सूर्यका जन्म बहुत पुराना है अतः आपने ही सृष्टिके...

items.s: बहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन
items.p: bahuni me vyatitani janmani tava charjuna tanyaham veda sarvani na tvam vettha parantapa
items.e: Krishna said: Many births of yours and mine have passed, Arjuna. I know them all, but you do not, enemy-burner.
items.h: श्रीभगवान् बोले हे परन्तप अर्जुन मेरे और तेरे बहुतसे जन्म हो चुके हैं । उन सबको मैं जानता...

items.p: ajopi sannavyayatma bhutanamishvaropi san prakritim svamadhishthaya sambhavamyatmamayaya
items.e: Though unborn and imperishable, and though I am the lord of all beings, I manifest myself by controlling my own nature through my own power of...
items.h: मैं अजन्मा और अविनाशीस्वरूप होते हुए भी तथा सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंका ईश्वर होते हुए भी अपनी...

items.s: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत
items.p: yada yada hi dharmasya glanirbhavati bharata abhyutthanamadharmasya tadatmanam srijamyaham
items.e: Whenever there is a decline of dharma and a rise of adharma, I manifest myself.
items.h: हे भरतवंशी अर्जुन जबजब धर्मकी हानि और अधर्मकी वृद्धि होती है, तबतब ही मैं अपनेआपको...

items.p: paritranaya sadhunam vinashaya cha dushkritam dharmasansthapanarthaya sambhavami yuge yuge
items.e: For the protection of the righteous, for the destruction of wrongdoers, and for the establishment of dharma, I appear age after age.
items.h: साधुओंभक्तों की रक्षा करनेके लिये, पापकर्म करनेवालोंका विनाश करनेके लिये और धर्मकी...
items.a: paritranaya sadhunam | sambhavami yuge yuge | dharma samsthapanarthaya

items.s: जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः
items.p: janma karma cha me divyamevam yo vetti tattvatah tyaktva deham punarjanma naiti mameti sorjuna
items.e: Arjuna, my birth and action are divine. One who truly understands this does not take birth again after leaving the body, but comes to me.
items.h: हे अर्जुन मेरे जन्म और कर्म दिव्य हैं । इस प्रकार मेरे जन्म और कर्मको जो मनुष्य तत्त्वसे...

items.p: vitaragabhayakrodha manmaya mamupashritah bahavo gyanatapasa puta madbhavamagatah
items.e: Many, purified by the austerity of knowledge, free from attachment, fear, and anger, absorbed in Me and taking refuge in Me, have attained My being.
items.h: राग, भय और क्रोधसे सर्वथा रहित, मेरेमें ही तल्लीन, मेरे ही आश्रित तथा ज्ञानरूप तपसे...

items.s: ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम्
items.p: ye yatha mam prapadyante tanstathaiva bhajamyaham mama vartmanuvartante manushyah partha sarvashah
items.e: As people approach Me, so I respond to them. All people follow My path in every way, O Arjuna.
items.h: हे पृथानन्दन जो भक्त जिस प्रकार मेरी शरण लेते हैं, मैं उन्हें उसी प्रकार आश्रय देता हूँ...

items.s: काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः
items.p: kankshantah karmanam siddhim yajanta iha devatah kshipram hi manushe loke siddhirbhavati karmaja
items.e: People who want quick success worship radiant beings, because results from action come quickly in the human world.
items.h: कर्मोंकी सिद्धि फल चाहनेवाले मनुष्य देवताओंकी उपासना किया करते हैं क्योंकि इस...

items.p: chaturvarnyam maya srishtam gunakarmavibhagashah tasya kartaramapi mam viddhyakartaramavyayam
items.e: The four social orders were created by Me according to qualities and actions. Though I am their maker, know Me as the unchanging non-doer.
items.h: मेरे द्वारा गुणों और कर्मोंके विभागपूर्वक चारों वर्णोंकी रचना की गयी है । उससृष्टिरचना...

items.s: न मां कर्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा
items.p: na mam karmani limpanti na me karmaphale spriha iti mam yobhijanati karmabhirna sa badhyate
items.e: Actions do not stain me, and I do not crave their fruits. One who knows me this way is not bound by actions.
items.h: मेरे द्वारा गुणों और कर्मोंके विभागपूर्वक चारों वर्णोंकी रचना की गयी है । उससृष्टिरचना...

items.s: एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः
items.p: evam gyatva kritam karma purvairapi mumukshubhih kuru karmaiva tasmattvam purvaih purvataram kritam
items.e: Even seekers of freedom acted after knowing this. Therefore, do the work that your ancestors always did.
items.h: पूर्वकालके मुमुक्षुओंने भी इस प्रकार जानकर कर्म किये हैं, इसलिये तू भी पूर्वजोंके द्वारा...

items.p: kim karma kimakarmeti kavayopyatra mohitah tatte karma pravakshyami yajgyatva mokshyaseshubhat
items.e: What is action, and what is inaction? Even the wise are confused here. I will explain that action to you, knowing which you will be freed from what...
items.h: कर्म क्या है और अकर्म क्या है इस प्रकार इस विषयमें विद्वान् भी मोहित हो जाते हैं । अतः वह...

items.s: कर्मणो ह्यपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः
items.p: karmano hyapi boddhavyam boddhavyam cha vikarmanah akarmanashcha boddhavyam gahana karmano gatih
items.e: Action, forbidden action, and inaction must all be understood, because the movement of action is hard to grasp.
items.h: कर्मका तत्त्व भी जानना चाहिये और अकर्मका तत्त्व भी जानना चाहिये तथा विकर्मका तत्त्व भी...
items.t: karmano gati vikarma akarma discrimination jnana yoga

items.s: कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः
items.p: karmanyakarma yah pashyedakarmani cha karma yah sa buddhiman manushyeshu sa yuktah kritsnakarmakrit
items.e: One who sees action in inaction, and inaction in action, is wise among people; that person is disciplined and complete in action.
items.h: जो मनुष्य कर्ममें अकर्म देखता है और जो अकर्ममें कर्म देखता है, वह मनुष्योंमें बुद्धिमान्...
items.t: karmanyakarma akarma jnana-yoga inner freedom actionless action

items.p: yasya sarve samarambhah kamasankalpavarjitah gyanagnidagdhakarmanam tamahuh panditam budhah
items.e: The wise call that person learned whose actions begin without desire or personal planning, and whose deeds are burned by the fire of knowledge.
items.h: जिसके सम्पूर्ण कर्मोंके आरम्भ संकल्प और कामनासे रहित हैं तथा जिसके सम्पूर्ण कर्म...

items.p: tyaktva karmaphalasangam nityatripto nirashrayah karmanyabhipravrittopi naiva kinchitkaroti sah
items.e: One who has abandoned attachment to the fruits of action, remains ever content, and depends on nothing, does nothing at all even while fully engaged...
items.h: जो कर्म और फलकी आसक्तिका त्याग करके आश्रयसे रहित और सदा तृप्त है, वह कर्मोंमें अच्छी तरह...

items.p: nirashiryatachittatma tyaktasarvaparigrahah shariram kevalam karma kurvannapnoti kilbisham
items.e: One who has no hope, who has controlled the body and mind, and who has given up all possessions, does only bodily action and incurs no fault.
items.h: जिसका शरीर और अन्तःकरण अच्छी तरहसे वशमें किया हुआ है, जिसने सब प्रकारके संग्रहका परित्याग...

items.p: yadrichchhalabhasantushto dvandvatito vimatsarah samah siddhavasiddhau cha kritvapi na nibadhyate
items.e: Content with whatever comes by itself, beyond opposites, free from envy, equal in success and failure, such a person is not bound even while acting.
items.h: जो कर्मयोगी फल की इच्छा के बिना, अपनेआप जो कुछ मिल जाय, उसमें सन्तुष्ट रहता है और जो...

items.p: gatasangasya muktasya gyanavasthitachetasah yagyayacharatah karma samagram praviliyate
items.e: For one who has given up attachment, is freed, and whose mind rests in knowledge, all action melts away when done only for sacrifice.
items.h: जिसकी आसक्ति सर्वथा मिट गयी है, जो मुक्त हो गया है, जिसकी बुद्धि स्वरूपके ज्ञानमें स्थित...

items.p: brahmarpanam brahmahavirbrahmagnau brahmana hutam brahmaiva tena gantavyam brahmakarmasamadhina
items.e: In such sacrifice, the offering is Brahman, the oblation is Brahman, and the act of offering into the fire of Brahman is Brahman. One whose action is...
items.h: जिस यज्ञमें अर्पण भी ब्रह्म है, हवी भी ब्रह्म है और ब्रह्मरूप कर्ताके द्वारा ब्रह्मरूप...

items.p: daivamevapare yagyam yoginah paryupasate brahmagnavapare yagyam yagyenaivopajuhvati
items.e: Some yogis offer sacrifice to the divine alone. Others offer the self into the fire of Brahman through sacrifice itself.
items.h: अन्य योगीलोग भगवदर्पणरूप यज्ञका ही अनुष्ठान करते हैं और दूसरे योगीलोग ब्रह्मरूप अग्निमें...

items.p: shrotradinindriyanyanye sanyamagnishu juhvati shabdadinvishayananya indriyagnishu juhvati
items.e: Some yogis offer the senses into the fires of restraint. Others offer sound and the other sense-objects into the fires of the senses.
items.h: अन्य योगीलोग श्रोत्रादि समस्त इन्द्रियोंका संयमरूप अग्नियोंमें हवन किया करते हैं और दूसरे...

items.p: sarvanindriyakarmani pranakarmani chapare atmasanyamayogagnau juhvati gyanadipite
items.e: Others offer all the activities of the senses and the life-force into the fire of self-control, lit by knowledge.
items.h: अन्य योगीलोग सम्पूर्ण इन्द्रियोंकी क्रियाओंको और प्राणोंकी क्रियाओंको ज्ञानसे प्रकाशित...

items.p: dravyayagyastapoyagya yogayagyastathapare svadhyayagyanayagyashcha yatayah sanshitavratah
items.e: Others offer wealth, austerity, yoga, and the study of sacred texts as sacrifice, while disciplined seekers make these offerings with firm vows.
items.h: दूसरे कितने ही तीक्ष्ण व्रत करनेवाले प्रयत्नशील साधक द्रव्यसम्बन्धी यज्ञ करनेवाले हैं, और...

items.p: apane juhvati prana pranepanam tathapare pranapanagati ruddhva pranayamaparayanah
items.e: Some offer the outgoing breath into the incoming breath, and the incoming breath into the outgoing breath, restraining the movement of both through...
items.h: दूसरे कितने ही प्राणायामके परायण हुए योगीलोग अपानमें प्राणका पूरक करके, प्राण और अपानकी...

items.p: apare niyataharah prananpraneshu juhvati sarvepyete yagyavido yagyakshapitakalmashah
items.e: Some offer the breath into the breath through regulated breathing; some, with regulated food, offer the life-forces into the life-forces. All of them...
items.h: दूसरे कितने ही प्राणायामके परायण हुए योगीलोग अपानमें प्राणका पूरक करके, प्राण और अपानकी...

items.p: yagyashishtamritabhujo yanti brahma sanatanam nayam lokostyayagyasya kutonyah kurusattama
items.e: Those who partake of the nectar left over from sacrifice attain the eternal supreme reality. This world is not for the one who does not perform...
items.h: हे कुरुवंशियोंमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुन यज्ञसे बचे हुए अमृतका अनुभव करनेवाले सनातन परब्रह्म...

items.s: एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे
items.p: evam bahuvidha yagya vitata brahmano mukhe karmajanviddhi tansarvanevam gyatva vimokshyase
items.e: In this way, many kinds of sacrifice are described in the sacred teaching. Know them all as born of action; knowing this, you will be freed from the...
items.h: इस प्रकार और भी बहुत तरहके यज्ञ वेदकी वाणीमें विस्तारसे कहे गये हैं । उन सब यज्ञोंको तू...

items.p: shreyandravyamayadyagyajgyanayagyah parantapa sarvam karmakhilam partha gyane parisamapyate
items.e: O Arjuna, knowledge-sacrifice is better than sacrifice made of material things. All action and all matter end in knowledge.
items.h: हे परन्तप अर्जुन द्रव्यमय यज्ञसे ज्ञानयज्ञ श्रेष्ठ है । सम्पूर्ण कर्म और पदार्थ...

items.p: tadviddhi pranipatena pariprashnena sevaya upadekshyanti te gyanam gyaninastattvadarshinah
items.e: Know that by prostration, by sincere questioning, and by service. The wise who see reality will teach you that knowledge.
items.h: उस तत्त्वज्ञान को तत्त्वदर्शी ज्ञानी महापुरुषोंके पास जाकर समझ । उनको साष्टाङ्ग दण्डवत्...

items.p: yajgyatva na punarmohamevam yasyasi pandava yena bhutanyasheshena drakshyasyatmanyatho mayi
items.e: Knowing which, you will not fall into confusion again. Through which, you will see all beings without remainder first in yourself, and then in me.
items.h: जिस तत्त्वज्ञान का अनुभव करनेके बाद तू फिर इस प्रकार मोहको नहीं प्राप्त होगा, और हे...

items.p: api chedasi papebhyah sarvebhyah papakrittamah sarvam gyanaplavenaiva vrijinam santarishyasi
items.e: Even if you are the worst of wrongdoers, you will cross all wrongdoing by the raft of knowledge alone.
items.h: अगर तू सब पापियोंसे भी अधिक पापी है, तो भी तू ज्ञानरूपी नौकाके द्वारा निःसन्देह सम्पूर्ण...

items.p: yathaidhansi samiddhognirbhasmasatkuruterjuna gyanagnih sarvakarmani bhasmasatkurute tatha
items.e: As a blazing fire reduces fuel to ashes, so the fire of knowledge reduces all actions to ashes, Arjuna.
items.h: हे अर्जुन जैसे प्रज्वलित अग्नि ईंधनोंको सर्वथा भस्म कर देती है, ऐसे ही ज्ञानरूपी अग्नि...

items.s: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते
items.p: na hi gyanena sadrisham pavitramiha vidyate tatsvayam yogasansiddhah kalenatmani vindati
items.e: No purifier compares to knowledge in this world. The one perfected in yoga finds that knowledge within the self in time.
items.h: इस मनुष्यलोकमें ज्ञानके समान पवित्र करनेवाला निःसन्देह दूसरा कोई साधन नहीं है । जिसका योग...
items.a: na hi jnanena sadrisham | na hi gyanena sadrisham

items.p: shraddhavanllabhate gyanam tatparah sanyatendriyah gyanam labdhva param shantimachirenadhigachchhati
items.e: The person with trust, discipline, and controlled senses gains knowledge. Having gained knowledge, that person quickly reaches supreme peace.
items.h: जो जितेन्द्रिय तथा साधनपरायण है, ऐसा श्रद्धावान् मनुष्य ज्ञानको प्राप्त होता है और...

items.p: agyashchashraddadhanashcha sanshayatma vinashyati nayam lokosti na paro na sukham sanshayatmanah
items.e: The ignorant and faithless person who doubts is ruined. For the doubter, there is neither this world, nor the next, nor happiness.
items.h: विवेकहीन और श्रद्धारहित संशयात्मा मनुष्यका पतन हो जाता है । ऐसे संशयात्मा मनुष्यके लिये न...

items.p: yogasannyastakarmanam gyanasanchhinnasanshayam atmavantam na karmani nibadhnanti dhananjaya
items.e: O Dhananjaya, actions do not bind the one who has renounced action through yoga, whose doubts have been cut away by knowledge, and who abides in the...
items.h: हे धनञ्जय योग समता के द्वारा जिसका सम्पूर्ण कर्मोंसे सम्बन्धविच्छेद हो गया है और ज्ञानके...

items.p: tasmadagyanasambhutam hritstham gyanasinatmanah chhittvainam sanshayam yogamatishthottishtha bharata
items.e: Therefore, O Bharata, cut away this doubt in your heart, born of ignorance, with the sword of knowledge. Stand in yoga and rise up for battle.
items.h: इसलिये हे भरतवंशी अर्जुन हृदयमें स्थित इस अज्ञानसे उत्पन्न अपने संशयका ज्ञानरूप तलवारसे...
items.t: doubt ignorance clear seeing kurukshetra action after insight

items.s: संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि
items.p: sannyasam karmanam krishna punaryogam cha shansasi yachchhreya etayorekam tanme bruhi sunishchitam
items.e: Arjuna said: Krishna, you praise both renunciation of action and yoga of action. Tell me clearly which one is definitely better for my welfare.
items.h: अर्जुन बोले हे कृष्ण आप कर्मोंका स्वरूपसे त्याग करनेकी और फिर कर्मयोगकी प्रशंसा करते हैं...

items.p: sannyasah karmayogashcha nihshreyasakaravubhau tayostu karmasannyasatkarmayogo vishishyate
items.e: Renunciation and karma yoga both lead to the highest good, but karma yoga is better than renouncing action.
items.h: श्रीभगवान् बोले संन्यास सांख्ययोग और कर्मयोग दोनों ही कल्याण करनेवाले हैं । परन्तु उन...
items.t: karma yoga sannyasa nishkama action without attachment renunciation

items.s: ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति
items.p: gyeyah sa nityasannyasi yo na dveshti na kankshati nirdvandvo hi mahabaho sukham bandhatpramuchyate
items.e: One who neither hates nor desires is always a renunciant. Free from opposites, such a person is easily released from bondage, O mighty-armed one.
items.h: हे महाबाहो जो मनुष्य न किसीसे द्वेष करता है और न किसीकी आकाङ्क्षा करता है वह कर्मयोगी सदा...

items.p: sankhyayogau prithagbalah pravadanti na panditah ekamapyasthitah samyagubhayorvindate phalam
items.e: The unwise say that renunciation and yoga lead to different results. The wise see that one who is firmly established in either reaches the same fruit.
items.h: बेसमझ लोग सांख्ययोग और कर्मयोगको अलगअलग फलवाले कहते हैं, न कि पण्डितजन क्योंकि इन...

items.p: yatsankhyaih prapyate sthanam tadyogairapi gamyate ekam sankhyam cha yogam cha yah pashyati sa pashyati
items.e: The state reached by the wise is also reached through yoga. One who sees wisdom and yoga as one sees rightly.
items.h: सांख्ययोगियोंके द्वारा जो तत्त्व प्राप्त किया जाता है, कर्मयोगियोंके द्वारा भी वही...

items.p: sannyasastu mahabaho duhkhamaptumayogatah yogayukto munirbrahma nachirenadhigachchhati
items.e: But, mighty-armed one, renunciation without yoga is hard to attain. The disciplined seeker in yoga quickly reaches the supreme reality.
items.h: परन्तु हे महाबाहो कर्मयोगके बिना संन्यास सिद्ध होना कठिन है । मननशील कर्मयोगी शीघ्र ही...

items.p: yogayukto vishuddhatma vijitatma jitendriyah sarvabhutatmabhutatma kurvannapi na lipyate
items.e: A disciplined yogi, pure in mind, self-mastered, and senses conquered, sees the same self in all beings and is not tainted by action while acting.
items.h: जिसकी इन्द्रियाँ अपने वशमें हैं, जिसका अन्तःकरण निर्मल है, जिसका शरीर अपने वशमें है और...

items.p: naiva kinchitkaromiti yukto manyeta tattvavit pashyan shrrinavansprishanjighrannashnangachchhansvapan shvasan
items.e: The knower of reality should think, "I do nothing at all," while seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, walking, taking, speaking, discarding...
items.h: तत्त्वको जाननेवाला सांख्ययोगी देखता, सुनता, छूता, सूँघता, खाता, चलता, ग्रहण करता, बोलता...

items.p: pralapanvisrijangrihnannunmishannimishannapi indriyanindriyartheshu vartanta iti dharayan
items.e: Even while speaking, releasing, taking, opening, and closing the eyes, the wise know: the senses move among their objects.
items.h: तत्त्वको जाननेवाला सांख्ययोगी देखता, सुनता, छूता, सूँघता, खाता, चलता, ग्रहण करता, बोलता...

items.s: ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः
items.p: brahmanyadhaya karmani sangam tyaktva karoti yah lipyate na sa papena padmapatramivambhasa
items.e: One who offers actions to Brahman, renounces attachment, and acts is not stained by wrongdoing, just as a lotus leaf is untouched by water.
items.h: जो भक्तियोगी सम्पूर्ण कर्मोंको भगवान् में अर्पण करके और आसक्तिका त्याग करके कर्म करता है...

items.p: kayena manasa buddhya kevalairindriyairapi yoginah karma kurvanti sangam tyaktvatmashuddhaye
items.e: Yogis perform action with body, mind, intellect, and the senses, giving up attachment, only for inner purification.
items.h: कर्मयोगी आसक्तिका त्याग करके केवल ममतारहित इन्द्रियाँशरीरमनबुद्धि के द्वारा केवल...

items.p: yuktah karmaphalam tyaktva shantimapnoti naishthikim ayuktah kamakarena phale sakto nibadhyate
items.e: The disciplined one gives up the fruit of action and attains steady peace. The undisciplined one, clinging to results through desire, becomes bound.
items.h: कर्मयोगी कर्मफलका त्याग करके नैष्ठिकी शान्तिको प्राप्त होता है । परन्तु सकाम मनुष्य...

items.p: sarvakarmani manasa sannyasyaste sukham vashi navadvare pure dehi naiva kurvanna karayan
items.e: The embodied one, who has mastered the senses and mind, dwells happily in the city of nine gates, mentally renouncing all actions, neither doing nor...
items.h: जिसकी इन्द्रियाँ और मन वशमें हैं, ऐसा देहधारी पुरुष नौ द्वारोंवाले शरीररूपी पुरमें...

items.s: न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः
items.p: na kartritvam na karmani lokasya srijati prabhuh na karmaphalasanyogam svabhavastu pravartate
items.e: The supreme being creates neither doership nor actions nor the link between action and result for people. Nature alone keeps moving.
items.h: परमेश्वर मनुष्योंके न कर्तापनकी, न कर्मोंकी और न कर्मफलके साथ संयोगकी रचना करते हैं...

items.s: नादत्ते कस्यचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः
items.p: nadatte kasyachitpapam na chaiva sukritam vibhuh agyanenavritam gyanam tena muhyanti jantavah
items.e: The all-pervading one takes neither anyone's wrongdoing nor anyone's good deed. Knowledge is covered by ignorance, and that is why living beings are...
items.h: सर्वव्यापी परमात्मा न किसीके पापकर्मको और न शुभकर्मको ही ग्रहण करता है किन्तु अज्ञानसे...

items.p: gyanena tu tadagyanam yesham nashitamatmanah teshamadityavajgyanam prakashayati tatparam
items.e: But for those whose ignorance has been destroyed by knowledge of the true self, that knowledge reveals the supreme reality like the sun.
items.h: परन्तु जिन्होंने अपने जिस ज्ञानविवक के द्वारा उस अज्ञानका नाश कर दिया है, उनका वह ज्ञान...

items.p: tadbuddhayastadatmanastannishthastatparayanah gachchhantyapunaravrittim gyananirdhutakalmashah
items.e: Those whose intellect is fixed in That, whose mind is That, who are established in That, and who are devoted to That, go to the state of no return...
items.h: जिनकी बुद्धि तदाकार हो रही है, जिनका मन तदाकार हो रहा है, जिनकी स्थिति परमात्मतत्वमें है...

items.p: vidyavinayasampanne brahmane gavi hastini shuni chaiva shvapake cha panditah samadarshinah
items.e: The wise see the same reality in a learned, humble brahmin, a cow, an elephant, a dog, and an outcaste.
items.h: ज्ञानी महापुरुष विद्याविनययुक्त ब्राह्मणमें और चाण्डालमें तथा गाय, हाथी एवं कुत्तेमें भी...

items.s: इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः
items.p: ihaiva tairjitah sargo yesham samye sthitam manah nirdosham hi samam brahma tasmadbrahmani te sthitah
items.e: Those whose mind rests in sameness conquer rebirth here itself. The supreme reality is flawless and equal, so they are established in it.
items.h: जिनका अन्तःकरण समतामें स्थित है, उन्होंने इस जीवितअवस्थामें ही सम्पूर्ण संसारको जीत लिया...
items.t: samatva brahman rebirth equanimity inner steadiness

items.p: na prahrishyetpriyam prapya nodvijetprapya chapriyam sthirabuddhirasammudho brahmavidbrahmani sthitah
items.e: One who does not rejoice at the pleasant, and does not shrink from the unpleasant, is steady in understanding, free from delusion, and established in...
items.h: जो प्रियको प्राप्त होकर हर्षित न हो और अप्रियको प्राप्त होकर उद्विग्न न हो, वह स्थिर...

items.p: bahyasparsheshvasaktatma vindatyatmani yatsukham sa brahmayogayuktatma sukhamakshayamashnute
items.e: One who is not attached to outer contacts finds the joy within the true self. Unified with the supreme reality, that person enjoys unending happiness.
items.h: बाह्यस्पर्शमें आसक्तिरहित अन्तःकरणवाला साधक आत्मामें जो सुख है, उसको प्राप्त होता है...

items.s: ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते
items.p: ye hi sansparshaja bhoga duhkhayonaya eva te adyantavantah kaunteya na teshu ramate budhah
items.e: The pleasures born from contact with the senses are only sources of suffering. They have a beginning and an end, O Arjuna, and the wise do not...
items.h: क्योंकि हे कुन्तीनन्दन जो इन्द्रियों और विषयोंके संयोगसे पैदा होनेवाले भोग सुख हैं, वे...

items.p: shaknotihaiva yah sodhum prakshariravimokshanat kamakrodhodbhavam vegam sa yuktah sa sukhi narah
items.e: Whoever can withstand the surge of desire and anger here before the body falls, is a disciplined person and is truly happy.
items.h: इस मनुष्यशरीरमें जो कोई मनुष्य शरीर छूटनेसे पहले ही कामक्रोधसे उत्पन्न होनेवाले वेगको सहन...

items.p: yontahsukhontararamastathantarjyotireva yah sa yogi brahmanirvanam brahmabhutodhigachchhati
items.e: One who finds happiness within, delights within, and has inner light alone, becomes one with the supreme reality and reaches freedom in the supreme...
items.h: जो मनुष्य केवल परमात्मामें सुखवाला है और केवल परमात्मामें रमण करनेवाला है तथा जो केवल...

items.p: labhante brahmanirvanamrishayah kshinakalmashah chhinnadvaidha yatatmanah sarvabhutahite ratah
items.e: Sages who are free of impurity, free of doubt, self-controlled, and devoted to the welfare of all beings attain freedom in the supreme reality.
items.h: जिनका शरीर मनबुद्धिइन्द्रियोंसहित वशमें है, जो सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके हितमें रत हैं, जिनके...

items.p: kamakrodhaviyuktanam yatinam yatachetasam abhito brahmanirvanam vartate viditatmanam
items.e: For those free from desire and anger, with disciplined minds and self-knowledge, freedom in the supreme reality is near on both sides.
items.h: कामक्रोधसे सर्वथा रहित, जीते हुए मनवाले और स्वरूपका साक्षात्कार किये हुए सांख्ययोगियोंके...

items.p: sparshankritva bahirbahyanshchakshushchaivantare bhruvoh pranapanau samau kritva nasabhyantaracharinau
items.e: Leaving outer objects outside, fixing the gaze between the eyebrows, and balancing the inward and outward breaths moving through the nose.
items.h: बाह्य पदार्थोंको बाहर ही छोड़कर और नेत्रोंकी दृष्टिको भौंहोंके बीचमें स्थित करके तथा...

items.p: yatendriyamanobuddhirmunirmokshaparayanah vigatechchhabhayakrodho yah sada mukta eva sah
items.e: One who has controlled the senses, mind, and intellect, who seeks freedom as the highest aim, and who is free from desire, fear, and anger is forever...
items.h: बाह्य पदार्थोंको बाहर ही छोड़कर और नेत्रोंकी दृष्टिको भौंहोंके बीचमें स्थित करके तथा...

items.p: bhoktaram yagyatapasam sarvalokamaheshvaram suhridam sarvabhutanam gyatva mam shantimrichchhati
items.e: Knowing me as the enjoyer of all sacrifice and austerity, the great lord of all worlds, and the friend of all beings, one attains peace.
items.h: भक्त मुझे सब यज्ञों और तपोंका भोक्ता, सम्पूर्ण लोकोंका महान् ईश्वर तथा सम्पूर्ण...

items.s: अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः
items.p: anashritah karmaphalam karyam karma karoti yah sa sannyasi cha yogi cha na niragnirna chakriyah
items.e: One who performs the required action without taking shelter in the fruit of action is a renunciate and a yogi. Not one who merely gives up fire, and...
items.h: फल की आस छोड़कर कर्तव्य करने वाला ही सच्चा संन्यासी और योगी

items.s: यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव
items.p: yam sannyasamiti prahuryogam tam viddhi pandava na hyasannyastasankalpo yogi bhavati kashchana
items.e: Arjuna, what people call renunciation is yoga. No one becomes a yogi without giving up intentions.
items.h: संकल्पों को छोड़े बिना कोई भी योगी नहीं बनता

items.p: arurukshormuneryogam karma karanamuchyate yogarudhasya tasyaiva shamah karanamuchyate
items.e: For the sage who seeks to rise into yoga, action is the means. For the one who has risen in yoga, stillness is the means.
items.h: योग पर चढ़ने का साधन कर्म, पहुँचे हुए का साधन शांति

items.p: yada hi nendriyartheshu na karmasvanushajjate sarvasankalpasannyasi yogarudhastadochyate
items.e: When one no longer clings to sense pleasures or to actions, that person is called established in yoga, having renounced all intentions.
items.h: विषयों और कर्मों में आसक्ति न रहे, तभी योगारूढ़

items.p: uddharedatmanatmanam natmanamavasadayet atmaiva hyatmano bandhuratmaiva ripuratmanah
items.e: Lift yourself by yourself; do not let yourself fall. The true self is its own friend, and the true self is its own enemy.
items.h: अपना उद्धार स्वयं करो, तुम्हीं अपने मित्र और शत्रु

items.p: bandhuratmatmanastasya yenatmaivatmana jitah anatmanastu shatrutve vartetatmaiva shatruvat
items.e: For one who has conquered the lower self by the true self, the true self is a friend. For one who has not conquered the lower self, the true self...
items.h: जिसने अपने को जीता, उसका मन मित्र; नहीं तो शत्रु

items.p: jitatmanah prashantasya paramatma samahitah shitoshnasukhaduhkheshu tatha manapamanayoh
items.e: For one who has conquered the self and is serene, the supreme reality is ever present in heat and cold, pleasure and pain, honor and dishonor.
items.h: जिसने मन जीता, वह गर्मी-सर्दी, मान-अपमान में शांत रहता है
