items.p: gyanavigyanatriptatma kutastho vijitendriyah yukta ityuchyate yogi samaloshtashmakanchanah
items.e: One whose mind is satisfied by knowledge and realization, who remains steady, who has conquered the senses, and who sees clay, stone, and gold alike...
items.h: ज्ञान से तृप्त, अडिग, जितेंद्रिय योगी के लिए मिट्टी और सोना समान

items.p: suhrinmitraryudasinamadhyasthadveshyabandhushu sadhushvapi cha papeshu samabuddhirvishishyate
items.e: The one whose understanding is equal toward friend, enemy, neutral person, mediator, hateful person, relative, the virtuous, and the sinful is...
items.h: मित्र, शत्रु, साधु, पापी, सबमें समबुद्धि रखने वाला श्रेष्ठ

items.p: yogi yunjita satatamatmanam rahasi sthitah ekaki yatachittatma nirashiraparigrahah
items.e: The disciplined yogi, dwelling alone in seclusion, should constantly unite the mind with the supreme being, free from desire and possessiveness, with...
items.h: योगी एकांत में अकेला बैठकर मन को निरंतर परमात्मा में लगाए

items.p: shuchau deshe pratishthapya sthiramasanamatmanah natyuchchhritam natinicham chailajinakushottaram
items.e: Having placed a firm seat for himself on a clean spot, neither too high nor too low, with cloth, deerskin, and kusha grass laid in layers.
items.h: शुद्ध स्थान पर न बहुत ऊँचा, न बहुत नीचा स्थिर आसन बिछाएँ
items.t: dhyana asana meditation setup kusha grass seating

items.p: tatraikagram manah kritva yatachittendriyakriyah upavishyasane yunjyadyogamatmavishuddhaye
items.e: Sitting on that seat, with the mind made one-pointed and the movements of mind and senses restrained, one should practice yoga for inner purification.
items.h: आसन पर बैठकर मन एकाग्र करें, अंतःकरण की शुद्धि के लिए अभ्यास

items.p: samam kayashirogrivam dharayannachalam sthirah samprekshya nasikagram svam dishashchanavalokayan
items.e: Holding the body, head, and neck straight and still, and gazing only at the tip of the nose without looking around.
items.h: शरीर, सिर, गर्दन सीधे और अचल; दृष्टि नासिका के अग्रभाग पर

items.p: prashantatma vigatabhirbrahmacharivrate sthitah manah sanyamya machchitto yukta asita matparah
items.e: The yogi, with a peaceful mind, free of fear, and firm in celibate discipline, restrains the mind, fixes awareness on Me, and sits devoted to Me as...
items.h: शांत, निर्भय, ब्रह्मचर्य में स्थित होकर मन मुझमें लगाकर बैठे

items.p: yunjannevam sadatmanam yogi niyatamanasah shantim nirvanaparamam matsansthamadhigachchhati
items.e: The disciplined yogi, always uniting the mind in this way, attains the supreme peace of freedom rooted in Me.
items.h: निरंतर अभ्यास करने वाला योगी मुझमें स्थित परम शांति पाता है

items.p: natyashnatastu yogosti na chaikantamanashnatah na chatisvapnashilasya jagrato naiva charjuna
items.e: Yoga is not for one who eats too much, nor for one who eats nothing at all. It is not for one who sleeps too much, nor for one who stays awake too...
items.h: बहुत खाने, बिल्कुल न खाने, बहुत सोने या जागने से योग नहीं

items.p: yuktaharaviharasya yuktacheshtasya karmasu yuktasvapnavabodhasya yogo bhavati duhkhaha
items.e: Yoga that destroys suffering comes from balanced eating, balanced activity, balanced work, and balanced sleep and waking.
items.h: संतुलित आहार, विहार, कर्म और नींद से योग दुःख मिटाता है

items.p: yada viniyatam chittamatmanyevavatishthate nihsprihah sarvakamebhyo yukta ityuchyate tada
items.e: When the controlled mind rests in the true self alone and is free from craving for all pleasures, that person is called united in yoga.
items.h: वश में किया चित्त स्वरूप में टिके, कामनाओं से मुक्त, तब योगी

items.s: यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता
items.p: yatha dipo nivatastho nengate sopama smrita yogino yatachittasya yunjato yogamatmanah
items.e: As a lamp in a windless place does not flicker, so the disciplined mind of a yogi does not waver while practicing yoga of the true self.
items.h: वायुरहित स्थान में दीपक की स्थिर लौ जैसा योगी का चित्त

items.p: yatroparamate chittam niruddham yogasevaya yatra chaivatmanatmanam pashyannatmani tushyati
items.e: When the restrained mind becomes still through yoga practice, and the person sees the true self by the true self, one is content in the true self...
items.h: योग से निरुद्ध चित्त शांत होकर अपने में ही संतुष्ट होता है

items.p: sukhamatyantikam yattadbuddhigrahyamatindriyam vetti yatra na chaivayam sthitashchalati tattvatah
items.e: One knows the boundless joy beyond the senses and grasped by the discerning mind; established in it, one never truly falls away.
items.h: इंद्रियों से परे, बुद्धि से ग्राह्य अनंत सुख, जिससे योगी नहीं डिगता

items.s: यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः
items.p: yam labdhva chaparam labham manyate nadhikam tatah yasminsthito na duhkhena gurunapi vichalyate
items.e: Having attained it, one thinks no greater gain exists. Established in it, one is not shaken even by great sorrow.
items.h: जिसे पाकर कोई लाभ बड़ा न लगे, भारी दुःख भी न डिगाए

items.p: tam vidyad duhkhasanyogaviyogam yogasangyitam sa nishchayena yoktavyo yogonirvinnachetasa
items.e: Know that as yoga: the severance of union with suffering. Practice that yoga with certainty, with an undiscouraged mind.
items.h: दुःख के संयोग से वियोग ही योग, इसे बिना ऊबे साधो

items.p: sankalpaprabhavankamanstyaktva sarvanasheshatah manasaivendriyagramam viniyamya samantatah
items.e: Abandon every desire born of resolve, and restrain the whole field of the senses on all sides with the mind alone.
items.h: संकल्प से उपजी सब कामनाएँ छोड़कर, मन से इंद्रियाँ समेटें

items.p: shanaih shanairuparamed buddhya dhritigrihitaya atmasanstham manah kritva na kinchidapi chintayet
items.e: Little by little, the mind should be quieted by steady discernment. Fix the mind in the true self and think of nothing else.
items.h: धैर्ययुक्त बुद्धि से धीरे धीरे उपराम हो, फिर कुछ न सोचे

items.p: yato yato nishcharati manashchanchalamasthiram tatastato niyamyaitadatmanyeva vasham nayet
items.e: Whenever the restless, unsteady mind wanders, bring it back under the control of the true self.
items.h: मन जहाँ जहाँ भटके, वहाँ से लौटाकर परमात्मा में लगाओ

items.p: prashantamanasam hyenam yoginam sukhamuttamam upaiti shantarajasam brahmabhutamakalmasham
items.e: The yogi whose mind is peaceful, whose passion is stilled, and who is free from impurity attains the highest joy.
items.h: शांत मन, शांत रजोगुण वाले निष्पाप योगी को उत्तम सुख मिलता है

items.p: yunjannevam sadatmanam yogi vigatakalmashah sukhena brahmasansparshamatyantam sukhamashnute
items.e: Thus, the disciplined yogi, free from impurity, always unites the self with the supreme reality and attains limitless joy through that contact.
items.h: सदा अभ्यासरत निष्पाप योगी सहज ही ब्रह्म का अनंत सुख पाता है

items.p: sarvabhutasthamatmanam sarvabhutani chatmani ikshate yogayuktatma sarvatra samadarshanah
items.e: The one united in yoga sees the true self in all beings and all beings in the true self, seeing everything with equal vision.
items.h: योगी सबमें अपने को और अपने में सबको देखता है

items.s: यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति
items.p: yo mam pashyati sarvatra sarvam cha mayi pashyati tasyaham na pranashyami sa cha me na pranashyati
items.e: Who sees Me in all beings and sees all beings in Me, I am never lost to that person, and that person is never lost to Me.
items.h: जो सबमें मुझे देखता है, उससे मैं कभी ओझल नहीं होता

items.p: sarvabhutasthitam yo mam bhajatyekatvamasthitah sarvatha vartamanopi sa yogi mayi vartate
items.e: The yogi who abides in unity and worships Me in all beings lives in Me, even while acting in every way.
items.h: एकत्व में स्थित भक्त सब कुछ करते हुए भी मुझमें रहता है
items.t: ekatva bhajana sarvabhutasthita devotional presence meditation in action

items.p: atmaupamyena sarvatra samam pashyati yorjuna sukham va yadi va duhkham sah yogi paramo matah
items.e: O Arjuna, the yogi who sees all beings as equal through the measure of the true self, and sees pleasure and pain alike, is considered the highest...
items.h: जो सबका सुख दुःख अपने जैसा देखे, वही परम योगी

items.p: yoyam yogastvaya proktah samyena madhusudana etasyaham na pashyami chanchalatvat sthitim sthiram
items.e: Arjuna said: Krishna, you have described this yoga as balanced, but I do not see its steady practice, because the mind is restless.
items.h: मन की चंचलता के कारण मुझे इस योग की स्थिरता नहीं दिखती

items.s: चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्दृढम्
items.p: chanchalam hi manah krishna pramathi balavaddridham tasyaham nigraham manye vayoriva sudushkaram
items.e: The mind is restless, turbulent, stubborn, and strong. I think controlling it is as hard as controlling the wind.
items.h: मन चंचल, बलवान और हठी है, इसे रोकना हवा रोकने जैसा

items.p: asanshayam mahabaho mano durnigraham chalam abhyasena tu kaunteya vairagyena cha grihyate
items.e: The mind is hard to control, but it is mastered through practice and detachment.
items.h: मन सचमुच चंचल है, पर अभ्यास और वैराग्य से वश होता है

items.s: असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः
items.p: asanyatatmana yogo dushprapa iti me matih vashyatmana tu yatata shakyovaptumupayatah
items.e: Yoga is hard to attain for one whose mind is not fully controlled. But for one who controls the mind and strives with the right method, it can be...
items.h: असंयमी के लिए योग कठिन, संयमी प्रयत्नशील उपाय से पा सकता है

items.p: ayatih shraddhayopeto yogachchalitamanasah aprapya yogasansiddhim kam gatim krishna gachchhati
items.e: Arjuna said: What happens to a person who has faith but lacks steady effort, whose mind turns away from yoga before full success is reached, O...
items.h: श्रद्धा है पर प्रयत्न ढीला, योग अधूरा रहे तो क्या गति?

items.p: kachchinnobhayavibhrashtashchhinnabhramiva nashyati apratishtho mahabaho vimudho brahmanah pathi
items.e: O mighty-armed one, does a person who has fallen from both sides, like a torn cloud, perish without support, deluded on the path of the supreme...
items.h: दोनों ओर से भटका साधक क्या बिखरे बादल-सा मिट जाता है?

items.p: etanme sanshayam krishna chhettumarhasyasheshatah tvadanyah sanshayasyasya chhetta na hyupapadyate
items.e: O Krishna, only you can fully cut away this doubt. No one else is able to remove it.
items.h: मेरा यह संशय आप ही पूरी तरह मिटा सकते हैं

items.p: partha naiveha namutra vinashastasya vidyate nahi kalyanakritkashchiddurgatim tata gachchhati
items.e: Krishna said: O Partha, there is no destruction for him either here or hereafter. No one who does good ever comes to a bad end, my dear.
items.h: कल्याण करने वाले की न यहाँ, न परलोक में दुर्गति

items.p: prapya punyakritam lokanushitva shashvatih samah shuchinam shrimatam gehe yogabhrashtobhijayate
items.e: The one who falls from yoga reaches the worlds earned by good deeds, dwells there for many long years, and is then born again in the house of the...
items.h: योगभ्रष्ट पुण्यलोकों में रहकर फिर पवित्र श्रीमानों के घर जन्मता है

items.p: athava yoginameva kule bhavati dhimatam etaddhi durlabhataram loke janma yadidrisham
items.e: Or he is born into the family of wise yogis. Such a birth is very rare in this world.
items.h: या वह बुद्धिमान योगियों के कुल में जन्मता है, ऐसा जन्म दुर्लभ

items.p: tatra tam buddhisanyogam labhate paurvadehikam yatate cha tato bhuyah sansiddhau kurunandana
items.e: O son of Kuru, there he effortlessly regains the spiritual understanding from his previous life. Then he strives again, with greater force, toward...
items.h: नए जन्म में पिछली साधना के संस्कार जागते हैं, प्रयत्न फिर शुरू
items.t: yogabhraṣṭa punyakarma previous-life practice buddhisamyooga recovery of discipline

items.p: purvabhyasena tenaiva hriyate hyavashopi sah jigyasurapi yogasya shabdabrahmativartate
items.e: Even against his will, he is drawn onward by that earlier practice. Even the seeker of yoga goes beyond the sound of ritual words.
items.h: पिछला अभ्यास उसे विवश होकर भी परमात्मा की ओर खींच लेता है

items.p: prayatnadyatamanastu yogi sanshuddhakilbishah anekajanmasansiddhastato yati param gatim
items.e: But the yogi who keeps striving with effort, whose impurities have been cleared, and who has been perfected through many births, reaches the highest...
items.h: अनेक जन्मों के प्रयत्न से शुद्ध हुआ योगी परम गति पाता है

items.p: tapasvibhyodhiko yogi gyanibhyopi matodhikah karmibhyashchadhiko yogi tasmadyogi bhavarjuna
items.e: The yogi is greater than ascetics, greater than scholars, and greater than workers. Therefore, Arjuna, become a yogi.
items.h: योगी तपस्वी, ज्ञानी और कर्मी से श्रेष्ठ है; अर्जुन, योगी बनो

items.p: yoginamapi sarvesham madgatenantaratmana shraddhavanbhajate yo mam sa me yuktatamo matah
items.e: Among all yogis, the one who worships me with trust, with the inner self absorbed in me, is considered the most fully united.
items.h: सब योगियों में मुझमें तल्लीन श्रद्धालु भक्त सबसे श्रेष्ठ

items.p: mayyasaktamanah partha yogam yunjanmadashrayah asanshayam samagram mam yatha gyasyasi tachchhrinu
items.e: The Blessed Lord said: Arjuna, fix your mind on Me, take refuge in Me, and practice yoga. Hear how you will know Me fully, without doubt.
items.h: श्रीभगवान् बोले हे पृथानन्दन मुझमें आसक्त मनवाला, मेरे आश्रित होकर योगका अभ्यास करता हुआ...

items.p: gyanam teham savigyanamidam vakshyamyasheshatah yajgyatva neha bhuyonyajgyatavyamavashishyate
items.e: I will reveal to you knowledge together with direct realization in full. Knowing that, nothing more remains to be known here.
items.h: तेरे लिये मैं विज्ञानसहित ज्ञान सम्पूर्णतासे कहूँगा, जिसको जाननेके बाद फिर यहाँ कुछ भी...

items.p: manushyanam sahasreshu kashchidyatati siddhaye yatatamapi siddhanam kashchinmam vetti tattvatah
items.e: Among thousands of people, one may strive for perfection; among those striving, one may know Me in truth.
items.h: हजारों मनुष्योंमें कोई एक वास्तविक सिद्धिके लिये यत्न करता है और उन यत्न करनेवाले...

items.s: भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च
items.p: bhumiraponalo vayuh kham mano buddhireva cha ahankara itiyam me bhinna prakritirashtadha
items.e: Earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intellect, and ego: this is My eightfold lower nature.
items.h: पृथ्वी, जल, तेज, वायु, आकाश ये पञ्चमहाभूत और मन, बुद्धि तथा अहंकार यह आठ प्रकारके...

items.p: apareyamitastvanyam prakritim viddhi me param jivabhutam mahabaho yayedam dharyate jagat
items.e: Know My higher nature, which is different from this lower nature, O mighty-armed one. By that living nature, this world is sustained.
items.h: पृथ्वी, जल, तेज, वायु, आकाश ये पञ्चमहाभूत और मन, बुद्धि तथा अहंकार यह आठ प्रकारके...

items.p: etadyonini bhutani sarvanityupadharaya aham kritsnasya jagatah prabhavah pralayastatha
items.e: Know that all beings are born from these two natures. I am the source and the dissolution of the entire universe.
items.h: अपरा और परा इन दोनों प्रकृतियोंके संयोगसे ही सम्पूर्ण प्राणी उत्पन्न होते हैं, ऐसा तुम...

items.p: mattah parataram nanyatkinchidasti dhananjaya mayi sarvamidam protam sutre manigana iva
items.e: O Dhananjaya, nothing exists higher than Me. All this world is strung on Me like pearls on a thread.
items.h: हे धनञ्जय मेरे बढ़कर इस जगत् का दूसरा कोई किञ्चिन्मात्र भी कारण नहीं है । जैसे सूतकी...
items.t: parama-prakriti vibhuti cosmic unity krishna as support thread and beads

items.p: rasohamapsu kaunteya prabhasmi shashisuryayoh pranavah sarvavedeshu shabdah khe paurusham nrishu
items.e: O son of Kunti, I am the taste in water, the light in the moon and sun, the syllable Om in all the Vedas, the sound in space, and the valor in human...
items.h: हे कुन्तीनन्दन जलोंमें रस मैं हूँ, चन्द्रमा और सूर्यमें प्रभा प्रकाश मैं हूँ, सम्पूर्ण...

items.s: पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ
items.p: punyo gandhah prithivyam cha tejashchasmi vibhavasau jivanam sarvabhuteshu tapashchasmi tapasvishu
items.e: I am the pure fragrance in the earth, the radiance in fire, the life in all beings, and the austerity in ascetics.
items.h: पृथ्वीमें पवित्र गन्ध मैं हूँ, और अग्निमें तेज मैं हूँ, तथा सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंमें...

items.s: बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम्
items.p: bijam mam sarvabhutanam viddhi partha sanatanam buddhirbuddhimatamasmi tejastejasvinamaham
items.e: Know Me, O Partha, as the eternal seed of all beings. I am the intelligence of the intelligent and the brilliance of the brilliant.
items.h: हे पृथानन्दन सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंका अनादि बीज मुझे जान । बुद्धिमानोंमें बुद्धि और...

items.p: balam balavatamasmi kamaragavivarjitam dharmaviruddho bhuteshu kamosmi bharatarshabha
items.e: Among the strong, I am strength free from desire and attachment. In beings, I am desire that does not oppose dharma, O best of the Bharatas.
items.h: हे भरतवंशियोंमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुन बलवालोंमें काम और रागसे रहित बल मैं हूँ । मनुषयोंमें...

items.s: ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये
items.p: ye chaiva sattvika bhava rajasastamasashcha ye matta eveti tanviddhi natvaham teshu te mayi
items.e: Know that all states of being—sattvic, rajasic, and tamasic—arise from Me. I am not in them; they are in Me.
items.h: और तो क्या कहूँ जितने भी सात्त्विक, राजस और तामस भाव हैं, वे सब मुझ से ही होते हैं ऐसा...

items.p: tribhirgunamayairbhavairebhih sarvamidam jagat mohitam nabhijanati mamebhyah paramavyayam
items.e: Deluded by these three qualities, the whole world does not know me, who am beyond them and imperishable.
items.h: किन्तु इन तीनों गुणरूप भावोंसे मोहित यह सब जगत् इन गुणोंसे अतीत अविनाशी मुझे नहीं जानता ॥

items.s: दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया
items.p: daivi hyesha gunamayi mama maya duratyaya mameva ye prapadyante mayametam taranti te
items.e: My divine illusion, made of the three qualities, is hard to cross. Only those who take refuge in Me go beyond it.
items.h: क्योंकि मेरी यह गुणमयी दैवी माया बड़ी दुरत्यय है अर्थात् इससे पार पाना बड़ा कठिन है । जो...

items.s: न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः
items.p: na mam dushkritino mudhah prapadyante naradhamah mayayapahritagyana asuram bhavamashritah
items.e: The deluded, the lowest among people, the wrongdoers, and those whose understanding has been stolen by the veil do not turn to me. They take refuge...
items.h: मायाके द्वारा अपहृत ज्ञानवाले, आसुर भावका आश्रय लेनेवाले और मनुष्योंमें महान् नीच तथा...

items.p: chaturvidha bhajante mam janah sukritinorjuna arto jigyasurartharthi gyani cha bharatarshabha
items.e: Four kinds of virtuous people worship Me, Arjuna: the distressed, the seeker of knowledge, the seeker of wealth, and the wise one, O best of the...
items.h: हे भरतवंशियोंमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुनव पवित्र कर्म करनेवाले अर्थार्थी, आर्त, जिज्ञासु और ज्ञानी...

items.p: tesham gyani nityayukta ekabhaktirvishishyate priyo hi gyaninotyarthamaham sa cha mama priyah
items.e: Among those four, the wise devotee who is ever united and one-pointed is श्रेष्ठ. For I am exceedingly dear to the wise one, and the wise one is dear...
items.h: उन चार भक्तोंमें मेरेमें निरन्तर लगा हुआ, अनन्यभक्तिवाला ज्ञानी अर्थात् प्रेमी भक्त...

items.s: उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम्
items.p: udarah sarva evaite gyani tvatmaiva me matam asthitah sa hi yuktatma mamevanuttamam gatim
items.e: All these are noble indeed, but the wise devotee is My very self. Established in yoga, that person is steadfast in Me as the unsurpassed goal.
items.h: पहले कहे हुए सबकेसब भक्त बड़े उदार श्रेष्ठ भाववाले हैं । परन्तु ज्ञानी प्रेमी तो मेरा...

items.p: bahunam janmanamante gyanavanmam prapadyate vasudevah sarvamiti sa mahatma sudurlabhah
items.e: After many births, the wise one surrenders to Me, knowing that Vasudeva is everything. Such a great soul is very rare.
items.h: बहुत जन्मोंके अन्तमें अर्थात् मनुष्यजन्ममें सब कुछ परमात्मा ही है, ऐसा जो ज्ञानवान् मेरे...
items.t: vasudeva prapatti mahात्मa sarvam iti jnana-bhakti

items.p: kamaistaistairhritagyanah prapadyantenyadevatah tam tam niyamamasthaya prakritya niyatah svaya
items.e: Driven by desire, people whose understanding has been taken away turn to other radiant beings. They follow the rules of each, shaped by their own...
items.h: उनउन कामनाओंसे जिनका ज्ञान अपहृत हो गया है, ऐसे वे मनुष्य अपनीअपनी प्रकृतिसे नियन्त्रित...

items.s: यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति
items.p: yo yo yam yam tanum bhaktah shraddhayarchitumichchhati tasya tasyachalam shraddham tameva vidadhamyaham
items.e: Whatever form a devotee wants to worship with faith, I make that faith firm in that very form.
items.h: जोजो भक्त जिसजिस देवताका श्रद्धापूर्वक पूजन करना चाहता है, उसउस देवताके प्रति मैं उसकी...

items.p: sa taya shraddhaya yuktastasyaradhanamihate labhate cha tatah kamanmayaiva vihitan hi tan
items.e: Endowed with that faith, that person seeks that worship, and receives those desires, granted by Me alone.
items.h: उस मेरे द्वारा दृढ़ की हुई श्रद्धासे युक्त होकर वह मनुष्य सकामभावपूर्वक उस देवताकी उपासना...

items.p: antavattu phalam tesham tadbhavatyalpamedhasam devandevayajo yanti madbhakta yanti mamapi
items.e: But the reward gained by those of limited understanding is finite. Those who worship the radiant beings go to the radiant beings; my devotees come to...
items.h: परन्तु उन अल्पबुद्धिवाले मनुष्योंको उन देवताओंकी आराधनाका फल अन्तवाला नाशवान् ही मिलता है...

items.p: avyaktam vyaktimapannam manyante mamabuddhayah param bhavamajananto mamavyayamanuttamam
items.e: The unwise think I have taken a visible form from the unseen. They do not know my imperishable, supreme nature.
items.h: बुद्धिहीन मनुष्य मेरे सर्वश्रेष्ठ अविनाशी परमभावको न जानते हुए अव्यक्त मनइन्द्रियोंसे पर...

items.p: naham prakashah sarvasya yogamayasamavritah mudhoyam nabhijanati loko mamajamavyayam
items.e: Veiled by yoga-maya, I am not visible to everyone. Deluded people do not recognize me as unborn and imperishable.
items.h: जो मूढ़ मनुष्य मेरेको अज और अविनाशी ठीक तरहसे नहीं जानते मानते, उन सबके सामने योगमायासे...

items.p: vedaham samatitani vartamanani charjuna bhavishyani cha bhutani mam tu veda na kashchana
items.e: Arjuna, I know all beings of the past, the present, and the future. No one knows me.
items.h: हे अर्जुन जो प्राणी भूतकालमें हो चुके हैं, तथा जो वर्तमानमें हैं और जो भविष्यमें होंगे...

items.p: ichchhadveshasamutthena dvandvamohena bharata sarvabhutani sammoham sarge yanti parantapa
items.e: O descendant of Bharata, all beings fall into delusion at birth, from the confusion born of desire and aversion, O scorcher of foes.
items.h: हे भरतवंशमें उत्पन्न परंतप इच्छा राग और द्वेषसे उत्पन्न होनेवाले द्वन्द्वमोहसे मोहित...

items.p: yesham tvantagatam papam jananam punyakarmanam te dvandvamohanirmukta bhajante mam dridhavratah
items.e: But those whose wrongdoing has been cleared away, and whose good deeds have matured, are freed from confusion and worship me with firm resolve.
items.h: परन्तु जिन पुण्यकर्मा मनुष्योंके पाप नष्ट गये हैं, वे द्वन्द्वमोहसे रहित हुए मनुष्य...

items.p: jaramaranamokshaya mamashritya yatanti ye te brahma tadviduh kritsnamadhyatmam karma chakhilam
items.e: Those who, seeking release from old age and death, take refuge in me, come to know Brahman, the whole field of the inner life, and all action.
items.h: जरा वृद्धावस्था और मरण मृत्यु से मोक्ष पानेके लिये जो मेरा आश्रय लेकर प्रयत्न करते हैं...

items.s: साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः
items.p: sadhibhutadhidaivam mam sadhiyagyam cha ye viduh prayanakalepi cha mam te viduryuktachetasah
items.e: Those who know me together with the physical realm, the radiant powers, and the inner sacrifice know me even at the time of death.
items.h: जो मनुष्य अधिभूत, अधिदैव और अधियज्ञके सहित मुझे जानते हैं, वे युक्तचेता मनुष्य अन्तकालमें...

items.s: किं तद्ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम
items.p: kim tadbrahma kimadhyatmam kim karma purushottama adhibhutam cha kim proktamadhidaivam kimuchyate
items.e: Arjuna said: O Supreme Person, what is Brahman? What is the self? What is action? What is called the field of changing things, and what is called the...
items.h: अर्जुन बोले हे पुरुषोत्तम वह ब्रह्म क्या है अध्यात्म क्या है कर्म क्या है अधिभूत किसको...

items.p: adhiyagyah katham kotra dehesminmadhusudana prayanakale cha katham gyeyosi niyatatmabhih
items.e: Arjuna said: O Madhusudana, who is the sacrifice here, and how does he dwell in this body? And at the time of death, how are you known by those with...
items.h: अर्जुन बोले हे पुरुषोत्तम वह ब्रह्म क्या है अध्यात्म क्या है कर्म क्या है अधिभूत किसको...

items.p: aksharam brahma paramam svabhavodhyatmamuchyate bhutabhavodbhavakaro visargah karmasangyitah
items.e: The imperishable is the supreme reality. One's own nature is called the inner self. The offering that brings beings into existence is called action.
items.h: श्रीभगवान् बोले परम अक्षर ब्रह्म है और जीवका अपना जो होनापन है, उसको अध्यात्म कहते हैं...

items.p: adhibhutam ksharo bhavah purushashchadhidaivatam adhiyagyohamevatra dehe dehabhritam vara
items.e: The perishable world is the lower realm; the cosmic person is the radiant being. I am the inner witness of sacrifice in this body, Arjuna.
items.h: हे देहधारियोंमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुन क्षरभाव अर्थात् नाशवान् पदार्थको अधिभूत कहते हैं, पुरुष...

items.p: antakale cha mameva smaranmuktva kalevaram yah prayati sa madbhavam yati nastyatra sanshayah
items.e: Whoever remembers Me at the end and leaves the body attains My state; there is no doubt.
items.h: जो मनुष्य अन्तकालमें भी मेरा स्मरण करते हुए शरीर छोड़कर जाता है, वह मेरे स्वरुप को ही...

items.s: यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम्
items.p: yam yam vapi smaranbhavam tyajatyante kalevaram tam tamevaiti kaunteya sada tadbhavabhavitah
items.e: Whatever state a person remembers at the end, that state is reached, because the mind has been shaped by it.
items.h: हे कुन्तीपुत्र अर्जुन मनुष्य अन्तकाल में जिसजिस भी भावका स्मरण करते हुए शरीर छोड़ता है वह...

items.p: tasmatsarveshu kaleshu mamanusmara yudhya cha mayyarpitamanobuddhirmamevaishyasyasanshayam
items.e: Therefore, remember Me at all times and fight. With mind and intellect offered to Me, you will surely come to Me.
items.h: इसलिये तू सब समयमें मेरा स्मरण कर और युद्ध भी कर । मेरेमें मन और बुद्धि अर्पित करनेवाला...

items.p: abhyasayogayuktena chetasa nanyagamina paramam purusham divyam yati parthanuchintayan
items.e: One who departs while remembering the divine person with a mind trained by practice and fixed on nothing else reaches that supreme divine being, O...
items.h: हे पृथानन्दन अभ्यासयोगसे युक्त और अन्यका चिन्तन न करनेवाले चित्तसे परम दिव्य पुरुषका...

items.p: kavim puranamanushasitaramanoraniyansamanusmaredyah sarvasya dhataramachintyarupamadityavarnam tamasah parastat
items.e: Whoever remembers the wise, ancient, ruler, subtler than the subtle, supporter of all, beyond thought, radiant like the sun, and beyond darkness...
items.h: जो सर्वज्ञ, पुराण, शासन करनेवाला, सूक्ष्मसेसूक्ष्म, सबका धारणपोषण करनेवाला, अज्ञानसे...

items.p: prayanakale manasachalenabhaktya yukto yogabalena chaiva bhruvormadhye pranamaveshya samyaksa tam param purushamupaiti divyam
items.e: At the time of departure, one who leaves the body with an unmoving mind, devotion, and the power of yoga, placing the life-force between the...
items.h: वह भक्तियुक्त मनुष्य अन्तसमयमें अचल मनसे और योगबलके द्वारा भृकुटीके मध्यमें प्राणोंको...

items.p: yadaksharam vedavido vadantivishanti yadyatayo vitaragah yadichchhanto brahmacharyam charantitatte padam sangrahena pravakshye
items.e: I will briefly tell you that imperishable state, which the knowers of the Vedas call imperishable, which the detached ascetics enter, and which...
items.h: वेदवेत्ता लोग जिसको अक्षर कहते हैं, वीतराग यति जिसको प्राप्त करते हैं और साधक जिसकी...

items.s: सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च
items.p: sarvadvarani sanyamya mano hridi nirudhya cha murdhnyadhayatmanah pranamasthito yogadharanam
items.e: Closing all the doors of the senses, holding the mind in the heart, and placing the life-force in the head, one remains fixed in yoga-discipline.
items.h: इन्द्रियोंके सम्पूर्ण द्वारोंको रोककर मनका हृदयमें निरोध करके और अपने प्राणोंको मस्तकमें...

items.p: omityekaksharam brahma vyaharanmamanusmaran yah prayati tyajandeham sa yati paramam gatim
items.e: Uttering Om, the one-syllable Brahman, and remembering Me, one who departs while leaving the body attains the supreme state.
items.h: इन्द्रियोंके सम्पूर्ण द्वारोंको रोककर मनका हृदयमें निरोध करके और अपने प्राणोंको मस्तकमें...

items.s: अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः
items.p: ananyachetah satatam yo mam smarati nityashah tasyaham sulabhah partha nityayuktasya yoginah
items.e: Arjuna, for the one whose mind is wholly on me and who remembers me constantly, I am easy to reach.
items.h: हे पृथानन्दन अनन्यचित्तवाला जो मनुष्य मेरा नित्यनिरन्तर स्मरण करता है, उस नित्ययुक्त...

items.p: mamupetya punarjanma duhkhalayamashashvatam napnuvanti mahatmanah sansiddhim paramam gatah
items.e: Great souls who reach me do not return to this painful, temporary cycle of birth.
items.h: महात्मालोग मुझे प्राप्त करके दुःखालय और अशाश्वत पुनर्जन्मको प्राप्त नहीं होते क्योंकि वे...

items.p: abrahmabhuvanallokah punaravartinorjuna mamupetya tu kaunteya punarjanma na vidyate
items.e: All worlds up to Brahma's realm return again, Arjuna. But having reached me, O son of Kunti, there is no rebirth.
items.h: हे अर्जुन ब्रह्मलोकतक सभी लोक पुनरावर्ती है परन्तु हे कौन्तेय मुझे प्राप्त होनेपर...

items.p: sahasrayugaparyantamaharyadbrahmano viduh ratrim yugasahasrantam tehoratravido janah
items.e: Those who know that Brahma’s day lasts a thousand yugas, and his night lasts a thousand yugas, know day and night truly.
items.h: जो मनुष्य ब्रह्माके एक हज़ार चतुर्युगीवाले एक दिनको और सहस्त्र चतुर्युगीपर्यन्त एक रातको...

items.p: avyaktadvyaktayah sarvah prabhavantyaharagame ratryagame praliyante tatraivavyaktasangyake
items.e: At the start of Brahma's day, all beings arise from the unmanifest; at the start of Brahma's night, they dissolve back into that same unmanifest.
items.h: ब्रह्माजीके दिनके आरम्भकालमें अव्यक्त ब्रह्माजीके सूक्ष्मशरीर से सम्पूर्ण प्राणी पैदा...

items.s: भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते
items.p: bhutagramah sa evayam bhutva bhutva praliyate ratryagamevashah partha prabhavatyaharagame
items.e: O Arjuna, this entire group of beings is born again and again, and is dissolved at the coming of night; at the coming of day, it rises again...
items.h: हे पार्थ वही यह प्राणिसमुदाय उत्पन्न होहोकर प्रकृतिके परवश हुआ ब्रह्माके दिनके समय...

items.p: parastasmattu bhavonyovyaktovyaktatsanatanah yah sa sarveshu bhuteshu nashyatsu na vinashyati
items.e: Beyond that unmanifest is another, eternal unmanifest. Even when all beings perish, it does not perish.
items.h: परन्तु उस अव्यक्त ब्रह्माजीके सूक्ष्मशरीर से अन्य अनादि सर्वश्रेष्ठ भावरूप जो अव्यक्त है...
items.t: akshara avyakta sanatana imperishable cosmic dissolution

items.p: avyaktokshara ityuktastamahuh paramam gatim yam prapya na nivartante taddhama paramam mama
items.e: That is called the unmanifest and the imperishable. It is the highest goal. Having reached it, one does not return. It is my supreme abode.
items.h: उसीको अव्यक्त और अक्षर कहा गया है और उसीको परमगति कहा गया है तथा जिसको प्राप्त होनेपर जीव...

items.s: पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया
items.p: purushah sa parah partha bhaktya labhyastvananyaya yasyantahsthani bhutani yena sarvamidam tatam
items.e: O Arjuna, the supreme person is reached through undivided devotion. All beings dwell within that being, and this entire world is pervaded by that...
items.h: हे पृथानन्दन अर्जुन सम्पूर्ण प्राणी जिसके अन्तर्गत हैं और जिससे यह सम्पूर्ण संसार व्याप्त...

items.p: yatra kale tvanavrittimavrittim chaiva yoginah prayata yanti tam kalam vakshyami bharatarshabha
items.e: I will tell you of the time when yogis do not return, and the time when they do, O best of the Bharatas.
items.h: हे भरतवंशियोंमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुन जिस काल अर्थात् मार्गमें शरीर छोड़कर गये हुए योगी...

items.p: agnirjyotirahah shuklah shanmasa uttarayanam tatra prayata gachchhanti brahma brahmavido janah
items.e: Fire, daylight, the bright fortnight, and the six months of the northward course: those who depart then, knowing the supreme reality, go to the...
items.h: जिस मार्गमें प्रकाशस्वरूप अग्निका अधिपति देवता, दिनका अधिपति देवता, शुक्लपक्षका अधिपति...

items.p: dhumo ratristatha krishnah shanmasa dakshinayanam tatra chandramasam jyotiryogi prapya nivartate
items.e: In the path ruled by smoke, night, the dark fortnight, and the six months of the southern course, the yogi who departs there returns after reaching...
items.h: जिस मार्गमें धूमका अधिपति देवता, रात्रिका अधिपति देवता, कृष्णपक्षका अधिपति देवता और छः...

items.s: शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते
items.p: shuklakrishne gati hyete jagatah shashvate mate ekaya yatyanavrittimanyayavartate punah
items.e: The bright and the dark are the two eternal paths of the world. One leads to non-return; the other brings return again.
items.h: क्योंकि शुक्ल और कृष्ण ये दोनों गतियाँ अनादिकालसे जगत्प्राणिमात्र के साथ सम्बन्ध रखनेवाली...

items.s: नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन
items.p: naite sriti partha jananyogi muhyati kashchana tasmatsarveshu kaleshu yogayukto bhavarjuna
items.e: O Arjuna, the yogi who knows these two paths is never deluded. Therefore, remain steadfast in yoga at all times.
items.h: हे पृथानन्दन इन दोनों मार्गोंको जाननेवाला कोई भी योगी मोहित नहीं होता । अतः हे अर्जुन तू...

items.s: वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैवदानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम्
items.p: vedeshu yagyeshu tapahsu chaivadaneshu yatpunyaphalam pradishtam atyeti tatsarvamidam viditvayogi param sthanamupaiti chadyam
items.e: Knowing the two paths, the yogi goes beyond all the merits declared in the Vedas, sacrifices, austerities, and gifts, and reaches the primal supreme...
items.h: योगी इसको शुक्ल और कृष्णमार्गके रहस्यको जानकर वेदोंमें, यज्ञोंमें, तपोंमें तथा दानमें...

items.p: idam tu te guhyatamam pravakshyamyanasuyave gyanam vigyanasahitam yajgyatva mokshyaseshubhat
items.e: The Blessed Lord said: I will now tell you this most secret knowledge, joined with direct realization, to you who are not envious. Knowing it, you...
items.h: श्रीभगवान् बोले यह अत्यन्त गोपनीय विज्ञानसहित ज्ञान दोषदृष्टिरहित तेरे लिये तो मैं फिर...

items.p: rajavidya rajaguhyam pavitramidamuttamam pratyakshavagamam dharmyam susukham kartumavyayam
items.e: This is the king of all knowledge, the king of all secrets. It is supremely pure, directly knowable, aligned with dharma, easy to practice, and...
items.h: यह सम्पूर्ण विद्याओंका और सम्पूर्ण गोपनीयोंका राजा है । यह अति पवित्र तथा अतिश्रेष्ठ है...

items.p: ashraddadhanah purusha dharmasyasya parantapa aprapya mam nivartante mrityusansaravartmani
items.e: O conqueror of foes, people without trust in this dharma do not reach Me and keep returning on the path of repeated death and rebirth.
items.h: हे परंतप इस धर्मकी महिमापर श्रद्धा न रखनेवाले मनुष्य मेरे प्राप्त न होकर मृत्युरूप...

items.p: maya tatamidam sarvam jagadavyaktamurtina matsthani sarvabhutani na chaham teshvavasthitah
items.e: All this universe is pervaded by my unmanifest form. All beings dwell in me, but I do not dwell in them.
items.h: यह सब संसार मेरे निराकार स्वरूपसे व्याप्त है । सम्पूर्ण प्राणी मेरेमें स्थित हैं परन्तु...

items.s: न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्
items.p: na cha matsthani bhutani pashya me yogamaishvaram bhutabhrinna cha bhutastho mamatma bhutabhavanah
items.e: Behold My divine power: beings are not in Me, and yet I sustain all beings.
items.h: यह सब संसार मेरे निराकार स्वरूपसे व्याप्त है । सम्पूर्ण प्राणी मुझ में स्थित हैं परन्तु...

items.p: yathakashasthito nityam vayuh sarvatrago mahan tatha sarvani bhutani matsthanityupadharaya
items.e: As the great wind, moving everywhere, always rests in space, so all beings rest in Me.
items.h: जैसे सब जगह विचरनेवाली महान् वायु नित्य ही आकाशमें स्थित रहती है, ऐसे ही सम्पूर्ण प्राणी...

items.p: sarvabhutani kaunteya prakritim yanti mamikam kalpakshaye punastani kalpadau visrijamyaham
items.e: O son of Kunti, at the end of a cosmic cycle all beings enter my nature; at its beginning, I send them forth again.
items.h: हे कुन्तीनन्दन कल्पोंका क्षय होनेपर सम्पूर्ण प्राणी मेरी प्रकृतिको प्राप्त होते हैं और...

items.p: prakritim svamavashtabhya visrijami punah punah bhutagramamimam kritsnamavasham prakritervashat
items.e: Taking hold of my own nature, I repeatedly create this entire multitude of beings, helpless under the sway of nature.
items.h: प्रकृतिके वशमें होनेसे परतन्त्र हुए इस सम्पूर्ण प्राणिसमुदायको मैं कल्पोंके आदिमें अपनी...

items.s: न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय
items.p: na cha mam tani karmani nibadhnanti dhananjaya udasinavadasinamasaktam teshu karmasu
items.e: Those actions of creation do not bind me, Dhananjaya, because I remain detached and indifferent to them.
items.h: हे धनञ्जय उन सृष्टिरचना आदि कर्मोंमें अनासक्त और उदासीनकी तरह रहते हुए मेरेको वे कर्म...

items.p: mayadhyakshena prakritih suyate sacharacharam hetunanena kaunteya jagadviparivartate
items.e: Nature, under my supervision, brings forth all moving and unmoving beings. Because of this, the world keeps changing, O son of Kunti.
items.h: प्रकृति मेरी अध्यक्षतामें सम्पूर्ण चराचर जगत् को रचती है । हे कुन्तीनन्दन इसी हेतुसे जगत्...
items.t: prakriti omnipresence divine oversight cosmic order chapter 9

items.p: avajananti mam mudha manushim tanumashritam param bhavamajananto mama bhutamaheshvaram
items.e: Fools despise Me when I dwell in a human form, not knowing My higher nature as the great Lord of all beings.
items.h: मूर्खलोग मेरे सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके महान् ईश्वररूप परमभावको न जानते हुए मुझे मनुष्यशरीरके...

items.p: moghasha moghakarmano moghagyana vichetasah rakshasimasurim chaiva prakritim mohinim shritah
items.e: Those whose hopes, actions, and understanding are all wasted, confused minds take shelter in deluding, demonic, and shadowy nature.
items.h: जिनकी सब आशाएँ व्यर्थ होती हैं, सब शुभकर्म व्यर्थ होते हैं और सब ज्ञान व्यर्थ होते हैं...

items.p: mahatmanastu mam partha daivim prakritimashritah bhajantyananyamanaso gyatva bhutadimavyayam
items.e: But, Arjuna, the great-minded ones, relying on the divine nature, worship Me with one-pointed minds, knowing Me as the unborn and imperishable source...
items.h: परन्तु हे पृथानन्दन दैवी प्रकृतिके आश्रित अनन्यमनवाले महात्मालोग मुझे सम्पूर्ण...

items.p: satatam kirtayanto mam yatantashcha dridhavratah namasyantashcha mam bhaktya nityayukta upasate
items.e: Ever united with Me, steadfast in vows, they worship Me by chanting, striving, and bowing with devotion.
items.h: नित्य मेरेमें युक्त मनुष्य दृढ़व्रती होकर लगनपूर्वक साधनमें लगे हुए और भक्तिपूर्वक कीर्तन...

items.p: gyanayagyena chapyanye yajanto mamupasate ekatvena prithaktvena bahudha vishvatomukham
items.e: Others worship Me through the sacrifice of knowledge, seeing Me as one, as separate, or as the all-facing form.
items.h: दूसरे साधक ज्ञानयज्ञके द्वारा एकीभावसे अभेदभावसे मेरा पूजन करते हुए मेरी उपासना करते हैं...

items.p: aham kraturaham yagyah svadhahamahamaushadham mantrohamahamevajyamahamagniraham hutam
items.e: I am the sacrifice, I am the ritual, I am the offering, I am the herb, I am the mantra, I am the ghee, I am the fire, and I am the act of offering. I...
items.h: क्रतु मैं हूँ, यज्ञ मैं हूँ, स्वधा मैं हूँ, औषध मैं हूँ, मन्त्र मैं हूँ, घृत मैं हूँ...

items.p: pitahamasya jagato mata dhata pitamahah vedyam pavitramonkara rik sama yajureva cha
items.e: I am the father of this world, the mother, the supporter, and the grandfather. I am the object of knowledge, the purifier, the sacred syllable Om...
items.h: क्रतु मैं हूँ, यज्ञ मैं हूँ, स्वधा मैं हूँ, औषध मैं हूँ, मन्त्र मैं हूँ, घृत मैं हूँ...

items.s: गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत्
items.p: gatirbharta prabhuh sakshi nivasah sharanam suhrit prabhavah pralayah sthanam nidhanam bijamavyayam
items.e: I am the goal, the supporter, the lord, the witness, the refuge, the friend, the source, the dissolution, the resting place, the treasure, and the...
items.h: क्रतु मैं हूँ, यज्ञ मैं हूँ, स्वधा मैं हूँ, औषध मैं हूँ, मन्त्र मैं हूँ, घृत मैं हूँ...

items.p: tapamyahamaham varsham nigrihnamyutsrijami cha amritam chaiva mrityushcha sadasachchahamarjuna
items.e: I heat the world as the sun, I hold back the rain and send it forth. I am immortality and death, being and non-being, Arjuna.
items.h: हे अर्जुन संसारके हितके लिये मैं ही सूर्यरूपसे तपता हूँ, जलको ग्रहण करता हूँ और फिर उस...
items.t: vibhuti divine omnipresence rain sun amrita

items.s: त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापायज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते
items.p: traividya mam somapah putapapayagyairishtva svargatim prarthayante te punyamasadya surendralokamashnanti divyandivi devabhogan

items.s: ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालंक्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति
items.p: te tam bhuktva svargalokam vishalankshine punye martyalokam vishanti eva trayidharmamanuprapannagatagatam kamakama labhante
items.e: After enjoying the vast heaven-world, they return to the mortal world when their merit is exhausted. Thus, those who follow the ritual path of the...
items.h: वे उस विशाल स्वर्गलोकके भोगोंको भोगकर पुण्य क्षीण होनेपर मृत्युलोकमें आ जाते हैं । इस...

items.p: ananyashchintayanto mam ye janah paryupasate tesham nityabhiyuktanam yogakshemam vahamyaham
items.e: Those who think of me alone and worship me with unwavering focus—I carry their welfare and security.
items.h: जो अनन्य भक्त मेरा चिन्तन करते हुए मेरी उपासना करते हैं, मेरेमें निरन्तर लगे हुए उन...
items.a: ananyas chintayanto mam | yogakshemam vahamyaham | ananyas chintayanto | ananyashchintayanto

items.p: yepyanyadevata bhakta yajante shraddhayanvitah tepi mameva kaunteya yajantyavidhipurvakam
items.e: Even those who, filled with trust, worship other radiant beings, worship Me alone, but in the wrong way, O son of Kunti.
items.h: हे कुन्तीनन्दन जो भी भक्त मनुष्य श्रद्धापूर्वक अन्य देवताओंका पूजन करते हैं, वे भी करते...

items.s: अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च
items.p: aham hi sarvayagyanam bhokta cha prabhureva cha na tu mamabhijananti tattvenatashchyavanti te
items.e: For I am the enjoyer and lord of all sacrifices. But those people do not know me in truth, and so they fall away.
items.h: क्योंकि मैं ही सम्पूर्ण यज्ञोंका भोक्ता और स्वामी भी हूँ परन्तु वे मेरेको तत्त्वसे नहीं...

items.p: yanti devavrata devan pitrinyanti pitrivratah bhutani yanti bhutejya yanti madyajinopi mam
items.e: Those devoted to the radiant beings reach the radiant beings. Those devoted to the ancestors reach the ancestors. Those devoted to spirits reach the...
items.h: सकामभावसे देवताओंका पूजन करनेवाले शरीर छोड़नेपर देवताओंको प्राप्त होते हैं । पितरोंका...

items.s: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति
items.p: patram pushpam phalam toyam yo me bhaktya prayachchhati tadaham bhaktyupahritamashnami prayatatmanah
items.e: Whoever offers me a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or water with devotion, I accept that devoted offering from the pure-hearted.
items.h: जो भक्त पत्र, पुष्प, फल, जल आदि यथासाध्य प्राप्त वस्तु को भक्तिपूर्वक मेरे अर्पण करता है...

items.p: yatkaroshi yadashnasi yajjuhoshi dadasi yat yattapasyasi kaunteya tatkurushva madarpanam
items.e: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer, whatever you give, and whatever austerity you practice, offer it to me.
items.h: हे कुन्तीपुत्र तू जो कुछ करता है, जो कुछ खाता है, जो कुछ यज्ञ करता है, जो कुछ दान देता है...
items.t: madarpanam offering bhakti daily action austerity

items.p: shubhashubhaphalairevam mokshyase karmabandhanaih sannyasayogayuktatma vimukto mamupaishyasi
items.e: In this way, you will be freed from the bonds of action and its results. Given over to renunciation-yoga, released, you will come to me.
items.h: इस प्रकार मेरे अर्पण करनेसे जिनसे कर्मबन्धन होता है, ऐसे शुभ विहित और अशुभ निषिद्ध...

items.s: समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः
items.p: samoham sarvabhuteshu na me dveshyosti na priyah ye bhajanti tu mam bhaktya mayi te teshu chapyaham
items.e: I am equal toward all beings. No one is hated by me, and no one is especially dear. But those who worship me with devotion dwell in me, and I dwell...
items.h: मैं सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंमें समान हूँ । उन प्राणियोंमें न तो कोई मेरा द्वेषी है और न कोई...

items.p: api chetsuduracharo bhajate mamananyabhak sadhureva sa mantavyah samyagvyavasito hi sah
items.e: Even if a person of very bad conduct worships Me with undivided devotion, that person must be regarded as righteous, for the resolve is rightly made.
items.h: अगर कोई दुराचारीसेदुराचारी भी अनन्यभावसे मेरा भजन करता है, तो उसको साधु ही मानना चाहिये...

items.p: kshipram bhavati dharmatma shashvachchhantim nigachchhati kaunteya pratijanihi na me bhaktah pranashyati
items.e: One who is devoted to Me quickly becomes righteous and attains lasting peace. O son of Kunti, declare it boldly: My devotee never perishes.
items.h: वह तत्काल उसी क्षण धर्मात्मा हो जाता है और निरन्तर रहनेवाली शान्तिको प्राप्त हो जाता है...

items.s: मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः
items.p: mam hi partha vyapashritya yepi syuh papayonayah striyo vaishyastatha shudrastepi yanti param gatim
items.e: O Partha, even those born in difficult circumstances, and women, merchants, and workers, can reach the highest state by taking refuge in me.
items.h: हे पृथानन्दन जो भी पापयोनिवाले हों तथा जो भी स्त्रियाँ, वैश्य और शूद्र हों, वे भी सर्वथा...

items.p: kim punarbrahmanah punya bhakta rajarshayastatha anityamasukham lokamimam prapya bhajasva mam
items.e: If even pure Brahmins and royal sages devoted to the divine reach the highest state, what to speak of you? So, having come into this impermanent and...
items.h: जो पवित्र आचरणवाले ब्राह्मण और ऋषिस्वरूप क्षत्रिय भगवान् के भक्त हों, वे परमगतिको प्राप्त...

items.s: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु
items.p: manmana bhava madbhakto madyaji mam namaskuru mamevaishyasi yuktvaivamatmanam matparayanah
items.e: Fix your mind on me. Be devoted to me. Worship me. Bow to me. United with me in this way, and fully oriented toward me, you will come to me.
items.h: तू मेरा भक्त हो जा, मेरेमें मनवाला हो जा, मेरा पूजन करनेवाला हो जा और मेरेको नमस्कार कर...
items.a: man mana bhava mad bhakto | man mana bhava | manmana bhava

items.s: भूय एव महाबाहो श्रृणु मे परमं वचः
items.p: bhuya eva mahabaho shrrinu me paramam vachah yatteham priyamanaya vakshyami hitakamyaya
items.e: The Blessed Lord said: Listen again, O mighty-armed one, to my supreme word, which I will speak for your welfare because you are deeply dear to me.
items.h: श्रीभगवान् बोले हे महाबाहो अर्जुन मेरे परम वचनको तुम फिर भी सुनो, जिसे मैं तुम्हारे हितकी...

items.s: न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः
items.p: na me viduh suraganah prabhavam na maharshayah ahamadirhi devanam maharshinam cha sarvashah
items.e: The hosts of devas do not know my origin, nor do the great sages, for I am the beginning of the devas and the great sages in every way.
items.h: मेरे प्रकट होनेको न देवता जानते हैं और न महर्षि क्योंकि मैं सब प्रकारसे देवताओं और...

items.p: yo mamajamanadim cha vetti lokamaheshvaram asammudhah sa martyeshu sarvapapaih pramuchyate
items.e: One who knows Me as unborn, beginningless, and the great lord of all worlds is undeluded among mortals and is freed from every wrong deed.
items.h: जो मनुष्य मुझे अजन्मा, अनादि और सम्पूर्ण लोकोंका महान् ईश्वर जानता है अर्थात् दृढ़तासे...

items.p: buddhirgyanamasammohah kshama satyam damah shamah sukham duhkham bhavobhavo bhayam chabhayameva cha
items.e: Understanding, wisdom, freedom from confusion, forgiveness, truth, self-restraint, calmness, pleasure, pain, coming into being, ceasing to be, fear...
items.h: बुद्धि, ज्ञान, असम्मोह, क्षमा, सत्य, दम, शम, सुख, दुःख, भव, अभाव, भय, अभय, अहिंसा, समता...

items.e: Nonviolence, equanimity, contentment, austerity, charity, honor, and dishonor—all these different states of beings arise from Me alone.
items.h: बुद्धि, ज्ञान, असम्मोह, क्षमा, सत्य, दम, शम, सुख, दुःख, भव, अभाव, भय, अभय, अहिंसा, समता...

items.e: The seven great sages, the four ancient sages, and the fourteen Manus were born from my mind. The people of these worlds descend from them.
items.h: सात महर्षि और उनसे भी पूर्वमें होनेवाले चार सनकादि तथा चौदह मनु ये सबकेसब मेरे मनसे पैदा...
items.t: vibhuti manu saptarishi cosmic lineage srsti

items.p: etam vibhutim yogam cha mama yo vetti tattvatah sovikampena yogena yujyate natra sanshayah
items.e: One who truly knows this glory and this yoga of mine becomes steadfast in yoga without doubt.
items.h: जो मनुष्य मेरी इस विभूतिको और योगको तत्त्वसे जानता है अर्थात् दृढ़तापूर्वक मानता है, वह...

items.s: अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते
items.p: aham sarvasya prabhavo mattah sarvam pravartate iti matva bhajante mam budha bhavasamanvitah
items.e: I am the source of all; everything moves from me. Knowing this, the wise worship me with wholehearted devotion.
items.h: मैं संसारमात्रका प्रभव मूलकारण हूँ, और मुझसे ही सारा संसार प्रवृत्त हो रहा है अर्थात्...

items.p: machchitta madgataprana bodhayantah parasparam kathayantashcha mam nityam tushyanti cha ramanti cha
items.e: With minds fixed on Me and lives offered to Me, My devotees speak of Me to one another, and find continual joy in that shared devotion.
items.h: मेरेमें चित्तवाले, मेरेमें प्राणोंको अर्पण करनेवाले भक्तजन आपसमें मेरे गुण, प्रभाव आदिको...

items.p: tesham satatayuktanam bhajatam pritipurvakam dadami buddhiyogam tam yena mamupayanti te
items.e: To those who are always devoted and worship Me with love, I give the discernment that leads them to Me.
items.h: उन नित्यनिरन्तर मेरेमें लगे हुए और प्रेमपूर्वक मेरा भजन करनेवाले भक्तोंको मैं वह...

items.p: teshamevanukamparthamahamagyanajam tamah nashayamyatmabhavastho gyanadipena bhasvata
items.e: To show them compassion, I destroy the darkness born of ignorance with the shining lamp of knowledge, dwelling in their own being.
items.h: उन भक्तोंपर कृपा करनेके लिये ही उनके स्वरूप होनेपन में रहनेवाला मैं उनके अज्ञानजन्य...

items.s: परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान्
items.p: param brahma param dhama pavitram paramam bhavan purusham shashvatam divyamadidevamajam vibhum
items.e: Arjuna said: You are the supreme reality, the highest refuge, the purest one, the eternal divine person, the first being, unborn, and all-pervading.
items.h: अर्जुन बोले परम ब्रह्म, परम धाम और महान् पवित्र आप ही हैं । आप शाश्वत, दिव्य पुरुष...

items.p: ahustvamrishayah sarve devarshirnaradastatha asito devalo vyasah svayam chaiva bravishi me
items.e: All the sages speak of you this way: the divine sage Narada, Asita, Devala, and Vyasa. You yourself also say this to me.
items.h: अर्जुन बोले परम ब्रह्म, परम धाम और महान् पवित्र आप ही हैं । आप शाश्वत, दिव्य पुरुष...

items.p: sarvametadritam manye yanmam vadasi keshava na hi te bhagavan vyaktim vidurdeva na danavah
items.e: I accept as true all that you have said, O Keshava. O Bhagavan, neither the devas nor the asuras know your manifested form.
items.h: हे केशव मेरेसे आप जो कुछ कह रहे हैं, यह सब मैं सत्य मानता हूँ । हे भगवन् आपके प्रकट...

items.p: svayamevatmanatmanam vettha tvam purushottama bhutabhavana bhutesha devadeva jagatpate
items.e: O Supreme Person, you alone know yourself by yourself, O source of all beings, lord of all beings, divine of the divine, ruler of the world.
items.h: हे भूतभावन हे भूतेश हे देवदेव हे जगत्पते हे पुरुषोत्तम आप स्वयं ही अपनेआपसे अपनेआपको...

items.p: vaktumarhasyasheshena divya hyatmavibhutayah yabhirvibhutibhirlokanimanstvam vyapya tishthasi
items.e: Only you can fully describe your own divine manifestations, by which you pervade and sustain all these worlds.
items.h: जिन विभूतियोंसे आप इन सम्पूर्ण लोकोंको व्याप्त करके स्थित हैं, उन सभी अपनी दिव्य...

items.p: katham vidyamaham yoginstvam sada parichintayan keshu keshu cha bhaveshu chintyosi bhagavanmaya
items.e: O Yogi, how shall I know You by constant contemplation? In what forms should You be contemplated, O Blessed One?
items.h: हे योगिन् हरदम साङ्गोपाङ्ग चिन्तन करता हुआ मैं आपको कैसे जानूँ और हे भगवन् किनकिन...

items.p: vistarenatmano yogam vibhutim cha janardana bhuyah kathaya triptirhi shrrinvato nasti memritam
items.e: O Janardana, tell me again in detail of Your yogic power and Your manifestations, for I am not satisfied hearing Your nectar-like words.
items.h: हे जनार्दन आप अपने योग सामर्थ्य को और विभूतियोंको विस्तारसे फिर कहिये क्योंकि आपके अमृतमय...

items.p: hanta te kathayishyami divya hyatmavibhutayah pradhanyatah kurushreshtha nastyanto vistarasya me
items.e: Krishna said: I will tell you briefly of my divine manifestations, chief of them, Arjuna, for there is no end to their विस्तार.
items.h: श्रीभगवान् बोले हाँ, ठीक है । मैं अपनी दिव्य विभूतियोंको तेरे लिये प्रधानतासे संक्षेपसे...

items.p: ahamatma gudakesha sarvabhutashayasthitah ahamadishcha madhyam cha bhutanamanta eva cha
items.e: I am the Self, O Gudakesha, seated in the heart of all beings. I am the beginning, the middle, and the end of all beings.
items.h: हे नींदको जीतनेवाले अर्जुन सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके आदि, मध्य तथा अन्तमें भी मैं ही हूँ और...

items.p: adityanamaham vishnurjyotisham raviranshuman marichirmarutamasmi nakshatranamaham shashi
items.e: Among the sons of Aditi, I am Vishnu; among radiant things, I am the sun with rays. I am the brilliance in the Maruts, and among stars, I am the moon.
items.h: मैं अदितिके पुत्रोंमें विष्णु वामन और प्रकाशमान वस्तुओंमें किरणोंवाला सूर्य हूँ । मैं...
items.t: vibhuti cosmic manifestations surya chandra adityas

items.p: vedanam samavedosmi devanamasmi vasavah indriyanam manashchasmi bhutanamasmi chetana
items.e: Among the Vedas, I am the Sama Veda; among the radiant beings, I am Indra. Among the senses, I am the mind; among living beings, I am consciousness.
items.h: मैं वेदोंमें सामवेद हूँ, देवताओंमें इन्द्र हूँ, इन्द्रियोंमें मन हूँ और प्राणियोंकी चेतना...

items.p: rudranam shankarashchasmi vittesho yaksharakshasam vasunam pavakashchasmi meruh shikharinamaham
items.e: Among the Rudras, I am Shankara; among the Yakshas and Rakshasas, I am Kubera. Among the Vasus, I am fire, and among mountain peaks, I am Mount Meru.
items.h: रुद्रोंमें शंकर और यक्षराक्षसोंमें कुबेर मैं हूँ । वसुओंमें पावक अग्नि और शिखरवाले...

items.s: पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम्
items.p: purodhasam cha mukhyam mam viddhi partha brihaspatim senaninamaham skandah sarasamasmi sagarah
items.e: Among priests, know Me as Brihaspati; among commanders, I am Skanda; among waters, I am the ocean.
items.h: हे पार्थ पुरोहितोंमें मुख्य बृहस्पतिको मेरा स्वरूप समझो । सेनापतियोंमें स्कन्द और...

items.p: maharshinam bhriguraham giramasmyekamaksharam yagyanam japayagyosmi sthavaranam himalayah
items.e: Among great sages I am Bhrigu; among words I am the one imperishable syllable. Among sacrifices I am the sacrifice of silent repetition; among the...
items.h: महर्षियोंमें भृगु और वाणियोंशब्दों में एक अक्षर अर्थात् प्रणव मैं हूँ । सम्पूर्ण...

items.p: ashvatthah sarvavrikshanam devarshinam cha naradah gandharvanam chitrarathah siddhanam kapilo munih
items.e: Among all trees I am the sacred fig tree. Among divine sages I am Narada; among celestial musicians, Chitraratha; among perfected sages, the sage...
items.h: सम्पूर्ण वृक्षोंमें पीपल, देवर्षियोंमें नारद, गन्धर्वोंमें चित्ररथ और सिद्धोंमें कपिल...

items.p: uchchaihshravasamashvanam viddhi mamamritodbhavam airavatam gajendranam naranam cha naradhipam
items.e: Among horses, know me as Ucchaihshravas, born from nectar. Among royal elephants, I am Airavata, and among humans, I am the king.
items.h: घोड़ोंमें अमृतके साथ समुद्रसे प्रकट होनेवाले उच्चैःश्रवा नामक घोड़ेको, श्रेष्ठ हाथियोंमें...

items.p: ayudhanamaham vajram dhenunamasmi kamadhuk prajanashchasmi kandarpah sarpanamasmi vasukih
items.e: Among weapons, I am the thunderbolt; among cows, I am the wish-fulfilling cow. I am the cause of procreation, and among serpents, I am Vasuki.
items.h: आयुधोंमें वज्र और धेनुओंमें कामधेनु मैं हूँ । सन्तानउत्पत्तिका हेतु कामदेव मैं हूँ और...

items.p: anantashchasmi naganam varuno yadasamaham pitrinamaryama chasmi yamah sanyamatamaham
items.e: Among serpents I am Ananta; among water beings I am Varuna. Among ancestors I am Aryaman; among those who govern, I am Yama.
items.h: नागोंमें अनन्त शेषनाग और जलजन्तुओंका अधिपति वरुण मैं हूँ । पितरोंमें अर्यमा और शासन...

items.p: prahladashchasmi daityanam kalah kalayatamaham mriganam cha mrigendroham vainateyashcha pakshinam
items.e: Among the daityas I am Prahlada; among calculators I am Time. Among beasts I am the lion, and among birds I am Garuda.
items.h: दैत्योंमें प्रह्लाद और गणना करनेवालोंमें काल मैं हूँ । पशुओंमें सिंह और पक्षियोंमें गरुड...

items.p: pavanah pavatamasmi ramah shastrabhritamaham jhashanam makarashchasmi srotasamasmi jahnavi
items.e: Among purifiers, I am the wind. Among wielders of weapons, I am Rama. Among aquatic beings, I am the crocodile. Among flowing rivers, I am the Ganga.
items.h: पवित्र करनेवालोंमें वायु और शास्त्रधारियोंमें राम मैं हूँ । जलजन्तुओंमें मगर मैं हूँ...

items.p: sarganamadirantashcha madhyam chaivahamarjuna adhyatmavidya vidyanam vadah pravadatamaham
items.e: I am the beginning, the middle, and the end of all creation, Arjuna. Among all forms of knowledge, I am the knowledge of the true self; among...
items.h: हे अर्जुन सम्पूर्ण सर्गोंके आदि, मध्य तथा अन्तमें मैं ही हूँ । विद्याओंमें अध्यात्मविद्या...

items.p: aksharanamakarosmi dvandvah samasikasya cha ahamevakshayah kalo dhataham vishvatomukhah
items.e: Among letters I am the letter A. Among compounds I am the dual compound. I am endless time itself, and I am the all-facing sustainer.
items.h: अक्षरोंमें अकार और समासोंमें द्वन्द्व समास मैं हूँ । अक्षयकाल अर्थात् कालका भी महाकाल तथा...

items.p: mrityuh sarvaharashchahamudbhavashcha bhavishyatam kirtih shrirvakcha narinam smritirmedha dhritih kshama
items.e: I am death that takes everything, and the source of all future beings. Among women, I am fame, fortune, speech, memory, intelligence, steadfastness...
items.h: सबका हरण करनेवाली मृत्यु और उत्पन्न होनेवालोंका उभ्दव मैं हूँ तथा स्त्रीजातिमें कीर्ति...

items.p: brihatsama tatha samnam gayatri chhandasamaham masanam margashirshohamritunam kusumakarah
items.e: Among hymns I am the Brihat-Sama; among meters I am Gayatri. Among months I am Margashirsha; among seasons I am spring.
items.h: गायी जानेवाली श्रुतियोंमें बृहत्साम और वैदिक छन्दोंमें गायत्री छन्द मैं हूँ । बारह...

items.p: dyutam chhalayatamasmi tejastejasvinamaham jayosmi vyavasayosmi sattvam sattvavatamaham
items.e: Among deceivers I am gambling, among the vigorous I am splendor. I am victory, I am resolve, and I am the goodness of the good.
items.h: छल करनेवालोंमें जूआ और तेजस्वियोंमें तेज मैं हूँ । जीतनेवालोंकी विजय, निश्चय करनेवालोंका...

items.p: vrishninam vasudevosmi pandavanam dhananjayah muninamapyaham vyasah kavinamushana kavih
items.e: Among the Vrishnis I am Vasudeva; among the Pandavas I am Dhananjaya. Among sages I am Vyasa, and among poets I am Ushana, the poet.
items.h: वृष्णिवंशियोंमें वासुदेव और पाण्डवोंमें धनञ्जय मैं हूँ । मुनियोंमें वेदव्यास और कवियोंमें...

items.p: dando damayatamasmi nitirasmi jigishatam maunam chaivasmi guhyanam gyanam gyanavatamaham
items.e: Among enforcers, I am punishment; among those seeking victory, I am policy. Among secrets, I am silence; among the wise, I am knowledge.
items.h: दमन करनेवालोंमें दण्डनीति और विजय चाहनेवालोंमें नीति मैं हूँ । गोपनीय भावोंमें मौन और...

items.p: yachchapi sarvabhutanam bijam tadahamarjuna na tadasti vina yatsyanmaya bhutam characharam
items.e: Arjuna, I am the seed of all beings. Without me, nothing moving or unmoving could exist.
items.h: हे अर्जुन सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंका जो बीज है, वह बीज मैं ही हूँ क्योंकि मेरे बिना कोई भी...

items.p: nantosti mama divyanam vibhutinam parantapa esha tuddeshatah prokto vibhutervistaro maya
items.e: O scorcher of foes, my divine manifestations have no end. What I have described to you is only a brief summary of my vast manifestations.
items.h: हे परंतप अर्जुन मेरी दिव्य विभूतियोंका अन्त नहीं है । मैंने तुम्हारे सामने अपनी...
items.t: vibhuti limitless manifestations divine presence cosmic expanse krishna teaching

items.p: yadyadvibhutimatsattvam shrimadurjitameva va tattadevavagachchha tvam mama tejomshasambhavam
items.e: Whatever being or thing is endowed with splendour, beauty, or power—know that to have arisen from a spark of my radiance.
items.h: जोजो ऐश्वर्ययुक्त, शोभायुक्त और बलयुक्त प्राणी तथा वस्तु है, उसउसको तुम मेरे ही तेजयोग के...

items.p: athava bahunaitena kim gyatena tavarjuna vishtabhyahamidam kritsnamekanshena sthito jagat
items.e: Or, Arjuna, what is the need for all this detailed knowledge? I sustain this entire universe with a single fragment of myself.
items.h: अथवा हे अर्जुन तुम्हें इस प्रकार बहुतसी बातें जाननेकी क्या आवश्यकता है मैं अपने किसी एक...

items.p: madanugrahaya paramam guhyamadhyatmasangyitam yattvayoktam vachastena mohoyam vigato mama
items.e: Arjuna said: By the gracious words you spoke for my benefit alone, my delusion has been dispelled.
items.h: अर्जुन बोले केवल मेरेपर कृपा करनेके लिये ही आपने जो परम गोपनीय अध्यात्मतत्तव जाननेका वचन...

items.s: भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया
items.p: bhavapyayau hi bhutanam shrutau vistarasho maya tvattah kamalapatraksha mahatmyamapi chavyayam
items.e: O lotus-eyed one, I have heard from You in detail about the arising and passing away of all beings, and also about Your imperishable majesty.
items.h: हे कमलनयन सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंकी उत्पत्ति और प्रलय मैंने विस्तारपूर्वक आपसे ही सुना है और...

items.p: evametadyathattha tvamatmanam parameshvara drashtumichchhami te rupamaishvaram purushottama
items.e: O Supreme Person, everything you have said about yourself is true. Yet I wish to see your divine form.
items.h: हे पुरुषोत्तम आप अपनेआपको जैसा कहते हैं, यह वास्तवमें ऐसा ही है । हे परमेश्वर आपके...

items.s: मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो
items.p: manyase yadi tachchhakyam maya drashtumiti prabho yogeshvara tato me tvam darshayatmanamavyayam
items.e: If you think I can see that form, Lord, then show me your imperishable self, Master of yoga.
items.h: हे प्रभो मेरे द्वारा आपका वह परम ऐश्वर रूप देखा जा सकता है ऐसा अगर आप मानते हैं, तो हे...

items.s: पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः
items.p: pashya me partha rupani shatashotha sahasrashah nanavidhani divyani nanavarnakritini cha
items.e: The Blessed Lord said: See, Partha, my forms in hundreds and thousands, diverse, divine, and of many colors and shapes.
items.h: श्रीभगवान् बोले हे पृथानन्दन अब मेरे अनेक तरहके, अनेक अनेक वर्णों और आकृतियोंवाले...

items.p: pashyadityanvasunrudranashvinau marutastatha bahunyadrishtapurvani pashyashcharyani bharata
items.e: See the twelve Adityas, the eight Vasus, the eleven Rudras, the two Ashvins, and the forty-nine Maruts. See many wonders never seen before, O Bharata.
items.h: हे भरतवंशोद्भव अर्जुन तू बारह आदित्योंको, आठ वसुओंको, ग्यारह रुद्रोंको और दो...

items.p: ihaikastham jagatkritsnam pashyadya sacharacharam mama dehe gudakesha yachchanyaddrashtumichchhasi
items.e: Behold the entire universe, with all that moves and does not move, gathered here in one place in My body. See whatever else you wish to see as well.
items.h: हे नींदको जीतनेवाले अर्जुन मेरे इस शरीरके एक देशमें चराचरसहित सम्पूर्ण जगत् को अभी देख ले...
items.t: vishwarupa cosmic form all-pervading divine vision arjuna

items.s: न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा
items.p: na tu mam shakyase drashtumanenaiva svachakshusha divyam dadami te chakshuh pashya me yogamaishvaram
items.e: You cannot see me with these ordinary eyes. I give you divine sight, so you may behold my supreme power.
items.h: परन्तु तू अपनी इस आँखसे अर्थात् चर्मचक्षुसे मेरेको देख ही नहीं सकता, इसलिये मैं तुझे...

items.p: evamuktva tato rajanmahayogeshvaro harih darshayamasa parthaya paramam rupamaishvaram
items.e: Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus, O King, the great lord of yoga, Hari, revealed to Arjuna the supreme divine form.
items.h: सञ्जय बोले हे राजन् ऐसा कहकर फिर महायोगेश्वर भगवान् श्रीकृष्णने अर्जुनको परम ऐश्वररूप...

items.p: anekavaktranayanamanekadbhutadarshanam anekadivyabharanam divyanekodyatayudham
items.e: With many mouths and eyes, with countless wondrous forms, adorned with many divine ornaments and many uplifted divine weapons.
items.h: जिसके अनेक मुख और नेत्र हैं, अनेक तहरके अद्भुत दर्शन हैं, अनेक दिव्य आभूषण हैं, हाथोंमें...

items.p: divyamalyambaradharam divyagandhanulepanam sarvashcharyamayam devamanantam vishvatomukham
items.e: Wearing divine garlands and garments, anointed with divine fragrances, wondrous in every way, endless, and facing everywhere.
items.h: जिसके अनेक मुख और नेत्र हैं, अनेक तहरके अद्भुत दर्शन हैं, अनेक दिव्य आभूषण हैं, हाथोंमें...

items.p: divi suryasahasrasya bhavedyugapadutthita yadi bhah sadrishi sa syadbhasastasya mahatmanah
items.e: If a thousand suns rose together in the sky, their light would still barely match that great being's radiance.
items.h: अगर आकाशमें एक साथ हजारों सूर्य उदित हो जायँ, तो भी उन सबका प्रकाश मिलकर उस महात्माविराट्...
items.a: divi surya sahasrasya | radiance of a thousand suns
