items.p: ma te vyatha ma cha vimudhabhavodrishtva rupam ghoramidrinmamedam vyapetabhih pritamanah punastvantadeva me rupamidam prapashya
items.e: Do not be distressed or confused by this fierce form of mine. Free from fear and calm-minded, look again upon this very form of mine.
items.h: यह इस प्रकारका मेरा घोररूप देखकर तेरेको व्यथा नहीं होनी चाहिये और मूढ़भाव भी नहीं होना...

items.p: ityarjunam vasudevastathoktvasvakam rupam darshayamasa bhuyah ashvasayamasa cha bhitamenambhutva punah saumyavapurmahatma
items.e: Sanjaya said: After speaking thus to Arjuna, Vasudeva revealed his own form again. The great one then reassured the frightened Arjuna, taking once...
items.h: सञ्जय बोले वासुदेवभगवान् ने अर्जुनसे ऐसा कहकर फिर उसी प्रकारसे अपना रूप देवरूप दिखाया और...

items.p: drishtvedam manusham rupam tavasaumyam janardana idanimasmi sanvrittah sachetah prakritim gatah
items.e: Arjuna said: Seeing your gentle human form, Janardana, I am calm again and restored to my natural state.
items.h: अर्जुन बोले हे जनार्दन आपके इस सौम्य मनुष्यरूपको देखकर मैं इस समय स्थिरचित्त हो गया हूँ...

items.p: sudurdarshamidam rupam drishtavanasi yanmama deva apyasya rupasya nityam darshanakankshinah
items.e: Krishna said: The form you have seen is very hard to behold. Even the radiant beings long forever to see it.
items.h: श्रीभगवान् बोले मेरा यह जो रूप तुमने देखा है, इसके दर्शन अत्यन्त ही दुर्लभ हैं । इस रूपको...

items.s: नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया
items.p: naham vedairna tapasa na danena na chejyaya shakya evanvidho drashtum drishtavanasi mam yatha
items.e: I cannot be seen in this form through the Vedas, austerity, charity, or sacrifice, as you have seen me.
items.h: जिस प्रकार तुमने मुझे देखा है, इस प्रकारका चतुर्भुजरूपवाला मैं न तो वेदोंसे, न तपसे, न...

items.p: bhaktya tvananyaya shakyamahamevanvidhorjuna gyatum drishtum cha tattvena praveshtum cha parantapa
items.e: But only through undivided devotion can I be truly known, seen, and entered, Arjuna.
items.h: परन्तु हे शत्रुतापन अर्जुन इस प्रकार चतुर्भुजरूपवाला मैं अनन्यभक्तिसे ही तत्त्वसे...

items.p: matkarmakrinmatparamo madbhaktah sangavarjitah nirvairah sarvabhuteshu yah sa mameti pandava
items.e: O Pandava, the devotee who works for Me alone, takes Me as the highest goal, is devoted to Me, is free from attachment, and bears no enmity toward...
items.h: हे पाण्डवन जो मेरे लिये ही कर्म करनेवाला, मेरे ही परायण और मेरा ही भक्त है तथा सर्वथा...

items.p: evam satatayukta ye bhaktastvam paryupasate yechapyaksharamavyaktam tesham ke yogavittamah
items.e: Arjuna said: Those devotees who worship You with constant devotion, and those who worship the imperishable, unmanifest reality—who among them are the...
items.h: जो भक्त इस प्रकार निरन्तर आपमें लगे रहकर आपसगुण भगवान् की उपासना करते हैं और जो अविनाशी...

items.s: मय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते
items.p: mayyaveshya mano ye mam nityayukta upasate shraddhaya parayopetaste me yuktatama matah
items.e: Those who focus their mind on me, worship me with unwavering devotion, and are filled with supreme trust are, in my view, the highest yogis.
items.h: मेरेमें मनको लगाकर नित्यनिरन्तर मेरेमें लगे हुए जो भक्त परम श्रद्धासे युक्त होकर मेरी...

items.p: ye tvaksharamanirdeshyamavyaktam paryupasate sarvatragamachintyam cha kutasthamachalam dhruvam
items.e: Those who worship the unchanging, the indefinable, the unmanifest, the all-pervading, the unthinkable, the unmoving, the eternal, the...
items.h: जो अपनी इन्द्रियोंको वशमें करके अचिन्त्य, सब जगह परिपूर्ण, अनिर्देश्य, कूटस्थ, अचल...

items.p: sanniyamyendriyagramam sarvatra samabuddhayah te prapnuvanti mameva sarvabhutahite ratah
items.e: Those who restrain the senses, remain even-minded everywhere, and delight in the welfare of all beings reach me alone.
items.h: जो अपनी इन्द्रियोंको वशमें करके अचिन्त्य, सब जगह परिपूर्ण, अनिर्देश्य, कूटस्थ, अचल...

items.p: kleshodhikatarasteshamavyaktasaktachetasam avyakta hi gatirduhkham dehavadbhiravapyate
items.e: For those whose minds cling to the unmanifest, the struggle is greater. The unmanifest path is hard to reach for embodied beings.
items.h: अव्यक्तमें आसक्त चित्तवाले उन साधकोंको अपने साधनमें कष्ट अधिक होता है क्योंकि...

items.s: ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः
items.p: ye tu sarvani karmani mayi sannyasya matparah ananyenaiva yogena mam dhyayanta upasate
items.e: But those who surrender all actions to Me, take Me as their highest aim, and worship Me with single-pointed devotion, meditating on Me alone.
items.h: परन्तु जो कर्मोंको मेरे अर्पण करके और मेरे परायण होकर अनन्ययोगसे मेरा ही ध्यान करते हुए...

items.p: teshamaham samuddharta mrityusansarasagarat bhavami nachiratpartha mayyaveshitachetasam
items.e: I quickly become the one who lifts those whose minds are fixed on me from the ocean of mortal existence, O Partha.
items.h: हे पार्थ मेरेमें आविष्ट चित्तवाले उन भक्तोंका मैं मृत्युरूप संसारसमुद्रसे शीघ्र ही उद्धार...

items.s: मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय
items.p: mayyeva mana adhatsva mayi buddhim niveshaya nivasishyasi mayyeva ata urdhvam na sanshayah
items.e: Fix your mind on me alone. Place your discerning mind in me, and you will live in me beyond doubt.
items.h: तू मेरेमें मनको लगा और मेरेमें ही बुद्धिको लगा इसके बाद तू मेरेमें ही निवास करेगा इसमें...

items.s: अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम्
items.p: atha chittam samadhatum na shaknoshi mayi sthiram abhyasayogena tato mamichchhaptum dhananjaya
items.e: If you cannot steadily fix your mind on me, then, Dhananjaya, seek me through practice yoga.
items.h: अगर तू मनको मेरेमें अचलभावसे स्थिर अर्पण करनेमें समर्थ नहीं है, तो हे धनञ्जय अभ्यासयोगके...

items.p: abhyasepyasamarthosi matkarmaparamo bhava madarthamapi karmani kurvan siddhimavapsyasi
items.e: If you are unable even to practice, then be devoted to working for Me. By doing actions for My sake, you will attain perfection.
items.h: अगर तू अभ्यासयोग में भी असमर्थ है, तो मेरे लिये कर्म करनेके परायण हो जा । मेरे लिये...

items.p: athaitadapyashaktosi kartum madyogamashritah sarvakarmaphalatyagam tatah kuru yatatmavan
items.e: If you still cannot do even this while taking refuge in my yoga, then, self-controlled, renounce all fruits of action.
items.h: अगर मेरे योगसमता के आश्रित हुआ तू इसपूर्वश्लोकमें कहे गये साधन को भी करनेमें असमर्थ है...

items.p: shreyo hi gyanamabhyasajgyanaddhyanam vishishyate dhyanatkarmaphalatyagastyagachchhantiranantaram
items.e: Knowledge is better than practice; meditation is better than knowledge. Renouncing the fruits of action is better than meditation, and peace follows...
items.h: अभ्याससे शास्त्रज्ञान श्रेष्ठ है, शास्त्रज्ञानसे ध्यान श्रेष्ठ है और ध्यानसे भी सब...

items.s: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च
items.p: adveshta sarvabhutanam maitrah karuna eva cha nirmamo nirahankarah samaduhkhasukhah kshami
items.e: One who hates no being, is friendly and compassionate, free from possessiveness and ego, equal in pleasure and pain, and forgiving.
items.h: सब प्राणियोंमें द्वेषभावसे रहित, सबका मित्र प्रेमी और दयालु, ममतारहित, अहंकाररहित...

items.p: santushtah satatam yogi yatatma dridhanishchayah mayyarpitamanobuddhiryo madbhaktah sa me priyah
items.e: The devoted yogi is always content, self-controlled, and steady in resolve. One whose mind and discerning mind are offered to Me is dear to Me.
items.h: सब प्राणियोंमें द्वेषभावसे रहित, सबका मित्र प्रेमी और दयालु, ममतारहित, अहंकाररहित...

items.p: yasmannodvijate loko lokannodvijate cha yah harshamarshabhayodvegairmukto yah sa cha me priyah
items.e: The one who disturbs no one and is disturbed by no one, and who is free from delight, envy, fear, and agitation, is dear to me.
items.h: जिससे किसी प्राणीको उद्वेग नहीं होता और जिसको खुद भी किसी प्राणीसे उद्वेग नहीं होता तथा...

items.p: anapekshah shuchirdaksha udasino gatavyathah sarvarambhaparityagi yo madbhaktah sa me priyah
items.e: One who has no expectation, is pure, skilled, detached, free from anxiety, and has given up all undertakings is dear to me, my devotee.
items.h: जो आकाङ्क्षासे रहित, बाहरभीतरसे पवित्र, दक्ष, उदासीन, व्यथासे रहित और सभी आरम्भोंका...

items.s: यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति
items.p: yo na hrishyati na dveshti na shochati na kankshati shubhashubhaparityagi bhaktimanyah sa me priyah
items.e: One who neither rejoices, hates, grieves, nor craves, and who has given up attachment to both good and bad actions, is dear to me.
items.h: जो न कभी हर्षित होता है, न द्वेष करता है, न शोक करता है, न कामना करता है और जो शुभअशुभ...

items.s: समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः
items.p: samah shatrau cha mitre cha tatha manapamanayoh shitoshnasukhaduhkheshu samah sangavivarjitah
items.e: One who is equal to enemy and friend, honor and dishonor, heat and cold, pleasure and pain, and is free from attachment is dear to Me.
items.h: जो शत्रु और मित्रमें तथा मानअपमानमें सम है और शीतउष्ण अनुकूलताप्रतिकूलता तथा सुखदुःखमें...

items.p: tulyanindastutirmauni santushto yenakenachit aniketah sthiramatirbhaktimanme priyo narah
items.e: Equal in praise and blame, silent, content with whatever comes, homeless, steady-minded—the devoted person is dear to me.
items.h: जो शत्रु और मित्रमें तथा मानअपमानमें सम है और शीतउष्ण अनुकूलताप्रतिकूलता तथा सुखदुःखमें...

items.p: ye tu dharmyamritamidam yathoktam paryupasate shraddadhana matparama bhaktastetiva me priyah
items.e: Those devotees who trust, take refuge in Me, and faithfully live this nectar-like teaching are exceedingly dear to Me.
items.h: जो मेरेमें श्रद्धा रखनेवाले और मेरे परायण हुए भक्त पहले कहे हुए इस धर्ममय अमृतका अच्छी...

items.s: प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च
items.p: prakritim purusham chaiva kshetram kshetragyameva cha etadveditumichchhami gyanam gyeyam cha keshava
items.e: Arjuna said: O Keshava, I wish to understand nature, the field, the knower of the field, wisdom, and what is to be known.
items.h: श्रीभगवान् बोलेहे कुन्तीपुत्र अर्जुन यहरूपसे कहे जानेवाले शरीरको क्षेत्र कहते हैं और इस...

items.p: idam shariram kaunteya kshetramityabhidhiyate etadyo vetti tam prahuh kshetragya iti tadvidah
items.e: The body is called the field, O Arjuna. Those who know it call the knower of the field the field-knower.
items.h: श्रीभगवान् बोले हे कुन्तीपुत्र अर्जुन यह रूपसे कहे जानेवाले शरीरको क्षेत्र कहते हैं और इस...

items.s: क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत
items.p: kshetragyam chapi mam viddhi sarvakshetreshu bharata kshetrakshetragyayorgyanam yattajgyanam matam mama
items.e: Know Me as the knower in all fields, Arjuna. In my view, true knowledge is knowing the field and the knower of the field.
items.h: हे भरतवंशोद्भव अर्जुन तू सम्पूर्ण क्षेत्रोंमें क्षेत्रज्ञ मेरेको ही समझ और...

items.s: तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक् च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत्
items.p: tatkshetram yachcha yadrik cha yadvikari yatashcha yat sa cha yo yatprabhavashcha tatsamasena me shrrinu
items.e: Listen to the field, its nature, its changes, its source, and the knower of the field, along with that knower's powers, in brief.
items.h: वह क्षेत्र जो है, जैसा है, जिन विकारोंवाला है और जिससे जो पैदा हुआ है तथा वह क्षेत्रज्ञ...

items.p: rishibhirbahudha gitam chhandobhirvividhaih prithak brahmasutrapadaishchaiva hetumadbhirvinishchitaih
items.e: This truth about the field and the knower has been sung in many ways by sages, in varied Vedic hymns, and in the reasoned, conclusive verses of the...
items.h: यह क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञका तत्त्व ऋषियोंके द्वारा बहुत विस्तारसे कहा गया है तथा वेदोंकी...

items.p: mahabhutanyahankaro buddhiravyaktameva cha indriyani dashaikam cha pancha chendriyagocharah
items.e: The five great elements, ego, intellect, the unmanifest, the ten senses, the one mind, and the five sense-objects: this is the field in brief.
items.h: मूल प्रकृति, समष्टि बुद्धि महत्तत्त्व, समष्टि अहंकार, पाँच महाभूत और दस इन्द्रियाँ, एक मन...

items.p: ichchha dveshah sukham duhkham sanghatashchetanadhritih etatkshetram samasena savikaramudahritam
items.e: Desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, the body, consciousness, and steadiness: this field, together with its changes, is briefly described.
items.h: इच्छा, द्वेष, सुख, दुःख, संघात, चेतना प्राणशक्ति और धृति इन विकारोंसहित यह क्षेत्र...

items.p: amanitvamadambhitvamahinsa kshantirarjavam acharyopasanam shaucham sthairyamatmavinigrahah
items.e: Absence of pride, absence of pretence, nonviolence, forgiveness, simplicity, service to the teacher, purity, steadiness, and self-control.
items.h: मानित्वअपनेमें श्रेष्ठताके भाव का न होना, दम्भित्वदिखावटीपन का न होना, अहिंसा, क्षमा...

items.p: indriyartheshu vairagyamanahankara eva cha janmamrityujaravyadhiduhkhadoshanudarshanam
items.e: Dispassion toward sense objects, absence of ego, and constant seeing of the fault in birth, death, old age, and disease.
items.h: इन्द्रियोंके विषयोंमें वैराग्यका होना, अहंकारका भी न होना और जन्म, मृत्यु, वृद्धावस्था...

items.p: asaktiranabhishvangah putradaragrihadishu nityam cha samachittatvamishtanishtopapattishu
items.e: Freedom from attachment to sons, wife, home, and the like; and constant evenness of mind in desired and undesired events.
items.h: आसक्तिरहित होना पुत्र, स्त्री, घर आदिमें एकात्मता घनिष्ठ सम्बन्ध न होना और...

items.p: mayi chananyayogena bhaktiravyabhicharini viviktadeshasevitvamaratirjanasansadi
items.e: Undivided devotion to me, a love that does not waver, delight in solitude, and no attraction to crowds.
items.h: मेरेमें अनन्ययोगके द्वारा अव्यभिचारिणी भक्तिका होना, एकान्त स्थानमें रहनेका स्वभाव होना...

items.p: adhyatmagyananityatvam tattvagyanarthadarshanam etajgyanamiti proktamagyanam yadatonyatha
items.e: Constant awareness of the inner reality, and seeing the supreme reality as the meaning of true understanding—this is called knowledge; whatever is...
items.h: अध्यात्मज्ञानमें नित्यनिरन्तर रहना, तत्त्वज्ञानके अर्थरूप परमात्माको सब जगह देखना यह...

items.p: gyeyam yattatpravakshyami yajgyatvamritamashnute anadimatparam brahma na sattannasaduchyate
items.e: I will now tell you what is to be known. Knowing it, one attains freedom. It is beginningless supreme reality, beyond existence and nonexistence.
items.h: जो ज्ञेय है, उसपरमात्मतत्त्व को मैं अच्छी तरहसे कहूँगा, जिसको जानकर मनुष्य अमरताका अनुभव...

items.p: sarvatah panipadam tatsarvatokshishiromukham sarvatah shrutimalloke sarvamavritya tishthati
items.e: The supreme reality has hands and feet everywhere, eyes, heads, and faces everywhere, and ears everywhere. It pervades all things and stands within...
items.h: वे परमात्मा सब जगह हाथों और पैरोंवाले, सब जगह नेत्रों, सिरों और मुखोंवाले तथा सब जगह...

items.p: sarvendriyagunabhasam sarvendriyavivarjitam asaktam sarvabhrichchaiva nirgunam gunabhoktri cha
items.e: The supreme reality has no senses, yet illumines every sense-object. It is detached, supports all beings, beyond the three qualities, and yet...
items.h: वे परमात्मा सम्पूर्ण इन्द्रियोंसे रहित हैं और सम्पूर्ण इन्द्रियोंके विषयोंको प्रकाशित...

items.p: bahirantashcha bhutanamacharam charameva cha sukshmatvattadavigyeyam durastham chantike cha tat
items.e: The supreme reality is inside and outside all beings, moving and unmoving. Because it is subtle, it cannot be known; it is far away and near at hand.
items.h: वे परमात्मा सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके बाहरभीतर परिपूर्ण हैं और चरअचर प्राणियोंके रूपमें भी वे...

items.s: अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम्
items.p: avibhaktam cha bhuteshu vibhaktamiva cha sthitam bhutabhartri cha tajgyeyam grasishnu prabhavishnu cha
items.e: Undivided among beings, it appears divided. Know it as the one who bears, devours, and creates all beings.
items.h: वे परमात्मा स्वयं विभागरहित होते हुए भी सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंमें विभक्तकी तरह स्थित हैं । वे...

items.p: jyotishamapi tajjyotistamasah paramuchyate gyanam gyeyam gyanagamyam hridi sarvasya vishthitam
items.e: It is the light of all lights, beyond darkness. It is knowledge, the knowable, reached through knowledge, and abiding in every heart.
items.h: वह परमात्मा सम्पूर्ण ज्योतियोंका भी ज्योति और अज्ञानसे अत्यन्त परे कहा गया है । वह...

items.s: इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः
items.p: iti kshetram tatha gyanam gyeyam choktam samasatah madbhakta etadvigyaya madbhavayopapadyate
items.e: Thus, field, knowledge, and the knowable have been explained briefly. My devotee, understanding this, attains my state.
items.h: इस प्रकार क्षेत्र, ज्ञान और ज्ञेयको संक्षेपसे कहा गया । मेरा भक्त इसको तत्त्वसे जानकर...

items.p: prakritim purusham chaiva viddhyanadi ubhavapi vikaranshcha gunanshchaiva viddhi prakritisambhavan
items.e: Know both Prakriti and Purusha to be beginningless, and know the modifications and qualities to arise from Prakriti.
items.h: प्रकृति और पुरुष दोनोंको ही तुम अनादि समझो और विकारों तथा गुणोंको भी प्रकृतिसे ही उत्पन्न...

items.p: karyakaranakartritve hetuh prakritiruchyate purushah sukhaduhkhanam bhoktritve heturuchyate
items.e: Nature is said to be the cause of the body, the senses, and action. The inner being is said to be the cause of experiencing pleasure and pain.
items.h: प्रकृति और पुरुष दोनोंको ही तुम अनादि समझो और विकारों तथा गुणोंको भी प्रकृतिसे ही उत्पन्न...

items.p: purushah prakritistho hi bhunkte prakritijangunan karanam gunasangosya sadasadyonijanmasu
items.e: The inner being, situated in nature, experiences the qualities born of nature. Attachment to those qualities causes birth in good and bad wombs.
items.h: प्रकृतिमें स्थित पुरुष ही प्रकृतिजन्य गुणोंका भोक्ता बनता है और गुणोंका सङ्ग ही उसके...

items.p: upadrashtanumanta cha bharta bhokta maheshvarah paramatmeti chapyukto dehesminpurushah parah
items.e: The inner self becomes the witness, consent-giver, supporter, enjoyer, and great lord through its relation with the body. Yet in its true nature, it...
items.h: यह पुरुष प्रकृतिशरीर के साथ सम्बन्ध रखनेसे उपद्रष्टा, उसके साथ मिलकर सम्मति, अनुमति...

items.s: य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैःसह
items.p: ya evam vetti purusham prakritim cha gunaihsaha sarvatha vartamanopi na sa bhuyobhijayate
items.e: Whoever thus knows the purusha and prakriti together with the qualities is not born again, even while living and acting in every way.
items.h: इस प्रकार पुरुषको और गुणोंके सहित प्रकृतिको जो मनुष्य अलगअलग जानता है, वह सब तरहका बर्ताव...

items.p: dhyanenatmani pashyanti kechidatmanamatmana anye sankhyena yogena karmayogena chapare
items.e: Some realize the true self within through meditation on the self. Others through clear discernment and yoga, and still others through the yoga of...
items.h: कई मनुष्य ध्यानयोगके द्वारा, कई सांख्ययोगके द्वारा और कई कर्मयोगके द्वारा अपनेआपसे...

items.p: anye tvevamajanantah shrutvanyebhya upasate tepi chatitarantyeva mrityum shrutiparayanah
items.e: Others do not know these paths, but they worship by hearing from others. Even they cross beyond death if they listen with devotion.
items.h: दूसरे मनुष्य इस प्रकार ध्यानयोग, सांख्ययोग, कर्मयोग, आदि साधनोंको नहीं जानते, केवल...

items.p: yavatsanjayate kinchitsattvam sthavarajangamam kshetrakshetragyasanyogattadviddhi bharatarshabha
items.e: O best among the Bharatas, know that whatever comes into being, moving or unmoving, arises from the union of the field and the knower of the field.
items.h: हे भरतवंशियोंमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुन स्थावर और जंगम जितने भी प्राणी पैदा होते हैं, उनको तुम...

items.p: samam sarveshu bhuteshu tishthantam parameshvaram vinashyatsvavinashyantam yah pashyati sa pashyati
items.e: One who sees the supreme being equally present in all beings, imperishable amid the perishing, truly sees.
items.h: जो नष्ट होते हुए सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंमें परमात्माको नाशरहित और समरूपसे स्थित देखता है, वही...

items.p: samam pashyanhi sarvatra samavasthitamishvaram na hinastyatmanatmanam tato yati param gatim
items.e: Seeing the divine equally everywhere, a person does not wound the true self by the true self, and reaches the highest state.
items.h: क्योंकि सब जगह समरूपसे स्थित ईश्वरको समरूपसे देखनेवाला मनुष्य अपनेआपसे अपनी हिंसा नहीं...

items.p: prakrityaiva cha karmani kriyamanani sarvashah yah pashyati tathatmanamakartaram sa pashyati
items.e: One who sees all actions as being done only by nature, and sees the true self as the non-doer, sees rightly.
items.h: जो सम्पूर्ण क्रियाओंको सब प्रकारसे प्रकृतिके द्वारा ही की जाती हुई देखता है और अपनेआपको...

items.p: yada bhutaprithagbhavamekasthamanupashyati tata eva cha vistaram brahma sampadyate tada
items.e: When one sees all beings as rooted in one nature and all expansion arising from that source, one attains the supreme reality.
items.h: जिस कालमें साधक प्राणियोंके अलगअलग भावोंको एक प्रकृतिमें ही स्थित देखता है और उस...

items.p: anaditvannirgunatvatparamatmayamavyayah sharirasthopi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate
items.e: O son of Kunti, this supreme self is beginningless, beyond the gunas, and imperishable. Though abiding in the body, it does not act and is not...
items.h: हे कुन्तीनन्दन यह पुरुष स्वयं अनादि और गुणोंसे रहित होनेसे अविनाशी परमात्मस्वरूप ही है...

items.p: yatha sarvagatam saukshmyadakasham nopalipyate sarvatravasthito dehe tathatma nopalipyate
items.e: As all-pervading space is not tainted because of its subtlety, so the self, present in every body, is not tainted.
items.h: जैसे सब जगह व्याप्त आकाश अत्यन्त सूक्ष्म होनेसे कहीं भी लिप्त नहीं होता, ऐसे ही सब जगह...

items.p: yatha prakashayatyekah kritsnam lokamimam ravih kshetram kshetri tatha kritsnam prakashayati bharata
items.e: As one sun illuminates this whole world, so the knower of the field illuminates the whole field, O Bharata.
items.h: हे भरतवंशोद्भव अर्जुन जैसे एक ही सूर्य सम्पूर्ण संसारको प्रकाशित करता है, ऐसे ही क्षेत्री...

items.p: kshetrakshetragyayorevamantaram gyanachakshusha bhutaprakritimoksham cha ye viduryanti te param
items.e: In this way, those who know the distinction between the field and the knower of the field with the eye of wisdom, and who know release from the...
items.h: इस प्रकार जो ज्ञानरूपी नेत्रसे क्षेत्र और क्षेत्रज्ञके अन्तरविभाग को तथा कार्यकारणसहित...

items.p: param bhuyah pravakshyami gyananam gyanamuttamam yajgyatva munayah sarve param siddhimito gatah
items.e: The Blessed Lord said: I will speak again of the highest knowledge, the best of all knowledge. Knowing this, all sages have reached the supreme...
items.h: श्रीभगवान् बोले सम्पूर्ण ज्ञानोंमें उत्तम और पर ज्ञानको मैं फिर कहूँगा, जिसको जानकर...

items.p: idam gyanamupashritya mama sadharmyamagatah sargepi nopajayante pralaye na vyathanti cha
items.e: Having taken refuge in this knowledge, they attain my likeness. They are not born at creation, and they are not troubled at dissolution.
items.h: इस ज्ञानका आश्रय लेकर जो मनुष्य मेरी सधर्मताको प्राप्त हो गये हैं, वे महासर्गमें भी पैदा...

items.p: mama yonirmahadbrahma tasmin garbham dadhamyaham sambhavah sarvabhutanam tato bhavati bharata
items.e: O Bharata, my primal nature is the womb; I place the seed in it. From that, all beings are born.
items.h: हे भरतवंशोद्भव अर्जुन मेरी मूल प्रकृति तो उत्पत्तिस्थान है और मैं उसमें जीवरूप गर्भका...

items.p: sarvayonishu kaunteya murtayah sambhavanti yah tasam brahma mahadyoniraham bijapradah pita
items.e: O son of Kunti, in all forms of birth, the material nature is the womb, and I am the seed-giving father.
items.h: हे कुन्तीनन्दन सम्पूर्ण योनियोंमें प्राणियोंके जितने शरीर पैदा होते हैं, उन सबकी मूल...

items.p: sattvam rajastama iti gunah prakritisambhavah nibadhnanti mahabaho dehe dehinamavyayam
items.e: Arjuna, the three qualities of nature—sattva, rajas, and tamas—bind the imperishable inner being to the body.
items.h: हे महाबाहो प्रकृतिसे उत्पन्न होनेवाले सत्त्व, रज और तम ये तीनों गुण अविनाशी देहीको देहमें...

items.p: tatra sattvam nirmalatvatprakashakamanamayam sukhasangena badhnati gyanasangena chanagha
items.e: Among those qualities, sattva—because it is pure and luminous and free from affliction—binds the embodied being through attachment to happiness and...
items.h: हे पापरहित अर्जुन उन गुणोंमें सत्त्वगुण निर्मल स्वच्छ होनेके कारण प्रकाशक और निर्विकार है...

items.p: rajo ragatmakam viddhi trishnasangasamudbhavam tannibadhnati kaunteya karmasangena dehinam
items.e: Know rajas as passion-born, born of craving and attachment. It binds the embodied being through attachment to action, O son of Kunti.
items.h: हे कुन्तीनन्दन तृष्णा और आसक्तिको पैदा करनेवाले रजोगुणको तुम रागस्वरूप समझो । वह कर्मोंकी...

items.p: tamastvagyanajam viddhi mohanam sarvadehinam pramadalasyanidrabhistannibadhnati bharata
items.e: Arjuna, know tamas to be born of ignorance and deluding all embodied beings. It binds them through heedlessness, laziness, and sleep.
items.h: हे भरतवंशी अर्जुन सम्पूर्ण देहधारियोंको मोहित करनेवाले तमोगुणको तुम अज्ञानसे उत्पन्न...

items.s: सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत
items.p: sattvam sukhe sanjayati rajah karmani bharata gyanamavritya tu tamah pramade sanjayatyuta
items.e: Sattva binds through pleasure, rajas through action, and tamas, covering knowledge, binds through negligence.
items.h: हे भरतवंशोद्भव अर्जुन सत्त्वगुण सुखमें और रजोगुण कर्ममें लगाकर मनुष्यपर विजय करता है तथा...

items.p: rajastamashchabhibhuya sattvam bhavati bharata rajah sattvam tamashchaiva tamah sattvam rajastatha
items.e: Arjuna, when rajas and tamas are subdued, sattva rises. When sattva and tamas are subdued, rajas rises. When sattva and rajas are subdued, tamas...
items.h: हे भरतवंशोद्भव अर्जुन रजोगुण और तमोगुणको दबाकर सत्त्वगुण सत्त्वगुण, और तमोगुणको दबाकर...

items.p: sarvadvareshu dehesminprakasha upajayate gyanam yada tada vidyadvivriddham sattvamityuta
items.e: When light, clarity, and understanding arise in all the gates of this body, know that sattva has grown strong.
items.h: जब इस मनुष्यशरीरमें सब द्वारोंइन्द्रियों और अन्तःकरण में प्रकाश स्वच्छता और ज्ञान विवेक...
items.t: sattva gunas prakasha viveka inner clarity

items.p: lobhah pravrittirarambhah karmanamashamah spriha rajasyetani jayante vivriddhe bharatarshabha
items.e: O best of the Bharatas, when rajas grows, greed, activity, the beginning of actions, restlessness, and desire arise.
items.h: हे भरतवंशमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुन रजोगुणके बढ़नेपर लोभ, प्रवृत्ति, कर्मोंका आरम्भ, अशान्ति और...

items.p: aprakashopravrittishcha pramado moha eva cha tamasyetani jayante vivriddhe kurunandana
items.e: O descendant of Kuru, when tamas grows strong, darkness, inertia, negligence, and delusion arise.
items.h: हे कुरुनन्दन तमोगुणके बढ़नेपर अप्रकाश, अप्रवृत्ति, प्रमाद और मोह ये वृत्तियाँ भी पैदा...

items.s: यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत्
items.p: yada sattve pravriddhe tu pralayam yati dehabhrit tadottamavidam lokanamalanpratipadyate
items.e: When sattva is predominant at death, the embodied being reaches the pure worlds of the wise.
items.h: जिस समय सत्त्वगुण बढ़ा हो, उस समय यदि देहधारी मनुष्य मर जाता है, तो वह,उत्तमवेत्ताओंके...

items.p: rajasi pralayam gatva karmasangishu jayate tatha pralinastamasi mudhayonishu jayate
items.e: A being who dies in rajas is born among those attached to action. A being who dies in tamas is born among deluded forms.
items.h: रजोगुणके बढ़नेपर मरनेवाला प्राणी मनुष्ययोनिमें जन्म लेता है तथा तमोगुणके बढ़नेपर मरनेवाला...

items.p: karmanah sukritasyahuh sattvikam nirmalam phalam rajasastu phalam duhkhamagyanam tamasah phalam
items.e: The result of wholesome action is pure and clear; the result of rajasic action is suffering; the result of tamasic action is ignorance and delusion.
items.h: विवेकी पुरुषोंने शुभकर्मका तो सात्त्विक निर्मल फल कहा है, राजस कर्मका फल दुःख कहा है और...

items.s: सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च
items.p: sattvatsanjayate gyanam rajaso lobha eva cha pramadamohau tamaso bhavatogyanameva cha
items.e: From sattva comes knowledge; from rajas, greed; from tamas, negligence, delusion, and ignorance.
items.h: सत्त्वगुणसे ज्ञान और रजोगुणसे लोभ आदि ही उत्पन्न होते हैं तमोगुणसे प्रमाद, मोह एवं अज्ञान...

items.s: ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः
items.p: urdhvam gachchhanti sattvastha madhye tishthanti rajasah jaghanyagunavrittistha adho gachchhanti tamasah
items.e: Those established in sattva go upward; those in rajas remain in the middle; those in the lowest movement of tamas go downward.
items.h: सत्त्वगुणमें स्थित मनुष्य ऊर्ध्वलोकोंमें जाते हैं, रजोगुणमें स्थित मनुष्य मृत्युलोकमें...

items.p: nanyam gunebhyah kartaram yada drashtanupashyati gunebhyashcha param vetti madbhavam sodhigachchhati
items.e: When the seer understands that no doer exists apart from the three qualities, and knows the divine nature beyond them, that seer reaches my being.
items.h: जब विवेकी विचारकुशल मनुष्य तीनों गुणोंके सिवाय अन्य किसीको कर्ता नहीं देखता और अपनेको...

items.p: gunanetanatitya trindehi dehasamudbhavan janmamrityujaraduhkhairvimuktomritamashnute
items.e: The embodied one who rises beyond these three qualities, which arise from the body, is freed from birth, death, old age, and sorrow, and attains...
items.h: देहधारी विवेकी मनुष्य देहको उत्पन्न करनेवाले इन तीनों गुणोंका अतिक्रमण करके जन्म, मृत्यु...

items.p: kairlingaistringunanetanatito bhavati prabho kimacharah katham chaitanstringunanativartate
items.e: Arjuna said: O Lord, by what signs is a person known who has gone beyond these three qualities? How does such a person behave, and how does one cross...
items.h: अर्जुन बोले हे प्रभो इन तीनों गुणोंसे अतीत हुआ मनुष्य किन लक्षणोंसे युक्त होता है उसके...

items.s: प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव
items.p: prakasham cha pravrittim cha mohameva cha pandava na dveshti sampravrittani na nivrittani kankshati
items.e: Krishna said: O Arjuna, the one who has gone beyond the three gunas does not hate light, activity, or confusion when they appear, and does not long...
items.h: श्रीभगवान् बोले हे पाण्डव प्रकाश, प्रवृत्ति तथा मोह ये सभी अच्छी तरहसे प्रवृत्त हो जायँ...
items.t: gunas equanimity vairagya mohah inner states

items.p: udasinavadasino gunairyo na vichalyate guna vartanta ityeva yovatishthati nengate
items.e: One who remains like an indifferent witness, unmoved by the three qualities, stands firm and does not stir, knowing only that the qualities are...
items.h: जो उदासीनकी तरह स्थित है और जो गुणोंके द्वारा विचलित नहीं किया जा सकता तथा गुण ही...

items.p: samaduhkhasukhah svasthah samaloshtashmakanchanah tulyapriyapriyo dhirastulyanindatmasanstutih
items.e: The steady one remains equal in pleasure and pain, in a clod of earth, a stone, and gold; equal toward the liked and the disliked, toward praise and...
items.h: जो धीर मनुष्य सुखदुःखमें सम तथा अपने स्वरूपमें स्थित रहता है जो मिट्टीके ढेले, पत्थर और...

items.p: manapamanayostulyastulyo mitraripakshayoh sarvarambhaparityagi gunatitah sa uchyate
items.e: The steady one is equal in honor and dishonor, equal toward friend and foe, and has abandoned all undertakings. Such a person is called beyond the...
items.h: जो धीर मनुष्य सुखदुःखमें सम तथा अपने स्वरूपमें स्थित रहता है जो मिट्टीके ढेले, पत्थर और...

items.p: mam cha yovyabhicharena bhaktiyogena sevate sa gunansamatityaitan brahmabhuyaya kalpate
items.e: Whoever serves Me with unwavering devotion transcends these qualities and becomes fit for union with the supreme reality.

items.e: Freed from these three gates of darkness, a person acts for their own good and reaches the highest state.
items.h: हे कुन्तीनन्दन इन नरकके तीनों दरवाजोंसे रहित हुआ जो मनुष्य अपने कल्याणका आचरण करता है, वह...

items.p: yah shastravidhimutsrijya vartate kamakaratah na sa siddhimavapnoti na sukham na param gatim
items.e: Whoever sets aside scripture and acts on desire alone does not attain perfection, happiness, or the highest state.
items.h: जो मनुष्य शास्त्रविधिको छोड़कर अपनी इच्छासे मनमाना आचरण करता है, वह न सिद्धिअन्तःकरणकी...

items.p: tasmachchhastram pramanam te karyakaryavyavasthitau gyatva shastravidhanoktam karma kartumiharhasi
items.e: Therefore, scripture is your authority for deciding what should be done and what should not be done. Knowing the duties laid out in scripture, you...
items.h: अतः तेरे लिये कर्तव्यअकर्तव्यकी व्यवस्थामें शास्त्र ही प्रमाण है ऐसा जानकर तू इस लोकमें...

items.p: ye shastravidhimutsrijya yajante shraddhayanvitah tesham nishtha tu ka krishna sattvamaho rajastamah
items.e: Arjuna said: O Krishna, what is the standing of those who worship with faith while setting aside the rules of scripture? Is it sattvic, rajasic, or...
items.h: अर्जुन बोले हे कृष्ण जो मनुष्य शास्त्रविधिका त्याग करके श्रद्धापूर्वक देवता आदिका पूजन...
items.t: shraddha sattva-rajas-tamas scriptural authority worship inquiry

items.s: त्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा
items.p: trividha bhavati shraddha dehinam sa svabhavaja sattviki rajasi chaiva tamasi cheti tam shrrinu
items.e: The faith of embodied beings is born of their nature. It is of three kinds: sattvic, rajasic, and tamasic. Listen to this.
items.h: श्रीभगवान् बोले मनुष्योंकी वह स्वभावसे उत्पन्न हुई श्रद्धा सात्त्विकी तथा राजसी और तामसी...

items.p: sattvanurupa sarvasya shraddha bhavati bharata shraddhamayoyam purusho yo yachchhraddhah sa eva sah
items.e: O Bharata, each person's trust matches their inner nature. A person is made of trust; whatever trust he holds, that is what he becomes.
items.h: हे भारत सभी मनुष्योंकी श्रद्धा अन्तःकरणके अनुरूप होती है । यह मनुष्य श्रद्धामय है...
items.t: shraddha inner disposition character formation bhakti guna

items.p: yajante sattvika devanyaksharakshansi rajasah pretanbhutagananshchanye yajante tamasa janah
items.e: The sattvic worship radiant beings; the rajasic worship yakshas and rakshasas; the tamasic worship spirits and hosts of the dead.
items.h: सात्त्विक मनुष्य देवताओंका पूजन करते हैं, राजस मनुष्य यक्षों और राक्षसोंका और दूसरे जो...

items.s: अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः
items.p: ashastravihitam ghoram tapyante ye tapo janah dambhahankarasanyuktah kamaragabalanvitah
items.e: People who perform harsh austerities without scriptural guidance, driven by vanity, ego, desire, attachment, and stubbornness, are not purified by...
items.h: जो मनुष्य शास्त्रविधिसे रहित घोर तप करते हैं जो दम्भ और अहङ्कारसे अच्छी तरह युक्त हैं जो...

items.p: karshayantah sharirastham bhutagramamachetasah mam chaivantahsharirastham tanviddhyasuranishchayan
items.e: Those who are ignorant and perform terrible austerities without scriptural guidance, wasting away the body’s elements and Me dwelling within the...
items.h: जो मनुष्य शास्त्रविधिसे रहित घोर तप करते हैं जो दम्भ और अहङ्कारसे अच्छी तरह युक्त हैं जो...

items.p: aharastvapi sarvasya trividho bhavati priyah yagyastapastatha danam tesham bhedamimam shrrinu
items.e: Food, sacrifice, charity, and austerity are each of three kinds. Listen to these distinctions.
items.h: आहार भी सबको तीन प्रकारका प्रिय होता है और वैसे ही यज्ञ, दान और तप भी तीन प्रकारके होते...

items.p: ayuhsattvabalarogyasukhapritivivardhanah rasyah snigdhah sthira hridya aharah sattvikapriyah
items.e: Foods that increase life, purity, strength, health, happiness, and cheerfulness, and are tasty, smooth, firm, and pleasing, are dear to the sattvic...
items.h: आयु, सत्त्वगुण, बल, आरोग्य, सुख और प्रसन्नता बढ़ानेवाले, स्थिर रहनेवाले, हृदयको शक्ति...
items.t: sattvic food ahara diet discipline health clarity

items.p: katvamlalavanatyushnatikshnarukshavidahinah ahara rajasasyeshta duhkhashokamayapradah
items.e: Bitter, sour, salty, overly hot, pungent, dry, and burning foods are dear to the passionate person. They bring pain, grief, and illness.
items.h: अति कड़वे, अति खट्टे, अति नमकीन, अति गरम, अति तीखे, अति रूखे और अति दाहकारक आहार अर्थात्...

items.s: यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत्
items.p: yatayamam gatarasam puti paryushitam cha yat uchchhishtamapi chamedhyam bhojanam tamasapriyam
items.e: Food that is half-cooked, tasteless, foul-smelling, stale, leftover, and impure is dear to people ruled by tamas.
items.h: जो भोजन अधपका, रसरहित, दुर्गन्धित, बासी और उच्छिष्ट है तथा जो महान् अपवित्र भी है, वह...

items.p: aphalakankshibhiryagyo vidhidrishto ya ijyate yashtavyameveti manah samadhaya sa sattvikah
items.e: A sacrifice performed according to scriptural rule by people without desire for reward, with the mind settled on “it must be done,” is sattvic.
items.h: यज्ञ करना कर्तव्य है इस तरह मनको समाधान करके फलेच्छारहित मनुष्योंद्वारा जो शास्त्रविधिसे...

items.s: अभिसंधाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत्
items.p: abhisandhaya tu phalam dambharthamapi chaiva yat ijyate bharatashreshtha tam yagyam viddhi rajasam
items.e: But, best of the Bharatas, know that sacrifice to be rajasic when it is performed for reward or for show.
items.h: परन्तु हे भरतश्रेष्ठ अर्जुन जो यज्ञ फलकी इच्छाको लेकर अथवा दम्भदिखावटीपन के लिये भी किया...

items.p: vidhihinamasrishtannam mantrahinamadakshinam shraddhavirahitam yagyam tamasam parichakshate
items.e: They call a sacrifice dark when it lacks scriptural rule, food offering, mantra, fee, and trust.
items.h: शास्त्रविधिसे हीन, अन्नदानसे रहित, बिना मन्त्रोंके, बिना दक्षिणाके और बिना श्रद्धाके किये...

items.p: devadvijagurupragyapujanam shauchamarjavam brahmacharyamahinsa cha shariram tapa uchyate
items.e: Worship of the radiant beings, the wise, the teacher, and the enlightened; purity, simplicity, celibacy, and non-violence — these are called bodily...
items.h: देवता, ब्राह्मण, गुरुजन और जीवन्मुक्त महापुरुषका पूजन करना, शुद्धि रखना, सरलता...

items.s: अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत्
items.p: anudvegakaram vakyam satyam priyahitam cha yat svadhyayabhyasanam chaiva vanmayam tapa uchyate
items.e: Speech that does not agitate, is truthful, pleasant, and beneficial, together with study and practice, is called austerity of speech.
items.h: उद्वेग न करनेवाला, सत्य, प्रिय, हितकारक भाषण तथा स्वाध्याय और अभ्यास करना यह वाणीसम्बन्धी...

items.p: manahprasadah saumyatvam maunamatmavinigrahah bhavasanshuddhirityetattapo manasamuchyate
items.e: Serenity of mind, gentleness, silence, self-control, and purity of feeling are called mental austerity.
items.h: मनकी प्रसन्नता, सौम्य भाव, मननशीलता, मनका निग्रह और भावोंकी शुद्धि इस तरह यह मनसम्बन्धी...

items.p: shraddhaya paraya taptam tapastattrividham naraih aphalakankshibhiryuktaih sattvikam parichakshate
items.e: That threefold discipline of body, speech, and mind, performed with supreme trust and without craving results, is called sattvic.
items.h: परम श्रद्धासे युक्त फलेच्छारहित मनुष्योंके द्वारा तीन प्रकारशरीर, वाणी और मन का तप किया...

items.p: satkaramanapujartham tapo dambhena chaiva yat kriyate tadiha proktam rajasam chalamadhruvam
items.e: Austerity done for honor, praise, and worship, or with a show of display, is said to be rajasic here. It gives unstable, temporary results.
items.h: जो तप सत्कार, मान और पूजाके लिये तथा दिखानेके भावसे किया जाता है, वह इस लोकमें अनिश्चित...

items.p: mudhagrahenatmano yatpidaya kriyate tapah parasyotsadanartham va tattamasamudahritam
items.e: Austerity done with foolish stubbornness, by torturing oneself or harming others, is called tamasic.
items.h: जो तप मूढ़तापूर्वक हठसे अपनेको पीड़ा देकर अथवा दूसरोंको कष्ट देनेके लिये किया जाता है, वह...

items.p: datavyamiti yaddanam diyatenupakarine deshe kale cha patre cha taddanam sattvikam smritam
items.e: A gift given with the feeling that giving is a duty, offered to a worthy person at the right place and time, is called sattvic.
items.h: दान देना कर्तव्य है ऐसे भावसे जो दान देश, काल और पात्रके प्राप्त होनेपर अनुपकारीको दिया...

items.p: yattu pratyupakarartham phalamuddishya va punah diyate cha pariklishtam taddanam rajasam smritam
items.e: But charity given in return, or for a desired result, and given grudgingly, is said to be rajasic.
items.h: किन्तु जो दान प्रत्युपकारके लिये अथवा फलप्राप्तिका उद्देश्य बनाकर फिर क्लेशपूर्वक दिया...

items.p: adeshakale yaddanamapatrebhyashcha diyate asatkritamavagyatam tattamasamudahritam
items.e: Charity given at the wrong place and time, to an unworthy recipient, without respect and with contempt, is called tamasic.
items.h: जो दान बिना सत्कारके तथा अवज्ञापूर्वक अयोग्य देश और कालमें कुपात्रको दिया जाता है, वह दान...

items.p: tatsaditi nirdesho brahmanastrividhah smritah brahmanastena vedashcha yagyashcha vihitah pura
items.e: Om, Tat, and Sat are the three names by which the supreme reality is known. By that, the Vedas, the priests, and the sacrifices were established in...
items.h: ऊँ, तत् और सत् इन तीनों नामोंसे जिस परमात्माका निर्देश किया गया है, उसी परमात्माने...

items.p: tasmadomityudahritya yagyadanatapahkriyah pravartante vidhanoktah satatam brahmavadinam
items.e: Therefore, the ritual acts of sacrifice, charity, and austerity prescribed by scripture are always begun by uttering Om, for those who speak of...
items.h: इसलिये वैदिक सिद्धान्तोंको माननेवाले पुरुषोंकी शास्त्रविधिसे नियत यज्ञ, दान और तपरूप...

items.p: tadityanabhisandhaya phalam yagyatapahkriyah danakriyashcha vividhah kriyante mokshakankshi
items.e: Thinking “all this is for the supreme reality,” seekers of freedom perform many kinds of sacrifice, austerity, and giving without wanting the result.
items.h: तत् नामसे कहे जानेवाले परमात्माके लिये ही सब कुछ है ऐसा मानकर मुक्ति चाहनेवाले...

items.p: sadbhave sadhubhave cha sadityetatprayujyate prashaste karmani tatha sachchhabdah partha yujyate
items.e: O Partha, the word sat is used for existence itself, for noble being, and for praiseworthy action.
items.h: हे पार्थ परमात्माके सत्इस नामका सत्तामात्रमें और श्रेष्ठ भावमें प्रयोग किया जाता है तथा...

items.s: यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते
items.p: yagye tapasi dane cha sthitih saditi chochyate karma chaiva tadarthiyam sadityevabhidhiyate
items.e: Steadfastness in sacrifice, austerity, and giving is called sat. Action done for that purpose is also called sat.
items.h: यज्ञ, तप और दानरूप क्रियामें जो स्थिति निष्ठा है, वह भी सत् ऐसे कही जाती है और उस...

items.s: अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत्
items.p: ashraddhaya hutam dattam tapastaptam kritam cha yat asadityuchyate partha na cha tatpretya no iha
items.e: O Partha, sacrifice, charity, austerity, and any deed done without trust are called unreal. Its fruit exists neither here nor after death.
items.h: हे पार्थ अश्रद्धासे किया हुआ हवन, दिया हुआ दान और तपा हुआ तप तथा और भी जो,कुछ किया जाय...

items.p: sannyasasya mahabaho tattvamichchhami veditum tyagasya cha hrishikesha prithakkeshinishudana
items.e: Arjuna said: O mighty-armed one, O master of the senses, O slayer of Kesi, I wish to know the distinct truth of renunciation and relinquishment.
items.h: अर्जुन बोले हे महाबाहो हे हृषीकेश हे केशिनिषूदन मैं संन्यास और त्यागका तत्त्व अलगअलग...

items.s: काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः
items.p: kamyanam karmanam nyasam sannyasam kavayo viduh sarvakarmaphalatyagam prahustyagam vichakshanah
items.e: The wise call renunciation the giving up of desire-born actions. The discerning call renunciation the giving up of all results of action.

items.p: tyajyam doshavadityeke karma prahurmanishinah yagyadanatapahkarma na tyajyamiti chapare
items.e: Some wise people say all action should be abandoned as flawed. Others say sacrifice, giving, and disciplined effort should not be abandoned.
items.h: श्रीभगवान् बोले कई विद्वान् काम्यकर्मोंके त्यागको संन्यास कहते हैं और कई विद्वान्...

items.s: निश्चयं श्रृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम
items.p: nishchayam shrrinu me tatra tyage bharatasattama tyago hi purushavyaghra trividhah samprakirtitah
items.e: Arjuna, first hear my settled view on renunciation. Renunciation is said to be threefold.
items.h: हे भरतवंशियोंमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुन तू संन्यास और त्याग इन दोनोंमेंसे पहले त्यागके विषयमें...

items.p: yagyadanatapahkarma na tyajyam karyameva tat yagyo danam tapashchaiva pavanani manishinam
items.e: Sacrifice, giving, and disciplined effort should not be abandoned; they must be done. These three actions purify thoughtful people.
items.h: यज्ञ, दान और तपरूप कर्मोंका त्याग नहीं करना चाहिये, प्रत्युत उनको तो करना ही चाहिये...

items.s: एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च
items.p: etanyapi tu karmani sangam tyaktva phalani cha kartavyaniti me partha nishchitam matamuttamam
items.e: Even these actions, and all other actions, should be done without attachment and without wanting their results. This is my settled and best teaching...
items.h: हे पार्थ पूर्वोक्त यज्ञ, दान और तप इन कर्मोंको तथा दूसरे भी कर्मोंको आसक्ति और फलोंका...

items.p: niyatasya tu sannyasah karmano nopapadyate mohattasya parityagastamasah parikirtitah
items.e: Abandoning prescribed action is not right. Giving it up in confusion is called tamasic.
items.h: नियत कर्मका तो त्याग करना उचित नहीं है । उसका मोहपूर्वक त्याग करना तामस कहा गया है ॥

items.p: duhkhamityeva yatkarma kayakleshabhayattyajet sa kritva rajasam tyagam naiva tyagaphalam labhet
items.e: If someone gives up action thinking it is only suffering and fearing bodily strain, that renunciation is passionate, and it brings no fruit of...
items.h: जो कुछ कर्म है, वह दुःखरूप ही है ऐसा समझकर कोई शारीरिक क्लेशके भयसे उसका त्याग कर दे, तो...

items.p: karyamityeva yatkarma niyatam kriyaterjuna sangam tyaktva phalam chaiva sa tyagah sattviko matah
items.e: Arjuna, when fixed duty is done as only duty, without clinging to results, that renunciation is called sattvic.
items.h: हे अर्जुन केवल कर्तव्यमात्र करना है ऐसा समझकर जो नियत कर्म आसक्ति और फलका त्याग करके किया...
items.t: tyaga nishkama karma yoga attachment fixed duty

items.p: na dveshtyakushalam karma kushale nanushajjate tyagi sattvasamavishto medhavi chhinnasanshayah
items.e: One who neither rejects unwholesome action nor clings to wholesome action is a wise renunciate, free of doubt and established in clear seeing.
items.h: जो अकुशल कर्मसे द्वेष नहीं करता और कुशल कर्ममें आसक्त नहीं होता, वह त्यागी, बुद्धिमान्...

items.s: न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः
items.p: na hi dehabhrita shakyam tyaktum karmanyasheshatah yastu karmaphalatyagi sa tyagityabhidhiyate
items.e: For embodied beings, total renunciation of action is impossible. Therefore, one who renounces the fruits of action is called a renunciant.
items.h: कारण कि देहधारी मनुष्यके द्वारा सम्पूर्ण कर्मोंका त्याग करना सम्भव नहीं है । इसलिये जो...

items.s: अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम्
items.p: anishtamishtam mishram cha trividham karmanah phalam bhavatyatyaginam pretya na tu sannyasinam kvachit
items.e: For those who do not renounce the fruits of action, action produces three kinds of results—pleasant, unpleasant, and mixed—even after death; but for...
items.h: कर्मफलका त्याग न करनेवाले मनुष्योंको कर्मोंका इष्ट, अनिष्ट और मिश्रित ऐसे तीन प्रकारका फल...

items.p: panchaitani mahabaho karanani nibodha me sankhye kritante proktani siddhaye sarvakarmanam
items.e: O mighty-armed one, learn from Me these five causes, taught in the Sankhya system, for the accomplishment of all actions.
items.h: हे महाबाहो कर्मोंका अन्त करनेवाले सांख्यसिद्धान्तमें सम्पूर्ण कर्मोंकी सिद्धिके लिये ये...
items.t: sankhya karma five causes doership action analysis

items.s: अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम्
items.p: adhishthanam tatha karta karanam cha prithagvidham vividhashcha prithakcheshta daivam chaivatra panchamam
items.e: The field, the doer, the instruments, the many efforts, and the fifth factor, the unseen force, all shape every action.
items.h: इसमें कर्मोंकी सिद्धिमें अधिष्ठान तथा कर्ता और अनेक प्रकारके करण एवं विविध प्रकारकी...

items.p: shariravanmanobhiryatkarma prarabhate narah nyayyam va viparitam va panchaite tasya hetavah
items.e: Whatever action a person begins through body, speech, and mind—right or wrong—has these five causes.
items.h: मनुष्य, शरीर वाणी और मनके द्वारा शास्त्रविहित अथवा शास्त्रविरुद्ध जो कुछ भी कर्म आरम्भ...
items.t: five causes agency kartṛtva body-speech-mind sankhya

items.s: तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः
items.p: tatraivam sati kartaramatmanam kevalam tu yah pashyatyakritabuddhitvanna sa pashyati durmatih
items.e: But one who sees only the pure self as the doer, even though these five causes are present, has not seen rightly; such a confused mind does not...
items.h: परन्तु ऐसे पाँच हेतुओंके होनेपर भी जो उस कर्मोंके विषयमें केवल शुद्ध आत्माको कर्ता मानता...
items.t: kartā five causes akṛtabuddhi agency doership

items.s: यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते
items.p: yasya nahankrito bhavo buddhiryasya na lipyate hatvapi sa imanllokanna hanti na nibadhyate
items.e: One who has no sense of separate self and whose understanding remains unstained does not kill, even by killing all these beings, and is not bound.
items.h: जिसका अहंकृतभाव नहीं है और जिसकी बुद्धि लिप्त नहीं होती, वह इन सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंको मारकर...

items.p: gyanam gyeyam parigyata trividha karmachodana karanam karma karteti trividhah karmasangrahah
items.e: Knowledge, the object known, and the knower—these three drive action. Instrument, act, and actor—these three make up the whole of action.
items.h: ज्ञान, ज्ञेय और परिज्ञाता इन तीनोंसे कर्मप्रेरणा होती है तथा करण, कर्म और कर्ता इन...

items.s: ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः
items.p: gyanam karma cha karta cha tridhaiva gunabhedatah prochyate gunasankhyane yathavachchhrinu tanyapi
items.e: In the analysis of the three qualities, knowledge, action, and the doer are each said to be threefold. Listen now to these distinctions as they truly...
items.h: गुणसंख्यान गुणोंके सम्बन्धसे प्रत्येक पदार्थके भिन्नभिन्न भेदोंकी गणना करनेवाले...

items.p: sarvabhuteshu yenaikam bhavamavyayamikshate avibhaktam vibhakteshu tajgyanam viddhi sattvikam
items.e: Know that knowledge to be sattvic by which one sees the one imperishable reality in all beings, undivided among the divided.
items.h: जिस ज्ञानके द्वारा साधक सम्पूर्ण विभक्त प्राणियोंमें विभागरहित एक अविनाशी भावसत्ता को...

items.p: prithaktvena tu yajgyanam nanabhavanprithagvidhan vetti sarveshu bhuteshu tajgyanam viddhi rajasam
items.e: But know that knowledge as rajasic by which one sees many different beings as separate and distinct in all beings.
items.h: परन्तु जो ज्ञान अर्थात् जिस ज्ञानके द्वारा मनुष्य सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंमें अलगअलग अनेक...

items.p: yattu kritsnavadekasminkarye saktamahaitukam atattvarthavadalpam cha tattamasamudahritam
items.e: But knowledge that clings to one body as if it were the whole, without reason, without truth, and petty, is called dark.
items.h: किंतु जो ज्ञान एक कार्यरूप शरीरमें ही सम्पूर्णके तरह आसक्त है तथा जो युक्तिरहित, वास्तविक...

items.p: niyatam sangarahitamaragadveshatah kritam aphalaprepsuna karma yattatsattvikamuchyate
items.e: Action that is guided by duty, free from attachment, and done without craving results is called sattvic.
items.h: जो कर्म शास्त्रविधिसे नियत किया हुआ और कर्तृत्वाभिमानसे रहित हो तथा फलेच्छारहित मनुष्यके...

items.s: यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहङ्कारेण वा पुनः
items.p: yattu kamepsuna karma sahankarena va punah kriyate bahulayasam tadrajasamudahritam
items.e: But action done with desire for pleasure, or with ego, or with great strain, is said to be rajasic.
items.h: परन्तु जो कर्म भोगोंको चाहनेवाले मनुष्यके द्वारा अहंकार अथवा परिश्रमपूर्वक किया जाता है...

items.p: anubandham kshayam hinsamanapekshya cha paurusham mohadarabhyate karma yattattamasamuchyate
items.e: Action begun in delusion, ignoring its consequences, harm, and one’s own capacity, is called tamasic.
items.h: जो कर्म परिणाम, हानि, हिंसा और सामर्थ्यको न देखकर मोहपूर्वक आरम्भ किया जाता है, वह तामस...

items.p: muktasangonahanvadi dhrityutsahasamanvitah siddhyasiddhyornirvikarah karta sattvika uchyate
items.e: The doer who is free from attachment, free from ego, endowed with steadiness and enthusiasm, and unchanged by success or failure is called sattvic.
items.h: जो कर्ता रागरहित, अनहंवादी, धैर्य और उत्साहयुक्त तथा सिद्धि और असिद्धिमें निर्विकार है...

items.p: ragi karmaphalaprepsurlubdho hinsatmakoshuchih harshashokanvitah karta rajasah parikirtitah
items.e: The doer ruled by craving, chasing results, greedy, violent in nature, impure, and tossed by joy and sorrow is called passionate.
items.h: जो कर्ता रागी, कर्मफलकी इच्छावाला, लोभी, हिंसाके स्वभाववाला, अशुद्ध और हर्षशोकसे युक्त...

items.p: ayuktah prakritah stabdhah shatho naishkritikolasah vishadi dirghasutri cha karta tamasa uchyate
items.e: A careless, crude, stubborn, deceitful, lazy, gloomy, and procrastinating doer is called tamasic.
items.h: जो कर्ता असावधान, अशिक्षित, ऐंठअकड़वाला, जिद्दी, उपकारीका अपकार करनेवाला, आलसी, विषादी और...

items.p: buddherbhedam dhriteshchaiva gunatastrividham shrrinu prochyamanamasheshena prithaktvena dhananjaya
items.e: O Dhananjaya, now hear the threefold distinctions of understanding and steadfastness according to the three qualities, fully and separately explained.
items.h: हे धनञ्जय अब तू गुणोंके अनुसार बुद्धि और धृतिके भी तीन प्रकारके भेद अलगअलगरूपसे सुन, जो...

items.s: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये
items.p: pravrittim cha nivrittim cha karyakarye bhayabhaye bandham moksham cha ya vetti buddhih sa partha sattviki
items.e: O Partha, the intellect that knows what leads forward and what withdraws, what should be done and not done, what is fear and fearlessness, what binds...
items.h: हे पृथानन्दन जो बुद्धि प्रवृत्ति और निवृत्तिको, कर्तव्य और अकर्तव्यको, भय और अभयको तथा...

items.s: यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च
items.p: yaya dharmamadharmam cha karyam chakaryameva cha ayathavatprajanati buddhih sa partha rajasi
items.e: Arjuna, the intellect that does not truly know right action and wrong action, duty and what should not be done, is rajasic.
items.h: हे पार्थ मनुष्य जिसके द्वारा धर्म और अधर्मको, कर्तव्य और अकर्तव्यको भी ठीक तरहसे नहीं...

items.p: adharmam dharmamiti ya manyate tamasavrita sarvarthanviparitanshcha buddhih sa partha tamasi
items.e: The mind covered by darkness calls wrongdoing right and reverses everything.
items.h: हे पृथानन्दन तमोगुणसे घिरी हुई जो बुद्धि अधर्मको धर्म और सम्पूर्ण चीजोंको उलटा मान लेती...

items.p: dhritya yaya dharayate manahpranendriyakriyah yogenavyabhicharinya dhritih sa partha sattviki
items.e: O Partha, that steadfastness by which one holds steady the functions of mind, life-force, and senses through unwavering yoga is sattvic steadfastness.
items.h: हे पार्थ समतासे युक्त जिस अव्यभिचारिणी धृतिके द्वारा मनुष्य मन, प्राण और इन्द्रियोंकी...

items.p: yaya tu dharmakamarthan dhritya dharayaterjuna prasangena phalakankshi dhritih sa partha rajasi
items.e: Arjuna, the steadiness that clings intensely to duty, pleasure, and wealth, while craving results, is passionate steadiness.
items.h: हे पृथानन्दन अर्जुन फलकी इच्छावाला मनुष्य जिस धृतिके द्वारा धर्म, काम भोग और अर्थको...

items.s: यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च
items.p: yaya svapnam bhayam shokam vishadam madameva cha na vimunchati durmedha dhritih sa partha tamasi
items.e: The dull-minded one does not let go of sleep, fear, grief, sorrow, and pride. That steadfastness is tamasic, Arjuna.
items.h: हे पार्थ दुष्ट बुद्धिवाला मनुष्य जिस धृतिके द्वारा निद्रा, भय, चिन्ता, दुःख और घमण्डको भी...

items.s: सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं श्रृणु मे भरतर्षभ
items.p: sukham tvidanim trividham shrrinu me bharatarshabha abhyasadramate yatra duhkhantam cha nigachchhati
items.e: O best of the Bharatas, hear from me now about three kinds of happiness. The happiness that comes from practice, ends sorrow, and first feels like...
items.h: हे भरतवंशियोंमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुन अब तीन प्रकारके सुखको भी तुम मेरेसे सुनो । जिसमें...

items.p: yattadagre vishamiva parinamemritopamam tatsukham sattvikam proktamatmabuddhiprasadajam
items.e: That happiness is called sattvic, which seems like poison at first and like nectar in the end, born from clarity of the discerning mind and the peace...
items.h: हे भरतवंशियोंमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुन अब तीन प्रकारके सुखको भी तुम मेरेसे सुनो । जिसमें...

items.p: vishayendriyasanyogadyattadagremritopamam pariname vishamiva tatsukham rajasam smritam
items.e: The pleasure that begins like nectar from contact between the senses and their objects, but ends like poison, is called rajasic pleasure.
items.h: जो सुख इन्द्रियों और विषयोंके संयोगसे आरम्भमें अमृतकी तरह और परिणाममें विषकी तरह होता है...

items.p: yadagre chanubandhe cha sukham mohanamatmanah nidralasyapramadottham tattamasamudahritam
items.e: That pleasure, born of sleep, laziness, and negligence, deludes the self at the beginning and at the end; it is called tamasic.
items.h: निद्रा, आलस्य और प्रमादसे उत्पन्न होनेवाला जो सुख आरम्भमें और परिणाममें अपनेको मोहित...

items.s: न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः
items.p: na tadasti prithivyam va divi deveshu va punah sattvam prakritijairmuktam yadebhih syattribhirgunaih
items.e: There is nothing on earth, in heaven, or among the radiant beings that is free from the three qualities born of nature.
items.h: पृथ्वीमें या स्वर्गमें अथवा देवताओंमें तथा इनके सिवाय और कहीं भी वह ऐसी कोई वस्तु नहीं...
items.t: triguna prakriti sattva-rajas-tamas conditioned nature field of action

items.p: brahmanakshatriyavisham shudranam cha parantapa karmani pravibhaktani svabhavaprabhavairgunaih
items.e: O scorcher of foes, the duties of priests, warriors, merchants, and workers are divided according to the qualities born of their nature.
items.h: हे परंतप ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, वैश्य और शूद्रोंके कर्म स्वभावसे उत्पन्न हुए तीनों गुणोंके...

items.p: shamo damastapah shaucham kshantirarjavameva cha gyanam vigyanamastikyam brahmakarma svabhavajam
items.e: Self-restraint, control of the senses, austerity, purity, forgiveness, honesty, knowledge, realization, and faith in the supreme reality are the...
items.h: मनका निग्रह करना इन्द्रियोंको वशमें करना धर्मपालनके लिये कष्ट सहना बाहरभीतरसे शुद्ध रहना...

items.p: shauryam tejo dhritirdakshyam yuddhe chapyapalayanam danamishvarabhavashcha kshatram karma svabhavajam
items.e: Valor, radiance, firmness, quick skill, never fleeing in battle, generosity, and leadership are the natural duties of a warrior.
items.h: शूरवीरता, तेज, धैर्य, प्रजाके संचालन आदिकी विशेष चतुरता, युद्धमें कभी पीठ न दिखाना, दान...

items.p: krishigaurakshyavanijyam vaishyakarma svabhavajam paricharyatmakam karma shudrasyapi svabhavajam
items.e: Farming, cattle-keeping, and trade are the natural work of the merchant class. Service to others is the natural work of the worker class.
items.h: खेती करना, गायोंकी रक्षा करना और शुद्ध व्यापार करना ये सबकेसब वैश्यके स्वाभाविक कर्म हैं...

items.s: स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः
items.p: sve sve karmanyabhiratah sansiddhim labhate narah svakarmaniratah siddhim yatha vindati tachchhrinu
items.e: A person devoted to their own work attains perfection. Listen as I explain how a person devoted to their own work reaches that perfection.
items.h: अपनेअपने कर्ममें तत्परतापूर्वक लगा हुआ मनुष्य सम्यक् सिद्धिपरमात्माको प्राप्त कर लेता है...

items.p: yatah pravrittirbhutanam yena sarvamidam tatam svakarmana tamabhyarchya siddhim vindati manavah
items.e: By worshipping the one from whom all beings arise and by whom this whole world is pervaded, a person attains perfection through their own work.
items.h: जिस परमात्मासे सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंकी उत्पत्ति होती है और जिससे यह सम्पूर्ण संसार व्याप्त...

items.p: shreyansvadharmo vigunah paradharmatsvanushthitat svabhavaniyatam karma kurvannapnoti kilbisham
items.e: One's own duty, though imperfect, is better than another's duty well performed. Doing the work set by one's nature, a person does not incur...
items.h: अच्छी तरहसे अनुष्ठान किये हुए परधर्मसे गुणरहित अपना धर्म श्रेष्ठ है । कारण कि स्वभावसे...

items.s: सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत्
items.p: sahajam karma kaunteya sadoshamapi na tyajet sarvarambha hi doshena dhumenagnirivavritah
items.e: O son of Kunti, one should not abandon one's natural duty, even if it has flaws. All undertakings are clouded by some defect, just as fire is veiled...
items.h: हे कुन्तीनन्दन दोषयुक्त होनेपर भी सहज कर्मका त्याग नहीं करना चाहिये क्योंकि सम्पूर्ण कर्म...

items.p: asaktabuddhih sarvatra jitatma vigatasprihah naishkarmyasiddhim paramam sannyasenadhigachchhati
items.e: One whose mind is detached everywhere, who has mastered the self, and who is free from craving attains the highest perfection of non-action through...
items.h: जिसकी बुद्धि सब जगह आसक्तिरहित है, जिसने शरीरको वशमें कर रखा है, जो स्पृहारहित है, वह...

items.s: सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे
items.p: siddhim prapto yatha brahma tathapnoti nibodha me samasenaiva kaunteya nishtha gyanasya ya para
items.e: Listen to me briefly, O Arjuna, as I explain how one who has reached perfection attains the supreme reality, the highest culmination of knowledge.
items.h: हे कौन्तेय सिद्धिअन्तःकरणकी शुद्धि को प्राप्त हुआ साधक ब्रह्मको, जो कि ज्ञानकी परा निष्ठा...

items.s: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्याऽऽत्मानं नियम्य च
items.p: buddhya vishuddhaya yukto dhrityatmanam niyamya cha shabdadin vishayanstyaktva ragadveshau vyudasya cha
items.e: Endowed with purified understanding, holding the self steady with firm resolve, giving up sense-objects, and casting away attraction and aversion...
items.h: जो विशुद्ध सात्त्विकी बुद्धिसे युक्त, वैराग्यके आश्रित, एकान्तका सेवन करनेवाला और नियमित...

items.p: viviktasevi laghvashi yatavakkayamanasah dhyanayogaparo nityam vairagyam samupashritah
items.e: Dwelling in solitude, eating lightly, and controlling speech, body, and mind, one stays absorbed in meditation, grounded in non-attachment.
items.h: जो विशुद्ध सात्त्विकी बुद्धिसे युक्त, वैराग्यके आश्रित, एकान्तका सेवन करनेवाला और नियमित...

items.s: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्
items.p: ahankaram balam darpam kamam krodham parigraham vimuchya nirmamah shanto brahmabhuyaya kalpate
items.e: Free from ego, force, pride, desire, anger, and possession, one becomes peaceful, without “mine,” and fit for union with the supreme reality.
items.h: जो विशुद्ध सात्त्विकी बुद्धिसे युक्त, वैराग्यके आश्रित, एकान्तका सेवन करनेवाला और नियमित...

items.s: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति
items.p: brahmabhutah prasannatma na shochati na kankshati samah sarveshu bhuteshu madbhaktim labhate param
items.e: One who has become Brahman, serene in mind, grieves not and desires not. Equal toward all beings, that person attains supreme devotion to Me.
items.h: वह ब्रह्मभूतअवस्थाको प्राप्त प्रसन्न मनवाला साधक न तो किसीके लिये शोक करता है और न किसीकी...

items.p: bhaktya mamabhijanati yavanyashchasmi tattvatah tato mam tattvato gyatva vishate tadanantaram
items.e: Through devoted love, one truly knows Me as I am. Knowing Me in truth, one enters into Me at once.
items.h: उस पराभक्तिसे मेरेको, मैं जितना हूँ और जो हूँ इसको तत्त्वसे जान लेता है तथा मेरेको...

items.p: sarvakarmanyapi sada kurvano madvyapashrayah matprasadadavapnoti shashvatam padamavyayam
items.e: A devotee who takes refuge in me, while always doing all actions, attains the eternal, imperishable state through my grace.
items.h: मेरा आश्रय लेनेवाला भक्त सदा सब कर्म करता हुआ भी मेरी कृपासे शाश्वत अविनाशी पदको प्राप्त...

items.p: chetasa sarvakarmani mayi sannyasya matparah buddhiyogamupashritya machchittah satatam bhava
items.e: With your mind, surrender all actions to Me. Take refuge in the discipline of clear understanding and remain constantly focused on Me.
items.h: चित्तसे सम्पूर्ण कर्म मुझमें अर्पण करके, मेरे परायण होकर तथा समताका आश्रय लेकर निरन्तर...

items.p: machchittah sarvadurgani matprasadattarishyasi atha chettvamahankaranna shroshyasi vinankshyasi
items.e: Centered in me, you will cross all obstacles through my grace. But if you do not listen because of ego, you will fall.
items.h: मेरेमें चित्तवाला होकर तू मेरी कृपासे सम्पूर्ण विघ्नोंको तर जायगा और यदि तू अहंकारके कारण...

items.p: yadahankaramashritya na yotsya iti manyase mithyaisha vyavasayaste prakritistvam niyokshyati
items.e: Relying on ego, you think, 'I will not fight.' That resolve is false; your nature will drive you into battle.
items.h: अहंकारका आश्रय लेकर तू जो ऐसा मान रहा है कि मैं युद्ध नहीं करूँगा, तेरा यह निश्चय मिथ्या...

items.p: svabhavajena kaunteya nibaddhah svena karmana kartum nechchhasi yanmohatkarishyasyavashopi tat
items.e: Bound by your own nature-born duty, you will do what you do not want to do in confusion. Even against your will, you will act.
items.h: हे कुन्तीनन्दन अपने स्वभावजन्य कर्मसे बँधा हुआ तू मोहके कारण जो नहीं करना चाहता, उसको तू...

items.p: ishvarah sarvabhutanam hriddesherjuna tishthati bhramayansarvabhutani yantrarudhani mayaya
items.e: O Arjuna, the Lord abides in the heart of all beings and, by His maya, causes all beings mounted on a body-machine to revolve according to their...
items.h: हे अर्जुन ईश्वर सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके हृदयमें रहता है और अपनी मायासे शरीररूपी यन्त्रपर...

items.p: tameva sharanam gachchha sarvabhavena bharata tatprasadatparam shantim sthanam prapsyasi shashvatam
items.e: Surrender to the divine with your whole being, Arjuna. By that grace, you will reach supreme peace and the eternal abode.
items.h: हे भरतवंशोद्भव अर्जुन तू सर्वभावसे उस ईश्वरकी ही शरणमें चला जा । उसकी कृपासे तू...

items.p: iti te gyanamakhyatam guhyadguhyataram maya vimrishyaitadasheshena yathechchhasi tatha kuru
items.e: Thus I have explained to you the most secret wisdom. Reflect on it fully, and then do as you wish.
items.h: यह गुह्यसे भी गुह्यतर शरणागतिरूप ज्ञान मैंने तुझे कह दिया । अब तू इसपर अच्छी तरहसे विचार...

items.s: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः श्रृणु मे परमं वचः
items.p: sarvaguhyatamam bhuyah shrrinu me paramam vachah ishtosi me dridhamiti tato vakshyami te hitam
items.e: Listen again to My most secret word. You are dear to Me, so I will speak for your good.
items.h: सबसे अत्यन्त गोपनीय वचन तू फिर मेरेसे सुन । तू मेरा अत्यन्त प्रिय है, इसलिये मैं तेरे...

items.s: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु
items.p: manmana bhava madbhakto madyaji mam namaskuru mamevaishyasi satyam te pratijane priyosi me
items.e: Fix your mind on me, become my devotee, worship me, and bow to me. You will come to me; I promise you this truly, because you are dear to me.
items.h: तू मेरा भक्त हो जा, मेरेमें मनवाला हो जा, मेरा पूजन करनेवाला हो जा और मेरेको नमस्कार कर...

items.p: sarvadharmanparityajya mamekam sharanam vraja aham tva sarvapapebhyo mokshayishyami ma shuchah
items.e: Abandon all duties and take refuge in Me alone. I will free you from all wrongdoing; do not grieve.
items.h: सम्पूर्ण धर्मोंका आश्रय छोड़कर तू केवल मेरी शरणमें आ जा । मैं तुझे सम्पूर्ण पापोंसे मुक्त...
items.a: sarva dharman parityajya | sarvadharman parityajya | mam ekam sharanam vraja

items.p: idam te natapaskaya nabhaktaya kadachana na chashushrushave vachyam na cha mam yobhyasuyati
items.e: Never speak this to one without discipline, one without devotion, one unwilling to listen, or one who finds fault with me.
items.h: यह सर्वगुह्यतम वचन अतपस्वीको मत कहना अभक्तको कभी मत कहना जो सुनना नहीं चाहता, उसको मत...

items.p: ya imam paramam guhyam madbhakteshvabhidhasyati bhaktim mayi param kritva mamevaishyatyasanshayah
items.e: Whoever shares this supreme secret among my devotees, with devoted love for me, will surely come to me without doubt.
items.h: मेरेमें पराभक्ति करके जो इस परम गोपनीय संवादगीताग्रन्थ को मेरे भक्तोंमें कहेगा, वह मुझे...

items.p: na cha tasmanmanushyeshu kashchinme priyakrittamah bhavita na cha me tasmadanyah priyataro bhuvi
items.e: Among all human beings, no one does what is more dear to me than he does. On this earth, no one will ever be dearer than he is.
items.h: उसके समान मेरा अत्यन्त प्रिय कार्य करनेवाला मनुष्योंमें कोई भी नहीं है और इस भूमण्डलपर...

items.s: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः
items.p: adhyeshyate cha ya imam dharmyam sanvadamavayoh gyanayagyena tenahamishtah syamiti me matih
items.e: Whoever studies this sacred dialogue of ours will also worship me through the sacrifice of knowledge; that is my view.
items.h: जो मनुष्य हम दोनोंके इस धर्ममय संवादका अध्ययन करेगा, उसके द्वारा भी मैं ज्ञानयज्ञसे पूजित...
items.t: jnana-yajna sacred dialogue study as worship chapter 18 krishna-arjuna

items.p: shraddhavananasuyashcha shrrinuyadapi yo narah sopi muktah shubhanllokanprapnuyatpunyakarmanam
items.e: Even a person who listens to this with trust and without fault-finding becomes free and reaches the auspicious realms earned by noble action.
items.h: श्रद्धावान् और दोषदृष्टिसे रहित जो मनुष्य इस गीताग्रन्थको सुन भी लेगा, वह भी सम्पूर्ण...

items.p: kachchidetachchhrutam partha tvayaikagrena chetasa kachchidagyanasammohah pranashtaste dhananjaya
items.e: O Partha, have you heard this with one-pointed mind? O Dhananjaya, has the delusion born of ignorance been destroyed in you?
items.h: हे पृथानन्दन क्या तुमने एकाग्रचित्तसे इसको सुना और हे धनञ्जय क्या तुम्हारा अज्ञानसे...

items.p: nashto mohah smritirlabdha tvatprasadanmayachyuta sthitosmi gatasandehah karishye vachanam tava
items.e: Arjuna said: By your grace, O Achyuta, my delusion is destroyed and memory restored. I stand free of doubt and will do what you say.
items.h: अर्जुन बोले हे अच्युत आपकी कृपासे मेरा मोह नष्ट हो गया है और स्मृति प्राप्त हो गयी है...

items.p: ityaham vasudevasya parthasya cha mahatmanah sanvadamimamashraushamadbhutam romaharshanam
items.e: Sanjaya said: Thus I heard this wondrous, hair-raising dialogue between Vasudeva and the great-souled Partha.
items.h: सञ्जय बोले इस प्रकार मैंने भगवान् वासुदेव और महात्मा पृथानन्दन अर्जुनका यह रोमाञ्चित...

items.p: vyasaprasadachchhrutavanetadguhyamaham param yogam yogeshvaratkrishnatsakshatkathayatah svayam
items.e: By Vyasa's grace, I heard this supreme secret yoga directly from Krishna, the Lord of yoga, as he spoke it himself.
items.h: व्यासजीकी कृपासे मैंने स्वयं इस परम गोपनीय योग गीताग्रन्थ को कहते हुए साक्षात् योगेश्वर...

items.p: rajansansmritya sansmritya sanvadamimamadbhutam keshavarjunayoh punyam hrishyami cha muhurmuhuh
items.e: O King, remembering again and again this wondrous, holy dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna, I rejoice again and again.
items.h: हे राजन् भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण और अर्जुनके इस पवित्र और अद्भुत संवादको याद करकरके मैं बारबार...

items.p: tachcha sansmritya sansmritya rupamatyadbhutam hareh vismayo me mahan rajan hrishyami cha punah punah
items.e: Remembering that astonishing form of Krishna again and again, I feel great wonder, O King, and I rejoice again and again.
items.h: हे राजन् भगवान् श्रीकृष्णके उस अत्यन्त अद्भुत विराट्रूपको याद करकरके मेरेको बड़ा भारी...

items.s: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः
items.p: yatra yogeshvarah krishno yatra partho dhanurdharah tatra shrirvijayo bhutirdhruva nitirmatirmama
items.e: Where Krishna, the master of yoga, is present, and where Arjuna, the bow-bearer, is present, there are prosperity, victory, glory, and firm justice...
items.h: जहाँ योगेश्वर भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण हैं और जहाँ गाण्डीवधनुषधारी अर्जुन हैं, वहाँ ही श्री...
items.a: yatra yogeshvarah krishno | yatra yogeshwarah krishno

items.p: katham gyanamavapnoti katham muktirbhavishyati vairagyam cha katham praptametad bruhi mama prabho
items.e: How does one come to know? How does freedom come about? And how is dispassion reached? Tell me this, my lord.

items.p: muktimichchhasi chettata vishayan vishavattyaja kshamarjavadayatoshasatyam piyushavad bhaja
items.e: If you want freedom, my child, leave the objects of the senses as you would leave poison. Take forgiveness, honesty, kindness, contentment and truth...

items.s: न पृथ्वी न जलं नाग्निर्न वायुर्द्यौर्न वा भवान्
items.p: na prithvi na jalam nagnirna vayurdyaurna va bhavan esham sakshinamatmanam chidrupam viddhi muktaye
items.e: You are not earth, water, fire, air or space. To be free, know yourself as the witness of all these, made of awareness.

items.s: यदि देहं पृथक् कृत्य चिति विश्राम्य तिष्ठसि
items.p: yadi deham prithak kritya chiti vishramya tishthasi adhunaiva sukhi shanto bandhamukto bhavishyasi
items.e: If you set the body apart and rest in awareness, you will be happy, at peace and free of bondage this very moment.

items.s: न त्वं विप्रादिको वर्णो नाश्रमी नाक्षगोचरः
items.p: na tvam vipradiko varno nashrami nakshagocharah asangosi nirakaro vishvasakshi sukhi bhava
items.e: You are not a Brahmin or of any other varna, you belong to no stage of life, and you are nothing the eyes can see. Unattached and formless, you are...

items.s: धर्माधर्मौ सुखं दुःखं मानसानि न ते विभो
items.p: dharmadharmau sukham duhkham manasani na te vibho na kartasi na bhoktasi mukta evasi sarvada
items.e: Right and wrong, pleasure and pain belong to the mind. They are not yours, all-pervading one. You are not the doer and not the one who enjoys. You...

items.p: eko drashtasi sarvasya muktaprayosi sarvada ayameva hi te bandho drashtaram pashyasitaram
items.e: You are the one seer of all, and you have always been free. Your only bondage is this: you see the seer as someone else.

items.p: aham kartetyahammanamahakrishnahidanshitah naham karteti vishvasamritam pitva sukhi bhava
items.e: You have been bitten by the great black snake of the thought 'I am the doer'. Drink the nectar of trust in 'I am not the doer', and be happy.

items.p: eko vishuddhabodhohamiti nishchayavahnina prajvalyagyanagahanam vitashokah sukhi bhava
items.e: 'I am the one pure awareness': let this certainty be a fire that burns down the forest of not knowing. Then be free of grief, and be happy.

items.p: yatra vishvamidam bhati kalpitam rajjusarpavat anandaparamanandah sa bodhastvam sukham bhava
items.e: That in which this world appears, imagined like a snake on a rope, that joy beyond joy, that awareness: you are that. Be happy.

items.p: muktabhimani mukto hi baddho baddhabhimanyapi kinvadantiha satyeyam ya matih sa gatirbhavet
items.e: One who thinks 'I am free' is free. One who thinks 'I am bound' stays bound. The old saying is true: as you hold yourself, so you become.

items.s: आत्मा साक्षी विभुः पूर्ण एको मुक्तश्चिदक्रियः
items.p: atma sakshi vibhuh purna eko muktashchidakriyah asango nihsprihah shanto bhramatsansaravaniva
items.e: The Self is the witness: all-pervading, whole, one, free, awareness itself, without action, unattached, without wanting, at peace. Only through error...

items.p: kutastham bodhamadvaitamatmanam paribhavaya abhasoham bhramam muktva bhavam bahyamathantaram
items.e: Meditate on the Self as unchanging awareness, one without a second. Let go of the mistaken idea that you are a reflection, and of every sense of...

items.p: dehabhimanapashena chiram baddhosi putraka bodhoham gyanakhadgena tannikritya sukhi bhava
items.e: My child, you have long been tied by the rope of 'I am the body'. Cut it with the sword of knowing 'I am awareness', and be happy.

items.p: nihsango nishkriyosi tvam svaprakasho niranjanah ayameva hi te bandhah samadhimanutishthati
items.e: You are unattached and without action, shining by your own light, without stain. This is your bondage: you keep practising samadhi.

items.s: त्वया व्याप्तमिदं विश्वं त्वयि प्रोतं यथार्थतः
items.p: tvaya vyaptamidam vishvam tvayi protam yatharthatah shuddhabuddhasvarupastvam ma gamah kshudrachittatam
items.e: In truth this world is pervaded by you and strung on you. Your nature is pure awareness. Do not fall into smallness of mind.

items.p: nirapeksho nirvikaro nirbharah shitalashayah agadhabuddhirakshubdho bhava chinmatravasanah
items.e: Need nothing, change not, be full and cool at heart, deep in understanding and unshaken. Let your one leaning be toward awareness alone.

items.p: sakaramanritam viddhi nirakaram tu nishchalam etattattvopadeshena na punarbhavasambhavah
items.e: Know that what has form is unreal and what is formless is unmoving. Taught this truth, you do not come back to birth.

items.p: yathaivadarshamadhyasthe rupentah paritastu sah tathaivasmin sharirentah paritah parameshvarah
items.e: As a mirror is present inside the image it holds and all around it, so the Supreme Lord is present inside this body and all around it.

items.p: ekam sarvagatam vyoma bahirantaryatha ghate nityam nirantaram brahma sarvabhutagane tatha
items.e: As one all-pervading space is inside a pot and outside it, so Brahman, eternal and unbroken, is in every being.

items.s: अहो निरञ्जनः शान्तो बोधोऽहं प्रकृतेः परः
items.p: aho niranjanah shanto bodhoham prakriteh parah etavantamaham kalam mohenaiva vidambitah
items.e: How strange. I am spotless, at peace, awareness itself, beyond nature. All this time I have been fooled by delusion.

items.p: yatha prakashayamyeko dehamenam tatha jagat ato mama jagatsarvamathava na cha kinchana
items.e: As I alone light up this body, so I light up the world. So the whole world is mine, or nothing is.

items.p: sa shariramaho vishvam parityajya mayadhuna kutashchit kaushalad eva paramatma vilokyate
items.e: Now that I have let go of the world along with the body, through some skill in the teaching I see the supreme Self.

items.p: yatha na toyato bhinnastarangah phenabudbudah atmano na tatha bhinnam vishvamatmavinirgatam
items.e: Waves, foam and bubbles are not different from water. In the same way the world, which comes out of the Self, is not different from the Self.

items.s: तन्तुमात्रो भवेद् एव पटो यद्वद् विचारितः
items.p: tantumatro bhaved eva pato yadvad vicharitah atmatanmatramevedam tadvad vishvam vicharitam
items.e: Looked at closely, a cloth is only thread. Looked at closely in the same way, this world is only the Self.

items.p: yathaivekshurase klripta tena vyaptaiva sharkara tatha vishvam mayi klriptam maya vyaptam nirantaram
items.e: As sugar made from cane juice is filled with that juice, so the world, imagined in me, is filled with me through and through.

items.p: atmagyanajjagad bhati atmagyananna bhasate rajjvagyanadahirbhati tajgyanad bhasate na hi
items.e: When the Self is not known, the world appears. When the Self is known, it does not. When the rope is not known, a snake appears. When it is known...

items.s: प्रकाशो मे निजं रूपं नातिरिक्तोऽस्म्यहं ततः
items.p: prakasho me nijam rupam natiriktosmyaham tatah yada prakashate vishvam tadaham bhasa eva hi
items.e: Light is my own form. I am nothing other than that. When the world shines, it is I who shine.

items.p: aho vikalpitam vishvamagyananmayi bhasate rupyam shuktau phani rajjau vari suryakare yatha
items.e: How strange. Through not knowing, the imagined world appears in me, like silver in a shell, a snake in a rope, water in the sun's glare.

items.p: matto vinirgatam vishvam mayyeva layameshyati mridi kumbho jale vichih kanake katakam yatha
items.e: The world came out of me and will dissolve back into me, as a pot into clay, a wave into water, a bracelet into gold.

items.s: अहो अहं नमो मह्यं विनाशो यस्य नास्ति मे
items.p: aho aham namo mahyam vinasho yasya nasti me brahmadistambaparyantam jagannashopi tishthatah
items.e: How wonderful I am. I bow to myself. I do not perish. Even when the whole world, from Brahma down to a blade of grass, perishes, I remain.

items.p: aho aham namo mahyamekoham dehavanapi kvachinna ganta naganta vyapya vishvamavasthitah
items.e: How wonderful I am. I bow to myself. Though I have a body, I am one. I go nowhere and come from nowhere. I stand pervading the world.

items.s: अहो अहं नमो मह्यं दक्षो नास्तीह मत्समः
items.p: aho aham namo mahyam daksho nastiha matsamah asansprishya sharirena yena vishvam chiram dhritam
items.e: How wonderful I am. I bow to myself. No one is as able as I am: without touching it with a body, I have held up this world for all time.

items.s: अहो अहं नमो मह्यं यस्य मे नास्ति किञ्चन
items.p: aho aham namo mahyam yasya me nasti kinchana athava yasya me sarvam yad vanmanasagocharam
items.e: How wonderful I am. I bow to myself. Nothing is mine, or everything that speech and mind can reach is mine.

items.s: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं तथा ज्ञाता त्रितयं नास्ति वास्तवम्
items.p: gyanam gyeyam tatha gyata tritayam nasti vastavam agyanad bhati yatredam sohamasmi niranjanah
items.e: Knowledge, the known and the knower: these three are not real. I am the spotless one in whom they appear through not knowing.

items.p: dvaitamulamaho duhkham nanyattasyasti bheshajam drishyametan mrisha sarvamekoham chidrasomalah
items.e: How strange. Duality is the root of sorrow, and there is no medicine for it except this: all that is seen is unreal, and I am one, pure awareness...

items.p: bodhamatrohamagyanad upadhih kalpito maya evam vimrishato nityam nirvikalpe sthitirmama
items.e: I am awareness alone. Through not knowing, I imagined limits on myself. Reflecting on this always, I rest in what has no divisions.

items.s: न मे बन्धोऽस्ति मोक्षो वा भ्रान्तिः शान्तो निराश्रया
items.p: na me bandhosti moksho va bhrantih shanto nirashraya aho mayi sthitam vishvam vastuto na mayi sthitam
