items.e: I have no bondage and no freedom. The error has ended, with nothing left to stand on. How strange: the world rests in me, and in truth it does not...

items.p: sashariramidam vishvam na kinchiditi nishchitam shuddhachinmatra atma cha tatkasmin kalpanadhuna
items.e: This world, body and all, is nothing: that is settled. The Self is pure awareness alone. So where could imagining take hold now?

items.p: shariram svarganarakau bandhamokshau bhayam tatha kalpanamatramevaitat kim me karyam chidatmanah
items.e: Body, heaven and hell, bondage and freedom, and fear as well: all this is only imagining. What have I, who am awareness, to do with any of it?

items.s: अहो जनसमूहेऽपि न द्वैतं पश्यतो मम
items.p: aho janasamuhepi na dvaitam pashyato mama aranyamiva sanvrittam kva ratim karavanyaham
items.e: How strange. Even in a crowd I see no second. It has become like a forest to me. What is there to cling to?

items.s: नाहं देहो न मे देहो जीवो नाहमहं हि चित्
items.p: naham deho na me deho jivo nahamaham hi chit ayameva hi me bandha asidya jivite spriha
items.e: I am not the body, and the body is not mine. I am not the separate self. I am awareness. My bondage was this: the craving to keep living.

items.p: aho bhuvanakallolairvichitrairdrak samutthitam mayyanantamahambhodhau chittavate samudyate
items.e: How strange. In me, the endless ocean, the many waves of the worlds rise at once when the wind of the mind blows.

items.p: mayyanantamahambhodhau chittavate prashamyati abhagyajjivavanijo jagatpoto vinashvarah
items.e: In me, the endless ocean, when the wind of the mind falls still, the ship of the world sinks, by the bad luck of the trader on board, the separate...

items.p: mayyanantamahambhodhavashcharyam jivavichayah udyanti ghnanti khelanti pravishanti svabhavatah
items.e: How wonderful. In me, the endless ocean, the waves of living beings rise, strike each other, play and sink back, by their own nature.

items.p: avinashinamatmanamekam vigyaya tattvatah tavatmagyanasya dhirasya kathamartharjane ratih
items.e: You have known the Self as one and indestructible, as it is. You know the Self and you are steady. How can you still take pleasure in piling up...

items.p: atmagyanadaho pritirvishayabhramagochare shukteragyanato lobho yatha rajatavibhrame
items.e: How strange. Love for objects, which are a mistake, comes from not knowing the Self, as greed for silver springs up when a shell is not known for a...

items.s: विश्वं स्फुरति यत्रेदं तरङ्गा इव सागरे
items.p: vishvam sphurati yatredam taranga iva sagare sohamasmiti vigyaya kim dina iva dhavasi
items.e: You have known 'I am that in which the world rises like waves in the sea'. Why do you run about like someone poor?

items.p: shrutvapi shuddhachaitanya atmanamatisundaram upasthetyantasansakto malinyamadhigachchhati
items.e: Even after hearing that the Self is pure awareness and lovely beyond words, a person gripped by sexual craving grows clouded.

items.p: sarvabhuteshu chatmanam sarvabhutani chatmani munerjanata ashcharyam mamatvamanuvartate
items.e: The sage knows the Self in every being and every being in the Self. It is strange that the sense of 'mine' still goes on in him.

items.p: asthitah paramadvaitam moksharthepi vyavasthitah ashcharyam kamavashago vikalah kelishikshaya
items.e: Settled in the highest non-duality and set on freedom, he still falls under desire and is shaken by old habits of pleasure. That is strange.

items.p: udbhutam gyanadurmitramavadharyatidurbalah ashcharyam kamamakankshet kalamantamanushritah
items.e: He knows desire is the enemy of knowledge, he is weak, his last days are near, and still he longs for pleasure. That is strange.

items.p: ihamutra viraktasya nityanityavivekinah ashcharyam mokshakamasya mokshad eva vibhishika
items.e: He has turned from this world and the next, he can tell the lasting from the passing, he wants freedom, and yet he is afraid of freedom itself. That...

items.p: dhirastu bhojyamanopi pidyamanopi sarvada atmanam kevalam pashyan na tushyati na kupyati
items.e: Whether fed with pleasures or tormented, the steady one sees only the Self and is neither pleased nor angry.

items.p: cheshtamanam shariram svam pashyatyanyashariravat sanstave chapi nindayam katham kshubhyet mahashayah
items.e: He watches his own body acting as if it were someone else's. Praised or blamed, how could such a large-hearted person be shaken?

items.p: mayamatramidam vishvam pashyan vigatakautukah api sannihite mrityau katham trasyati dhiradhih
items.e: He sees this world as mere appearance and has lost all curiosity about it. How could the steady one be afraid, even when death is close?

items.p: nihspriham manasam yasya nairashyepi mahatmanah tasyatmagyanatriptasya tulana kena jayate
items.e: The great one's mind wants nothing, even when nothing is left to hope for. Content in knowing the Self, with whom can he be compared?

items.p: svabhavad eva janano drishyametanna kinchana idam grahyamidam tyajyam sa kim pashyati dhiradhih
items.e: Knowing by nature that what is seen is nothing, how would the steady one look at things as 'this to take' and 'this to throw away'?

items.p: antastyaktakashayasya nirdvandvasya nirashishah yadrichchhayagato bhogo na duhkhaya na tushtaye
items.e: For one who has dropped inner impurities, who is free of opposites and of wishes, a pleasure that comes on its own brings neither pain nor delight.

items.p: hantatmagyanasya dhirasya khelato bhogalilaya na hi sansaravahikairmudhaih saha samanata
items.e: The steady one who knows the Self plays the game of experience. He has nothing in common with the confused, who carry the world like beasts of burden.

items.s: यत् पदं प्रेप्सवो दीनाः शक्राद्याः सर्वदेवताः
items.p: yat padam prepsavo dinah shakradyah sarvadevatah aho tatra sthito yogi na harshamupagachchhati
items.e: The state that Indra and all the gods long for, poor in their longing: the yogi stands there and does not grow excited.

items.p: tajgyasya punyapapabhyam sparsho hyantarna jayate na hyakashasya dhumena drishyamanapi sangatih
items.e: Inwardly, one who knows That is not touched by merit or sin, as space is not touched by smoke, though smoke seems to fill it.

items.p: atmaivedam jagatsarvam gyatam yena mahatmana yadrichchhaya vartamanam tam nisheddhum kshameta kah
items.e: The great one has known this whole world as the Self. He lives as things come. Who could stop him?

items.p: abrahmastambaparyante bhutagrame chaturvidhe vigyasyaiva hi samarthyamichchhanichchhavivarjane
items.e: Among the four kinds of beings, from Brahma down to a clump of grass, only the wise have the strength to give up both wanting and not wanting.

items.p: atmanamadvayam kashchijjanati jagadishvaram yad vetti tatsa kurute na bhayam tasya kutrachit
items.e: Rare is the one who knows the Self as one without a second, the Lord of the world. He does what he knows, and has no fear from anywhere.

items.s: न ते सङ्गोऽस्ति केनापि किं शुद्धस्त्यक्तुमिच्छसि
items.p: na te sangosti kenapi kim shuddhastyaktumichchhasi sanghatavilayam kurvannevameva layam vraja
items.e: You are tied to nothing. You are pure. What would you give up? Let this bundle of body and mind dissolve, and so go to rest.

items.p: udeti bhavato vishvam varidheriva budbudah iti gyatvaikamatmanamevameva layam vraja
items.e: The world rises from you like a bubble from the sea. Know the Self as one, and so go to rest.

items.p: pratyakshamapyavastutvad vishvam nastyamale tvayi rajjusarpa iva vyaktamevameva layam vraja
items.e: Though seen, the world is unreal, and it does not exist in you, the spotless one: it is like the snake in the rope. Know this, and so go to rest.

items.p: samaduhkhasukhah purna ashanairashyayoh samah samajivitamrityuh sannevameva layam vraja
items.e: The same in pain and pleasure, full, the same in hope and disappointment, the same in life and death: being so, go to rest.

items.p: akashavadanantoham ghatavat prakritam jagat iti gyanam tathaitasya na tyago na graho layah
items.e: I am endless like space. The world of nature is like a pot. Knowing this, there is nothing to give up, nothing to take and nothing to dissolve.

items.p: mahodadhirivaham sa prapancho vichisannibhah iti gyanam tathaitasya na tyago na graho layah
items.e: I am like the great ocean. The world of many things is like a wave. Knowing this, there is nothing to give up, nothing to take and nothing to...

items.p: aham sa shuktisankasho rupyavad vishvakalpana iti gyanam tathaitasya na tyago na graho layah
items.e: I am like the shell. The world is imagined, like the silver. Knowing this, there is nothing to give up, nothing to take and nothing to dissolve.

items.p: aham va sarvabhuteshu sarvabhutanyatho mayi iti gyanam tathaitasya na tyago na graho layah
items.e: I am in every being, and every being is in me. Knowing this, there is nothing to give up, nothing to take and nothing to dissolve.

items.p: mayyanantamahambhodhau vishvapota itastatah bhramati svantavatena na mamastyasahishnuta
items.e: In me, the endless ocean, the ship of the world drifts here and there, driven by its own wind. I am not troubled by it.

items.p: mayyanantamahambhodhau jagadvichih svabhavatah udetu vastamayatu na me vriddhirna cha kshatih
items.e: In me, the endless ocean, the wave of the world rises or sinks by its own nature. I neither grow nor shrink.

items.p: mayyanantamahambhodhau vishvam nama vikalpana atishanto nirakara etadevahamasthitah
items.e: In me, the endless ocean, the world is only imagined. I am at complete peace and without form. In this alone I rest.

items.p: natma bhaveshu no bhavastatranante niranjane ityasaktosprihah shanta etadevahamasthitah
items.e: The Self is not in objects, and no object is in the Self, which is endless and spotless. So I am unattached, without craving, at peace. In this alone...

items.p: aho chinmatramevahamindrajalopamam jagat iti mama katham kutra heyopadeyakalpana
items.e: How strange. I am awareness alone, and the world is like a magic show. So how, and where, could I imagine anything to reject or accept?

items.s: तदा बन्धो यदा चित्तं किञ्चिद् वाञ्छति शोचति
items.p: tada bandho yada chittam kinchid vanchhati shochati kinchin munchati grinhati kinchid drishyati kupyati
items.e: It is bondage when the mind wants something or grieves over something, lets go of something or grabs something, is pleased by something or angry at...

items.s: तदा मुक्तिर्यदा चित्तं न वाञ्छति न शोचति
items.p: tada muktiryada chittam na vanchhati na shochati na munchati na grinhati na hrishyati na kupyati
items.e: It is freedom when the mind does not want and does not grieve, does not let go and does not grab, is not pleased and is not angry.

items.s: तदा बन्धो यदा चित्तं सक्तं काश्वपि दृष्टिषु
items.p: tada bandho yada chittam saktam kashvapi drishtishu tada moksho yada chittamasaktam sarvadrishtishu
items.e: It is bondage when the mind is attached to any one experience. It is freedom when the mind is attached to none.

items.s: यदा नाहं तदा मोक्षो यदाहं बन्धनं तदा
items.p: yada naham tada moksho yadaham bandhanam tada matveti helaya kinchinma grihana vimuncha ma
items.e: When there is no 'I', there is freedom. When there is 'I', there is bondage. Knowing this, lightly, take nothing and drop nothing.

items.s: कृताकृते च द्वन्द्वानि कदा शान्तानि कस्य वा
items.p: kritakrite cha dvandvani kada shantani kasya va evam gyatveha nirvedad bhava tyagaparovrati
items.e: Things done and things left undone, the pairs of opposites: when have they ever ended, and for whom? Knowing this, grow weary of it all, let go, and...

items.p: kasyapi tata dhanyasya lokacheshtavalokanat jivitechchha bubhuksha cha bubhutsopashamah gatah
items.e: My child, rare is the fortunate one whose wish to live, to enjoy and to know has been put out by watching how people live.

items.p: anityam sarvamevedam tapatritayadushitam asaram ninditam heyamiti nishchitya shamyati
items.e: All this passes. It is spoiled by the three kinds of suffering, empty, worth little, fit to be left. Certain of this, one becomes still.

items.s: कोऽसौ कालो वयः किं वा यत्र द्वन्द्वानि नो नृणाम्
items.p: kosau kalo vayah kim va yatra dvandvani no nrinam tanyupekshya yathapraptavarti siddhimavapnuyat
items.e: What time, what age of life is free of the pairs of opposites for anyone? Ignore them, live with what comes, and you reach the goal.

items.s: नाना मतं महर्षीणां साधूनां योगिनां तथा
items.p: nana matam maharshinam sadhunam yoginam tatha drishtva nirvedamapannah ko na shamyati manavah
items.e: Seeing how great sages, saints and yogis differ in their views, who would not grow weary of it all and fall quiet?

items.s: कृत्वा मूर्तिपरिज्ञानं चैतन्यस्य न किं गुरुः
items.p: kritva murtiparigyanam chaitanyasya na kim guruh nirvedasamatayuktya yastarayati sansriteh
items.e: One who comes to know the nature of awareness through weariness with the world, evenness of mind and reasoning, and so crosses the round of birth and...

items.p: pashya bhutavikaranstvam bhutamatran yatharthatah tatkshanad bandhanirmuktah svarupastho bhavishyasi
items.e: See the changes of the elements as only the elements, as they are. That very moment you will be free of bondage and stand in your own nature.

items.s: वासना एव संसार इति सर्वा विमुञ्च ताः
items.p: vasana eva sansara iti sarva vimuncha tah tattyago vasanatyagatsthitiradya yatha tatha
items.e: Habit-tendencies are the world. So let all of them go. Dropping them is dropping the world. Then stay as you are, as things come.

items.p: vihaya vairinam kamamartham chanarthasankulam dharmamapyetayorhetum sarvatranadaram kuru
items.e: Leave desire, which is your enemy, and wealth, which comes tangled with harm, and even dharma, which is the cause of both. Be indifferent to all of...

items.s: स्वप्नेन्द्रजालवत् पश्य दिनानि त्रीणि पञ्च वा
items.p: svapnendrajalavat pashya dinani trini pancha va mitrakshetradhanagaradaradayadisampadah
items.e: Look on friends, land, money, houses, wife, gifts and other good fortune as a dream or a magic show lasting three or five days.

items.s: यत्र यत्र भवेत्तृष्णा संसारं विद्धि तत्र वै
items.p: yatra yatra bhavettrishna sansaram viddhi tatra vai praudhavairagyamashritya vitatrishnah sukhi bhava
items.e: Wherever craving arises, know that the world is there. Take up mature dispassion, let craving go, and be happy.

items.p: trishnamatratmako bandhastannasho moksha uchyate bhavasansaktimatrena praptitushtirmuhurmuhuh
items.e: Bondage is nothing but craving. Its end is called freedom. Simply by not clinging to the world, you find contentment again and again.

items.p: tvamekashchetanah shuddho jadam vishvamasattatha avidyapi na kinchitsa ka bubhutsa tathapi te
items.e: You are one, aware and pure. The world is inert and unreal. Not knowing is nothing either. So what is left that you still want to know?

items.s: राज्यं सुताः कलत्राणि शरीराणि सुखानि च
items.p: rajyam sutah kalatrani sharirani sukhani cha sansaktasyapi nashtani tava janmani janmani
items.e: Kingdoms, sons, wives, bodies and pleasures: you were attached to them, and still you lost them, birth after birth.

items.p: alamarthena kamena sukritenapi karmana ebhyah sansarakantare na vishrantamabhun manah
items.e: Enough of wealth, desire and even good deeds. In the thick forest of the world, the mind found no rest in them.

items.s: कृतं न कति जन्मानि कायेन मनसा गिरा
items.p: kritam na kati janmani kayena manasa gira duhkhamayasadam karma tadadyapyuparamyatam
items.e: For how many births have you done hard and painful work with body, mind and speech? Stop now, at least today.

items.p: bhavabhavavikarashcha svabhavaditi nishchayi nirvikaro gatakleshah sukhenaivopashamyati
items.e: Becoming, ceasing and change come from the nature of things. One who is sure of this stays unchanged, free of distress, and comes to rest with ease.

items.p: ishvarah sarvanirmata nehanya iti nishchayi antargalitasarvashah shantah kvapi na sajjate
items.e: 'God is the maker of all, and there is none besides him here': one who is sure of this, every wish melted inside, is at peace and clings to nothing.

items.p: apadah sampadah kale daivadeveti nishchayi triptah svasthendriyo nityam na vanchhati na shochati
items.e: Hard times and good times come in their season, by destiny. One who is sure of this is content, his senses at rest. He does not long and does not...

items.p: sukhaduhkhe janmamrityu daivadeveti nishchayi sadhyadarshi nirayasah kurvannapi na lipyate
items.e: Pleasure and pain, birth and death come by destiny. One who is sure of this sees nothing he must achieve, makes no strain, and is not stained even...

items.p: chintaya jayate duhkham nanyatheheti nishchayi taya hinah sukhi shantah sarvatra galitasprihah
items.e: Sorrow is born of worry and of nothing else here. One who is sure of this is free of worry, happy, at peace, his wanting melted everywhere.

items.s: नाहं देहो न मे देहो बोधोऽहमिति निश्चयी
items.p: naham deho na me deho bodhohamiti nishchayi kaivalyamiva samprapto na smaratyakritam kritam
items.e: 'I am not the body, the body is not mine, I am awareness': one who is sure of this has reached something like final freedom. He does not keep count...

items.p: abrahmastambaparyantamahameveti nishchayi nirvikalpah shuchih shantah praptapraptavinirvritah
items.e: 'From Brahma down to a clump of grass, it is all I': one who is sure of this has no wavering thought, is pure and at peace, and no longer worries...

items.p: nanashcharyamidam vishvam na kinchiditi nishchayi nirvasanah sphurtimatro na kinchidiva shamyati
items.e: This world of many wonders is nothing: one who is sure of this is free of tendencies, awareness alone, and comes to rest as if nothing were there.

items.p: kayakrityasahah purvam tato vagvistarasahah atha chintasahastasmad evamevahamasthitah
items.e: First I lost patience with the body's work, then with long talk, then with thinking itself. So I rest as I am.

items.p: prityabhavena shabdaderadrishyatvena chatmanah vikshepaikagrahridaya evamevahamasthitah
items.e: Sound and the other objects no longer pull at me, and the Self is no object to be seen. My heart is free of scatter and gathered. So I rest as I am.

items.p: samadhyasadivikshiptau vyavaharah samadhaye evam vilokya niyamamevamevahamasthitah
items.e: Distraction comes from taking things as real, and effort is then made to reach samadhi. Seeing that this is how it goes, I rest as I am.

items.p: heyopadeyavirahad evam harshavishadayoh abhavadadya he brahmanevamevahamasthitah
items.e: There is nothing to reject and nothing to take, so there is no joy and no sorrow. O Brahman, so I rest as I am.

items.p: ashramanashramam dhyanam chittasvikritavarjanam vikalpam mama vikshyaitairevamevahamasthitah
items.e: A stage of life or none, meditation, the mind taking things up and dropping them: seeing these as my own imaginings, I rest as I am.

items.p: karmanushthanamagyanad yathaivoparamastatha budhva samyagidam tattvamevamevahamasthitah
items.e: Doing rituals comes from not knowing, and so does stopping them. Knowing this truth fully, I rest as I am.

items.p: achintyam chintyamanopi chintarupam bhajatyasau tyaktva tadbhavanam tasmad evamevahamasthitah
items.e: Thinking about the unthinkable is still a form of thought. So I have let that thinking go, and rest as I am.

items.s: एवमेव कृतं येन स कृतार्थो भवेदसौ
items.p: evameva kritam yena sa kritartho bhavedasau evameva svabhavo yah sa kritartho bhavedasau
items.e: Whoever has done this has done all there is to do. Whoever is like this by nature has done all there is to do.

items.p: akinchanabhavam svastham kaupinatvepi durlabham tyagadane vihayasmadahamase yathasukham
items.e: The ease of owning nothing is rare even for one who wears only a loincloth. So I have left both giving up and taking, and live as it pleases me.

items.s: कुत्रापि खेदः कायस्य जिह्वा कुत्रापि खेद्यते
items.p: kutrapi khedah kayasya jihva kutrapi khedyate manah kutrapi tattyaktva purusharthe sthitah sukham
items.e: Here the body is strained, there the tongue grows tired, and there the mind. So I have left them and live at ease in what life is for.

items.s: कृतं किमपि नैव स्याद् इति सञ्चिन्त्य तत्त्वतः
items.p: kritam kimapi naiva syad iti sanchintya tattvatah yada yatkartumayati tat kritvase yathasukham
items.e: Knowing as it is that nothing is ever done by the Self, I do whatever comes to be done and live as it pleases me.

items.p: karmanaishkarmyanirbandhabhava dehasthayoginah sanyogayogavirahadahamase yathasukham
items.e: Yogis who take themselves to be the body insist on action or on doing nothing. I am free of joining and parting, and live as it pleases me.

items.s: अर्थानर्थौ न मे स्थित्या गत्या न शयनेन वा
items.p: arthanarthau na me sthitya gatya na shayanena va tishthan gachchhan svapan tasmadahamase yathasukham
items.e: I gain nothing and lose nothing by standing, walking or lying down. So whether I stand, walk or sleep, I live as it pleases me.

items.s: स्वपतो नास्ति मे हानिः सिद्धिर्यत्नवतो न वा
items.p: svapato nasti me hanih siddhiryatnavato na va nashollasau vihayasmadahamase yathasukham
items.e: Sleeping, I lose nothing. Striving, I win nothing. So I have dropped both loss and delight, and live as it pleases me.

items.p: sukhadirupa niyamam bhaveshvalokya bhurishah shubhashubhe vihayasmadahamase yathasukham
items.e: Having seen many times how pleasure and the rest come and go in things, I have left good and bad behind, and live as it pleases me.

items.p: prakritya shunyachitto yah pramadad bhavabhavanah nidrito bodhita iva kshinasansmarano hi sah
items.e: One whose mind is empty by nature, who thinks of things only by oversight, is like someone who has woken from sleep: his memories of the world have...

items.s: क्व धनानि क्व मित्राणि क्व मे विषयदस्यवः
items.p: kva dhanani kva mitrani kva me vishayadasyavah kva shastram kva cha vigyanam yada me galita spriha
items.e: Where is wealth, where are friends, where are the thieves called sense objects, where is scripture, where is learning, now that my craving has melted...

items.p: vigyate sakshipurushe paramatmani cheshvare nairashye bandhamokshe cha na chinta muktaye mama
items.e: Now that I have known the witness, the supreme Self, the Lord, and hope for neither bondage nor freedom, I have no worry about being freed.

items.p: antarvikalpashunyasya bahih svachchhandacharinah bhrantasyeva dashastastastadrisha eva janate
items.e: Empty of wavering thoughts within, moving freely outside like someone confused: such states are known only by those who share them.

items.p: yathatathopadeshena kritarthah sattvabuddhiman ajivamapi jigyasuh parastatra vimuhyati
items.e: A person of clear understanding is fulfilled by a teaching given in any way at all. Another may inquire his whole life and still stay confused.

items.p: moksho vishayavairasyam bandho vaishayiko rasah etavadeva vigyanam yathechchhasi tatha kuru
items.e: Freedom is losing the taste for objects. Bondage is the taste for them. That is all there is to know. Now do as you wish.

items.p: vagmipragyamahodyogam janam mukajadalasam karoti tattvabodhoyamatastyakto bubhukshabhih
items.e: This knowing of the truth turns the talker, the clever and the busy into someone silent, still and idle. So those who want enjoyment avoid it.

items.s: न त्वं देहो न ते देहो भोक्ता कर्ता न वा भवान्
items.p: na tvam deho na te deho bhokta karta na va bhavan chidruposi sada sakshi nirapekshah sukham chara
items.e: You are not the body, and the body is not yours. You are not the doer or the enjoyer. You are awareness itself, always the witness, needing nothing...

items.p: ragadveshau manodharmau na manaste kadachana nirvikalposi bodhatma nirvikarah sukham chara
items.e: Liking and disliking belong to the mind, and the mind was never yours. You are free of wavering, awareness itself, unchanging. Move about at ease.

items.p: sarvabhuteshu chatmanam sarvabhutani chatmani vigyaya nirahankaro nirmamastvam sukhi bhava
items.e: Know the Self in every being and every being in the Self. Free of 'I' and free of 'mine', be happy.

items.s: विश्वं स्फुरति यत्रेदं तरङ्गा इव सागरे
items.p: vishvam sphurati yatredam taranga iva sagare tattvameva na sandehashchinmurte vijvaro bhava
items.e: That in which this world shimmers like waves on the sea: you are that, without doubt. You who are awareness, let the fever go.

items.s: श्रद्धस्व तात श्रद्धस्व नात्र मोऽहं कुरुष्व भोः
items.p: shraddhasva tata shraddhasva natra moham kurushva bhoh gyanasvarupo bhagavanatma tvam prakriteh parah
items.e: Trust, my child, trust. Do not be confused about this. You are the Self, made of knowledge, the Lord, beyond nature.

items.p: gunaih sanveshtito dehastishthatyayati yati cha atma na ganta naganta kimenamanushochasi
items.e: The body, wrapped in the qualities of nature, comes, stays and goes. The Self neither goes nor comes. Why grieve over it?

items.p: dehastishthatu kalpantam gachchhatvadyaiva va punah kva vriddhih kva cha va hanistava chinmatrarupinah
items.e: Let the body last to the end of the age or go today. What is gained or lost for you, who are awareness alone?

items.p: tvayyanantamahambhodhau vishvavichih svabhavatah udetu vastamayatu na te vriddhirna va kshatih
items.e: In you, the endless ocean, the wave of the world rises or sinks by its own nature. You neither grow nor shrink.

items.s: तात चिन्मात्ररूपोऽसि न ते भिन्नमिदं जगत्
items.p: tata chinmatraruposi na te bhinnamidam jagat atah kasya katham kutra heyopadeyakalpana
items.e: My child, you are awareness alone. This world is not separate from you. So who could imagine anything to reject or take, and how, and where?

items.p: ekasminnavyaye shante chidakashemale tvayi kuto janma kuto karma kutohankara eva cha
items.e: In you, who are one, unchanging, at peace, a spotless sky of awareness, where is birth, where is action, where is the sense of 'I'?

items.p: yattvam pashyasi tatraikastvameva pratibhasase kim prithak bhasate svarnat katakangadanupuram
items.e: Whatever you see, you alone appear in it. Do bracelets, armlets and anklets appear as anything apart from the gold?

items.p: ayam sohamayam naham vibhagamiti santyaja sarvamatmeti nishchitya nihsankalpah sukhi bhava
items.e: Drop the division 'I am this, I am not that'. Be certain that all is the Self, make no more plans of the mind, and be happy.

items.p: tavaivagyanato vishvam tvamekah paramarthatah tvattonyo nasti sansari nasansari cha kashchana
items.e: Through your own not knowing, the world exists. In truth you alone are. There is no one apart from you, bound to the world or free of it.

items.p: bhrantimatramidam vishvam na kinchiditi nishchayi nirvasanah sphurtimatro na kinchidiva shamyati
items.e: 'This world is only an error, it is nothing': one who is sure of this is free of tendencies, awareness alone, and comes to rest as if nothing were...

items.p: eka eva bhavambhodhavasidasti bhavishyati na te bandhosti moksho va krityakrityah sukham chara
items.e: In the ocean of the world there was one, there is one, there will be one: you. You have no bondage and no freedom. Your work is done. Move about at...

items.p: ma sankalpavikalpabhyam chittam kshobhaya chinmaya upashamya sukham tishtha svatmanyanandavigrahe
items.e: You who are awareness, do not stir the mind with 'yes' and 'no'. Be still, and rest at ease in your own Self, which is joy itself.

items.s: त्यजैव ध्यानं सर्वत्र मा किञ्चिद् हृदि धारय
items.p: tyajaiva dhyanam sarvatra ma kinchid hridi dharaya atma tvam mukta evasi kim vimrishya karishyasi
items.e: Give up meditation altogether. Hold nothing in the heart. You are the Self, free already. What will you gain by thinking it over?

items.p: achakshva shrinu va tata nanashastranyanekashah tathapi na tava svasthyam sarvavismaranad rite
items.e: My child, you may recite many scriptures or hear them many times. Still you will not be at ease until you forget it all.

items.s: भोगं कर्म समाधिं वा कुरु विज्ञ तथापि ते
items.p: bhogam karma samadhim va kuru vigya tathapi te chittam nirastasarvashamatyartham rochayishyati
items.e: Wise one, you may enjoy, work or sit in samadhi. Even so, your mind will long most of all for the place where every wish has ended.

items.p: ayasatsakalo duhkhi nainam janati kashchana anenaivopadeshena dhanyah prapnoti nirvritim
items.e: Everyone suffers from effort, and nobody sees it. By this teaching alone, the fortunate one finds rest.

items.p: vyapare khidyate yastu nimeshonmeshayorapi tasyalasya dhurinasya sukham nanyasya kasyachit
items.e: The master idler, who finds even opening and closing his eyes a strain, has happiness. Nobody else has it.

items.s: इदं कृतमिदं नेति द्वन्द्वैर्मुक्तं यदा मनः
items.p: idam kritamidam neti dvandvairmuktam yada manah dharmarthakamamoksheshu nirapeksham tada bhavet
items.e: When the mind is free of opposites like 'this is done, this is not done', it stops caring about dharma, wealth, pleasure and even freedom.

items.p: virakto vishayadveshta ragi vishayalolupah grahamokshavihinastu na virakto na ragavan
items.e: One who hates objects is dispassionate. One who craves them is attached. One who neither takes nor drops is neither dispassionate nor attached.

items.p: heyopadeyata tavatsansaravitapankurah spriha jivati yavad vai nirvicharadashaspadam
items.e: As long as wanting lives, which is a state without discernment, the sense of things to take and things to drop stays alive: the sprout of the tree of...

items.s: प्रवृत्तौ जायते रागो निर्वृत्तौ द्वेष एव हि
items.p: pravrittau jayate rago nirvrittau dvesha eva hi nirdvandvo balavad dhiman evameva vyavasthitah
items.e: Activity breeds attachment, and holding back breeds aversion. So the wise one, free of opposites like a child, stays just as he is.

items.p: hatumichchhati sansaram ragi duhkhajihasaya vitarago hi nirduhkhastasminnapi na khidyati
items.e: The attached person wants to leave the world to escape sorrow. One without attachment is free of sorrow and is not troubled even while living in it.

items.p: yasyabhimano mokshepi dehepi mamata tatha na cha gyani na va yogi kevalam duhkhabhagasau
items.e: One who takes pride even in freedom and still calls the body his own is neither a knower nor a yogi. He only shares in sorrow.

items.s: हरो यद्युपदेष्टा ते हरिः कमलजोऽपि वा
items.p: haro yadyupadeshta te harih kamalajopi va tathapi na tava svathyam sarvavismaranadrite
items.e: Even if Shiva, Vishnu or lotus-born Brahma were your teacher, you would not be at ease until you forget it all.

items.p: tena gyanaphalam praptam yogabhyasaphalam tatha triptah svachchhendriyo nityamekaki ramate tu yah
items.e: He has the fruit of knowledge and the fruit of yoga practice who is content, whose senses are clear, and who delights in being alone.

items.p: na kadachijjagatyasmin tattvagyo hanta khidyati yata ekena tenedam purnam brahmandamandalam
items.e: One who knows what is real is never troubled here, for this whole round of worlds is filled by him alone.

items.s: न जातु विषयाः केऽपि स्वारामं हर्षयन्त्यमी
items.p: na jatu vishayah kepi svaramam harshayantyami sallakipallavapritamivebham nimbapallavah
items.e: No objects ever please one who delights in the Self, as neem leaves do not please an elephant who loves sallaki leaves.

items.p: yastu bhogeshu bhukteshu na bhavatyadhivasitah abhukteshu nirakankshi tadrisho bhavadurlabhah
items.e: One who does not dwell on pleasures he has had and does not long for those he has not had: such a person is rare.

items.p: bubhukshuriha sansare mumukshurapi drishyate bhogamokshanirakankshi viralo hi mahashayah
items.e: Here we see people who want enjoyment and people who want freedom. Rare is the great soul who wants neither.

items.p: dharmarthakamamoksheshu jivite marane tatha kasyapyudarachittasya heyopadeyata na hi
items.e: Rare is the large-hearted person who has no sense of taking or rejecting dharma, wealth, pleasure, freedom, life or death.

items.s: वाञ्छा न विश्वविलये न द्वेषस्तस्य च स्थितौ
items.p: vanchha na vishvavilaye na dveshastasya cha sthitau yatha jivikaya tasmad dhanya aste yatha sukham
items.e: He has no wish for the world to end and no dislike of its going on. So the fortunate one lives at ease on whatever livelihood comes.

items.p: kritarthonena gyanenetyevam galitadhih kriti pashyan shrinvan sprishan jighranashnannaste yatha sukham
items.e: Fulfilled by this knowledge, his mind melted away, he lives at ease, seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating.

items.p: shunya drishtirvritha cheshta vikalanindriyani cha na spriha na viraktirva kshinasansarasagare
items.e: For one whose ocean of the world has dried up, the gaze is empty, action has no aim, the senses are idle. There is no wanting and no turning away.

items.s: न जागर्ति न निद्राति नोन्मीलति न मीलति
items.p: na jagarti na nidrati nonmilati na milati aho paradasha kvapi vartate muktachetasah
items.e: He is not awake and not asleep, he neither opens nor closes his eyes. How wonderful: the free mind lives in the highest state wherever it is.

items.p: sarvatra drishyate svasthah sarvatra vimalashayah samastavasana mukto muktah sarvatra rajate
items.e: The free one is seen at ease everywhere, clear-hearted everywhere. Free of all tendencies, he shines everywhere.

items.s: पश्यन् शृण्वन् स्पृशन् जिघ्रन्अश्नन् गृण्हन् वदन् व्रजन्
items.p: pashyan shrinvan sprishan jighranashnan grinhan vadan vrajan ihitanihitairmukto mukta eva mahashayah
items.e: Seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, taking, speaking, walking, free of wanting and not wanting, the great soul is free.

items.s: न निन्दति न च स्तौति न हृष्यति न कुप्यति
items.p: na nindati na cha stauti na hrishyati na kupyati na dadati na grinhati muktah sarvatra nirasah
items.e: He does not blame and does not praise, is not elated and is not angry, does not give and does not take. The free one has no taste for anything.

items.s: सानुरागां स्त्रियं दृष्ट्वा मृत्युं वा समुपस्थितम्
items.p: sanuragam striyam drishtva mrityum va samupasthitam avihvalamanah svastho mukta eva mahashayah
items.e: Whether he sees a woman full of desire or death standing near, the great soul stays unshaken and at ease. He is free.

items.s: सुखे दुःखे नरे नार्यां सम्पत्सु च विपत्सु च
items.p: sukhe duhkhe nare naryam sampatsu cha vipatsu cha vishesho naiva dhirasya sarvatra samadarshinah
items.e: In pleasure and pain, man and woman, good fortune and bad, the steady one, who sees the same everywhere, finds no difference.

items.s: न हिंसा नैव कारुण्यं नौद्धत्यं न च दीनता
items.p: na hinsa naiva karunyam nauddhatyam na cha dinata nashcharyam naiva cha kshobhah kshinasansarane nare
items.e: In one whose round of births is worn out there is no cruelty and no pity, no arrogance and no meekness, no wonder and no agitation.

items.s: न मुक्तो विषयद्वेष्टा न वा विषयलोलुपः
items.p: na mukto vishayadveshta na va vishayalolupah asansaktamana nityam praptapraptamupashnute
items.e: The free one neither hates objects nor craves them. With a mind always unattached, he takes what comes and what does not.

items.p: samadhanasamadhanahitahitavikalpanah shunyachitto na janati kaivalyamiva sansthitah
items.e: Gathered or scattered, good or bad: one whose mind is empty does not know these choices. He stays as if in final freedom.

items.p: nirmamo nirahankaro na kinchiditi nishchitah antargalitasarvashah kurvannapi karoti na
items.e: Without 'mine', without 'I', certain that nothing is, every wish melted within, he does not act even while acting.

items.p: manahprakashasammohasvapnajadyavivarjitah dasham kamapi samprapto bhaved galitamanasah
items.e: Free of the play of mind, confusion, dream and dullness, one whose mind has melted reaches a state nobody can name.

items.p: yasya bodhodaye tavatsvapnavad bhavati bhramah tasmai sukhaikarupaya namah shantaya tejase
items.e: I bow to that peace, that light, whose nature is joy alone, at whose dawning the error of the world becomes like a dream.

items.p: arjayitvakhilan arthan bhoganapnoti pushkalan na hi sarvaparityagamantarena sukhi bhavet
items.e: One may gain every kind of wealth and enjoy pleasures in plenty, yet nobody is happy without letting go of everything.

items.p: kartavyaduhkhamartandajvaladagdhantaratmanah kutah prashamapiyushadharasaramrite sukham
items.e: One whose inner self is scorched by the sun of duty and its pain: how can he be happy without the steady rain of the nectar of calm?

items.p: bhavoyam bhavanamatro na kinchit paramarthatah nastyabhavah svabhavanam bhavabhavavibhavinam
items.e: This world is only a thought. In the highest truth it is nothing. That which is real by nature, and which lights up both being and not-being, never...

items.s: न दूरं न च सङ्कोचाल्लब्धमेवात्मनः पदम्
items.p: na duram na cha sankochallabdhamevatmanah padam nirvikalpam nirayasam nirvikaram niranjanam
items.e: The place of the Self is near, and narrowing down does not gain it, for it is already yours: without thought, without effort, without change, without...

items.p: vyamohamatraviratau svarupadanamatratah vitashoka virajante niravaranadrishtayah
items.e: When confusion stops and one simply takes up one's own nature, people shine free of sorrow, their sight unveiled.

items.p: samastam kalpanamatramatma muktah sanatanah iti vigyaya dhiro hi kimabhyasyati balavat
items.e: All this is only imagining. The Self is free and eternal. Knowing this, why would the steady one practise like a child?

items.s: आत्मा ब्रह्मेति निश्चित्य भावाभावौ च कल्पितौ
items.p: atma brahmeti nishchitya bhavabhavau cha kalpitau nishkamah kim vijanati kim brute cha karoti kim
items.e: Certain that the Self is Brahman and that being and not-being are imagined, what does the one without desire need to know, say or do?

items.p: ayam sohamayam nahamiti kshina vikalpana sarvamatmeti nishchitya tushnimbhutasya yoginah
items.e: 'I am this, I am not that': such thoughts fade for the yogi who is certain that all is the Self and has fallen silent.

items.s: न विक्षेपो न चैकाग्र्यं नातिबोधो न मूढता
items.p: na vikshepo na chaikagryam natibodho na mudhata na sukham na cha va duhkhamupashantasya yoginah
items.e: For the yogi at peace there is no distraction and no focus, no heightened knowing and no dullness, no pleasure and no pain.

items.s: स्वाराज्ये भैक्षवृत्तौ च लाभालाभे जने वने
items.p: svarajye bhaikshavrittau cha labhalabhe jane vane nirvikalpasvabhavasya na visheshosti yoginah
items.e: Ruling a kingdom or living on alms, gain or loss, among people or in the forest: it makes no difference to the yogi whose nature is free of wavering...

items.s: क्व धर्मः क्व च वा कामः क्व चार्थः क्व विवेकिता
items.p: kva dharmah kva cha va kamah kva charthah kva vivekita idam kritamidam neti dvandvairmuktasya yoginah
items.e: Where is dharma, where is pleasure, where is wealth, where is discernment, for the yogi free of opposites like 'this is done, this is not done'?

items.s: कृत्यं किमपि नैवास्ति न कापि हृदि रञ्जना
items.p: krityam kimapi naivasti na kapi hridi ranjana yatha jivanameveha jivanmuktasya yoginah
items.e: The yogi free while living has no duty left to do and no attachment in his heart. He lives as life comes.

items.s: क्व मोहः क्व च वा विश्वं क्व तद् ध्यानं क्व मुक्तता
items.p: kva mohah kva cha va vishvam kva tad dhyanam kva muktata sarvasankalpasimayam vishrantasya mahatmanah
items.e: Where is delusion, where is the world, where is meditation on That, where is freedom, for the great soul at rest past the edge of every intention?

items.s: येन विश्वमिदं दृष्टं स नास्तीति करोतु वै
items.p: yena vishvamidam drishtam sa nastiti karotu vai nirvasanah kim kurute pashyannapi na pashyati
items.e: One who has seen the world may try to deny it. But what does one without tendencies have to do? Seeing, he does not see.

items.s: येन दृष्टं परं ब्रह्म सोऽहं ब्रह्मेति चिन्तयेत्
items.p: yena drishtam param brahma soham brahmeti chintayet kim chintayati nishchinto dvitiyam yo na pashyati
items.e: One who has seen the supreme Brahman may think 'I am Brahman'. But what is left to think for one beyond thought, who sees no second?

items.p: drishto yenatmavikshepo nirodham kurute tvasau udarastu na vikshiptah sadhyabhavatkaroti kim
items.e: One who has seen distraction in himself may work to stop it. The noble one is not distracted. With nothing to achieve, what would he do?

items.p: dhiro lokaviparyasto vartamanopi lokavat na samadhim na vikshepam na lopam svasya pashyati
items.e: The steady one lives like other people and yet is unlike them. He sees no samadhi in himself, no distraction and no flaw.

items.p: bhavabhavavihino yastripto nirvasano budhah naiva kinchitkritam tena lokadrishtya vikurvata
items.e: The wise one, beyond being and not-being, content and free of tendencies, does nothing at all, though in other people's eyes he acts.

items.s: प्रवृत्तौ वा निवृत्तौ वा नैव धीरस्य दुर्ग्रहः
items.p: pravrittau va nivrittau va naiva dhirasya durgrahah yada yatkartumayati tatkritva tishthatah sukham
items.e: The steady one does not insist on acting or on holding back. He does whatever comes to be done and stays at ease.

items.p: nirvasano niralambah svachchhando muktabandhanah kshiptah sanskaravatena cheshtate shushkaparnavat
items.e: Free of tendencies, leaning on nothing, moving freely, his ties undone, he is blown about by the wind of past impressions like a dry leaf.

items.s: असंसारस्य तु क्वापि न हर्षो न विषादता
items.p: asansarasya tu kvapi na harsho na vishadata sa shitalamana nityam videha iva rajaye
items.e: One who is out of the round of the world has no joy and no gloom anywhere. With a mind always cool, he shines like one without a body.

items.s: कुत्रापि न जिहासास्ति नाशो वापि न कुत्रचित्
items.p: kutrapi na jihasasti nasho vapi na kutrachit atmaramasya dhirasya shitalachchhataratmanah
items.e: The steady one who delights in the Self, cool and clear inside, has no wish to give anything up and feels no loss anywhere.

items.p: prakritya shunyachittasya kurvatosya yadrichchhaya prakritasyeva dhirasya na mano navamanata
items.e: His mind is empty by nature and he acts as things come. Honour and dishonour do not reach the steady one the way they reach other people.

items.s: कृतं देहेन कर्मेदं न मया शुद्धरूपिणा
items.p: kritam dehena karmedam na maya shuddharupina iti chintanurodhi yah kurvannapi karoti na
items.e: 'This act was done by the body, not by me, the pure Self': one who holds to this thought does not act even while acting.

items.p: atadvadiva kurute na bhavedapi balishah jivanmuktah sukhi shriman sansarannapi shobhate
items.e: He acts without announcing it, yet he is no fool. Free while living, happy and graced, he shines even while living a worldly life.

items.p: nanavicharasushranto dhiro vishrantimagatah na kalpate na jati na shrinoti na pashyati
items.e: Worn out by endless reasoning, the steady one has come to rest. He does not imagine, does not know, does not hear, does not see.

items.p: asamadheravikshepan na mumukshurna chetarah nishchitya kalpitam pashyan brahmaivaste mahashayah
items.e: With no samadhi and no distraction, he is neither one who wants freedom nor anything else. Having seen that all is imagined, the great soul lives as...

items.s: यस्यान्तः स्यादहङ्कारो न करोति करोति सः
items.p: yasyantah syadahankaro na karoti karoti sah nirahankaradhirena na kinchidakritam kritam
items.e: One who has the sense of 'I' inside acts even when he does nothing. The steady one free of 'I' does nothing, even when things are done.

items.p: nodvignam na cha santushtamakartri spandavarjitam nirasham gatasandeham chittam muktasya rajate
items.e: The mind of the free one shines: not upset, not pleased, not the doer, without motion, without hope, without doubt.

items.s: निर्ध्यातुं चेष्टितुं वापि यच्चित्तं न प्रवर्तते
items.p: nirdhyatum cheshtitum vapi yachchittam na pravartate nirnimittamidam kintu nirdhyayeti vicheshtate
items.e: The free one's mind does not set out to meditate or to act. It meditates and acts without a reason.

items.p: tattvam yatharthamakarnya mandah prapnoti mudhatam athava yati sankochamamudhah kopi mudhavat
items.e: Hearing the truth as it is, a dull person is bewildered. A sharp one turns inward and may look like a dull one.

items.p: ekagrata nirodho va mudhairabhyasyate bhrisham dhirah krityam na pashyanti suptavatsvapade sthitah
items.e: The confused work hard at concentration and control. The steady see nothing to do. They rest in their own state like people asleep.

items.s: अप्रयत्नात् प्रयत्नाद् वा मूढो नाप्नोति निर्वृतिम्
items.p: aprayatnat prayatnad va mudho napnoti nirvritim tattvanishchayamatrena pragyo bhavati nirvritah
items.e: With effort or without it, the confused do not find rest. The wise are at rest just by being sure of the truth.

items.s: शुद्धं बुद्धं प्रियं पूर्णं निष्प्रपञ्चं निरामयम्
items.p: shuddham buddham priyam purnam nishprapancham niramayam atmanam tam na jananti tatrabhyasapara janah
items.e: People devoted to practice do not know the Self: pure, awake, dear, whole, beyond the spread of the world, untouched by sorrow.

items.p: napnoti karmana moksham vimudhobhyasarupina dhanyo vigyanamatrena muktastishthatyavikriyah
items.e: The confused person does not gain freedom by repeated action, which is all practice is. The fortunate one, by knowing alone, stands free and...

items.s: मूढो नाप्नोति तद् ब्रह्म यतो भवितुमिच्छति
items.p: mudho napnoti tad brahma yato bhavitumichchhati anichchhannapi dhiro hi parabrahmasvarupabhak
items.e: The confused do not reach Brahman because they want to become it. The steady one, without even wanting it, has the nature of the supreme Brahman.

items.p: niradhara grahavyagra mudhah sansaraposhakah etasyanarthamulasya mulachchhedah krito budhaih
items.e: With no ground to stand on and restless to grasp, the confused keep the world going. The wise cut the root of this root of trouble.

items.s: न शान्तिं लभते मूढो यतः शमितुमिच्छति
items.p: na shantim labhate mudho yatah shamitumichchhati dhirastattvam vinishchitya sarvada shantamanasah
items.e: The confused one does not find peace because he is trying to make himself peaceful. The steady one, sure of the truth, is always calm.

items.p: kvatmano darshanam tasya yad drishtamavalambate dhirastam tam na pashyanti pashyantyatmanamavyayam
items.e: How can one who leans on what is seen see the Self? The steady do not see this and that. They see the Self that does not change.

items.s: क्व निरोधो विमूढस्य यो निर्बन्धं करोति वै
items.p: kva nirodho vimudhasya yo nirbandham karoti vai svaramasyaiva dhirasya sarvadasavakritrimah
items.e: Where is control of the mind for the confused one who forces it? For the steady one who delights in the Self, it comes naturally, always.

items.s: भावस्य भावकः कश्चिन् न किञ्चिद् भावकोपरः
items.p: bhavasya bhavakah kashchin na kinchid bhavakoparah ubhayabhavakah kashchid evameva nirakulah
items.e: One person thinks things exist. Another thinks nothing exists. Rare is the one who thinks neither, and so stays undisturbed.

items.p: shuddhamadvayamatmanam bhavayanti kubuddhayah na tu jananti sammohadyavajjivamanirvritah
items.e: The dull-minded meditate on the Self as pure and one, but through confusion they do not know it, and stay unsatisfied all their lives.

items.p: mumukshorbuddhiralambamantarena na vidyate niralambaiva nishkama buddhirmuktasya sarvada
items.e: The mind of one who wants freedom needs something to lean on. The mind of the free one leans on nothing and wants nothing, always.

items.p: vishayadvipino vikshya chakitah sharanarthinah vishanti jhatiti krodam nirodhaikagrasiddhaye
items.e: Seeing the tigers of the senses' objects, frightened people looking for shelter rush into a cave to gain control and focus.

items.p: nirvasanam harim drishtva tushnim vishayadantinah palayante na shaktaste sevante kritachatavah
items.e: Seeing the lion without tendencies, the elephants of the senses' objects run off without a sound, or, if they cannot, stay and serve him like...

items.p: na muktikarikam dhatte nihshanko yuktamanasah pashyan shrinvan sprishan jighrannashnannaste yathasukham
items.e: Free of doubt, his mind joined to the Self, he does not take up practices for freedom. Seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, he lives at ease.

items.p: vastushravanamatrena shuddhabuddhirnirakulah naivacharamanacharamaudasyam va prapashyati
items.e: Clear-minded and settled just by hearing the truth, he does not look on right conduct, wrong conduct or indifference as his concern.

items.p: yada yatkartumayati tada tatkurute rijuh shubham vapyashubham vapi tasya cheshta hi balavat
items.e: Whatever comes to be done, the straightforward one does it, good or bad. His actions are like a child's.

items.p: svatantryatsukhamapnoti svatantryallabhate param svatantryannirvritim gachchhetsvatantryat paramam padam
items.e: Through inner freedom one finds happiness. Through inner freedom one reaches the highest. Through inner freedom one comes to rest. Through inner...

items.p: akartritvamabhoktritvam svatmano manyate yada tada kshina bhavantyeva samastashchittavrittayah
items.e: When one sees the Self as neither doer nor enjoyer, all the movements of the mind wear away.

items.p: uchchhrinkhalapyakritika sthitirdhirasya rajate na tu sasprihachittasya shantirmudhasya kritrima
items.e: The steady one's way of living shines, unbound and unforced. The forced calm of the confused, whose mind still wants, does not shine.

items.p: vilasanti mahabhogairvishanti girigahvaran nirastakalpana dhira abaddha muktabuddhayah
items.e: Steady ones, free of imagining, unbound, their minds set free, sometimes enjoy great pleasures and sometimes go into mountain caves.

items.p: shrotriyam devatam tirthamanganam bhupatim priyam drishtva sampujya dhirasya na kapi hridi vasana
items.e: When the steady one sees and honours a scholar of the Vedas, a deity, a holy place, a woman, a king or a loved one, no desire stirs in his heart.

items.p: bhrityaih putraih kalatraishcha dauhitraishchapi gotrajaih vihasya dhikkrito yogi na yati vikritim manak
items.e: Mocked and scorned by servants, sons, wives, grandsons and kin, the yogi is not shaken even a little.

items.s: सन्तुष्टोऽपि न सन्तुष्टः खिन्नोऽपि न च खिद्यते
items.p: santushtopi na santushtah khinnopi na cha khidyate tasyashcharyadasham tam tam tadrisha eva janate
items.e: Pleased, he is not pleased. Pained, he is not pained. Only those like him know such wondrous states.

items.s: कर्तव्यतैव संसारो न तां पश्यन्ति सूरयः
items.p: kartavyataiva sansaro na tam pashyanti surayah shunyakara nirakara nirvikara niramayah
items.e: Having duties is the world itself. The wise do not see it. They are empty of shape, without form, unchanging, untouched by pain.

items.p: akurvannapi sankshobhad vyagrah sarvatra mudhadhih kurvannapi tu krityani kushalo hi nirakulah
items.e: The confused one, even doing nothing, is agitated and restless everywhere. The able one, even doing his work, stays undisturbed.

items.s: सुखमास्ते सुखं शेते सुखमायाति याति च
items.p: sukhamaste sukham shete sukhamayati yati cha sukham vakti sukham bhunkte vyavaharepi shantadhih
items.e: At ease he sits, at ease he sleeps, at ease he comes and goes, at ease he speaks, at ease he eats. Calm-minded, he is at ease even in daily dealings.

items.p: svabhavadyasya naivartirlokavad vyavaharinah mahahrida ivakshobhyo gatakleshah sushobhate
items.e: One who by nature feels no distress while dealing with the world like anyone else shines free of trouble, unstirred like a great lake.

items.p: nivrittirapi mudhasya pravritti rupajayate pravrittirapi dhirasya nivrittiphalabhagini
items.e: Even the confused person's holding back becomes a kind of action. Even the steady one's action bears the fruit of holding back.

items.p: parigraheshu vairagyam prayo mudhasya drishyate dehe vigalitashasya kva ragah kva viragata
items.e: The confused often show dispassion toward their possessions. For one whose clinging to the body has melted, where is attachment, and where is...

items.p: bhavanabhavanasakta drishtirmudhasya sarvada bhavyabhavanaya sa tu svasthasyadrishtirupini
items.e: The confused person's gaze is always caught up in thinking and not thinking. For one at rest in himself, even thinking about something is a way of...

items.p: sarvarambheshu nishkamo yashchared balavan munih na lepastasya shuddhasya kriyamanepi karmani
items.e: The sage who acts like a child, without desire in anything he begins, is pure, and is not stained even by the work he does.

items.s: स एव धन्य आत्मज्ञः सर्वभावेषु यः समः
items.p: sa eva dhanya atmagyah sarvabhaveshu yah samah pashyan shrinvan sprishan jighranashnannistarshamanasah
items.e: Blessed is the one who knows the Self and stays the same in every state: seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, with a mind free of thirst.

items.s: क्व संसारः क्व चाभासः क्व साध्यं क्व च साधनम्
items.p: kva sansarah kva chabhasah kva sadhyam kva cha sadhanam akashasyeva dhirasya nirvikalpasya sarvada
items.e: Where is the world, where is its appearance, where is the goal and where the means, for the steady one who is always like the sky, free of wavering...

items.p: sa jayatyarthasannyasi purnasvarasavigrahah akritrimonavachchhinne samadhiryasya vartate
items.e: Victorious is the one who has left all aims, who is the form of complete joy, and whose natural samadhi goes on unbroken.

items.p: bahunatra kimuktena gyatatattvo mahashayah bhogamokshanirakankshi sada sarvatra nirasah
items.e: What more is there to say? The great soul who knows the truth wants neither enjoyment nor freedom, and has no taste for anything, always, everywhere.

items.p: mahadadi jagaddvaitam namamatravijrimbhitam vihaya shuddhabodhasya kim krityamavashishyate
items.e: The duality of the world, beginning with the great principle of nature, is only names spreading out. Having dropped it, what is left to do for one...

items.p: bhramabhutamidam sarvam kinchinnastiti nishchayi alakshyasphuranah shuddhah svabhavenaiva shamyati
items.e: Certain that all this is born of error and nothing is, the pure one, whose shining nobody can see, comes to rest by his own nature.

items.p: shuddhasphuranarupasya drishyabhavamapashyatah kva vidhih kva cha vairagyam kva tyagah kva shamopi va
items.e: For one whose form is pure shining, who does not see objects as real, where is rule, where is dispassion, where is giving up, where is calm?

items.p: sphuratonantarupena prakritim cha na pashyatah kva bandhah kva cha va mokshah kva harshah kva vishadita
items.e: For one who shines as the endless and does not see nature apart from himself, where is bondage, where is freedom, where is joy, where is grief?

items.p: buddhiparyantasansare mayamatram vivartate nirmamo nirahankaro nishkamah shobhate budhah
items.e: In this world, which lasts as long as the intellect does, only illusion turns. The wise one, without 'mine', without 'I', without desire, shines.

items.p: akshayam gatasantapamatmanam pashyato muneh kva vidya cha kva va vishvam kva dehoham mameti va
items.e: For the sage who sees the Self as imperishable and free of pain, where is knowledge, where is the world, where is 'I am the body' or 'this is mine'?

items.p: nirodhadini karmani jahati jadadhiryadi manorathan pralapanshcha kartumapnotyatatkshanat
items.e: If a dull-minded person drops practices like control of the mind, he at once starts on daydreams and chatter.

items.s: मन्दः श्रुत्वापि तद्वस्तु न जहाति विमूढताम्
items.p: mandah shrutvapi tadvastu na jahati vimudhatam nirvikalpo bahiryatnadantarvishayalalasah
items.e: Even after hearing the truth, the dull one does not give up his confusion. He looks free of thought through outward effort, but inside he still longs...

items.p: gyanad galitakarma yo lokadrishtyapi karmakrit napnotyavasaram kartrum vaktumeva na kinchana
items.e: One whose actions have fallen away through knowledge, though others see him act, finds no occasion to do or say anything.

items.s: क्व तमः क्व प्रकाशो वा हानं क्व च न किञ्चन
items.p: kva tamah kva prakasho va hanam kva cha na kinchana nirvikarasya dhirasya niratankasya sarvada
items.e: Where is darkness, where is light, where is loss, for the steady one who is always unchanging and fearless? There is nothing.

items.s: क्व धैर्यं क्व विवेकित्वं क्व निरातङ्कतापि वा
items.p: kva dhairyam kva vivekitvam kva niratankatapi va anirvachyasvabhavasya nihsvabhavasya yoginah
items.e: Where is patience, where is discernment, where is even fearlessness, for the yogi whose nature cannot be described and who has no separate nature?

items.s: न स्वर्गो नैव नरको जीवन्मुक्तिर्न चैव हि
items.p: na svargo naiva narako jivanmuktirna chaiva hi bahunatra kimuktena yogadrishtya na kinchana
items.e: There is no heaven, no hell, not even freedom while living. What more is there to say? In the yogi's sight, nothing at all is.

items.p: naiva prarthayate labham nalabhenanushochati dhirasya shitalam chittamamritenaiva puritam
items.e: He does not pray for gain or grieve over loss. The steady one's cool mind is filled with nectar.

items.s: न शान्तं स्तौति निष्कामो न दुष्टमपि निन्दति
items.p: na shantam stauti nishkamo na dushtamapi nindati samaduhkhasukhastriptah kinchit krityam na pashyati
items.e: The one without desire does not praise the calm or blame the wicked. The same in sorrow and joy, content, he sees nothing he must do.

items.s: धीरो न द्वेष्टि संसारमात्मानं न दिदृक्षति
items.p: dhiro na dveshti sansaramatmanam na didrikshati harshamarshavinirmukto na mrito na cha jivati
items.e: The steady one does not hate the world or long to see the Self. Free of joy and anger, he is not dead and he is not alive.

items.p: nihsnehah putradaradau nishkamo vishayeshu cha nishchintah svasharirepi nirashah shobhate budhah
items.e: Without clinging fondness for children, wife and the rest, without desire for objects, without worry even about his own body, without expectations...

items.p: tushtih sarvatra dhirasya yathapatitavartinah svachchhandam charato deshan yatrastamitashayinah
items.e: The steady one is content everywhere, living on whatever falls his way, wandering where he likes and sleeping wherever the sun sets.

items.s: पततूदेतु वा देहो नास्य चिन्ता महात्मनः
items.p: patatudetu va deho nasya chinta mahatmanah svabhavabhumivishrantivismritasheshasansriteh
items.e: Let the body fall or rise. The great soul does not think about it. Resting on the ground of his own nature, he has forgotten the whole round of birth.

items.p: akinchanah kamacharo nirdvandvashchhinnasanshayah asaktah sarvabhaveshu kevalo ramate budhah
items.e: Owning nothing, moving freely, free of opposites, his doubts cut, unattached to anything, the wise one delights alone.

items.p: nirmamah shobhate dhirah samaloshtashmakanchanah subhinnahridayagranthirvinirdhutarajastamah
items.e: Without 'mine', the steady one shines. To him a clod, a stone and gold are the same. The knots of his heart are cut, and restlessness and dullness...

items.p: sarvatranavadhanasya na kinchid vasana hridi muktatmano vitriptasya tulana kena jayate
items.e: He pays no special heed to anything and no tendency is left in his heart. Free and wholly content, with whom can he be compared?

items.s: जानन्नपि न जानाति पश्यन्नपि न पश्यति
items.p: janannapi na janati pashyannapi na pashyati bruvannapi na cha brute konyo nirvasanadrite
items.e: Knowing, he does not know. Seeing, he does not see. Speaking, he does not speak. Who can be like this except one without tendencies?

items.s: भिक्षुर्वा भूपतिर्वापि यो निष्कामः स शोभते
items.p: bhikshurva bhupatirvapi yo nishkamah sa shobhate bhaveshu galita yasya shobhanashobhana matih
items.e: Beggar or king, the one without desire shines, he whose ideas of good and bad in things have melted away.

items.s: क्व स्वाच्छन्द्यं क्व सङ्कोचः क्व वा तत्त्वविनिश्चयः
items.p: kva svachchhandyam kva sankochah kva va tattvavinishchayah nirvyajarjavabhutasya charitarthasya yoginah
items.e: Where is license, where is restraint, where is even settling the truth, for the yogi who is simplicity itself and has fulfilled his purpose?

items.p: atmavishrantitriptena nirashena gatartina antaryadanubhuyeta tat katham kasya kathyate
items.e: What is felt inside by one who is content resting in the Self, without hope, his sorrows gone: how can it be told, and to whom?

items.s: सुप्तोऽपि न सुषुप्तौ च स्वप्नेऽपि शयितो न च
items.p: suptopi na sushuptau cha svapnepi shayito na cha jagarepi na jagarti dhirastriptah pade pade
items.e: Asleep, he is not in deep sleep. Dreaming, he is not lying down. Awake, he is not awake. The steady one is content at every step.

items.p: gyah sachintopi nishchintah sendriyopi nirindriyah subuddhirapi nirbuddhih sahankaronahankritih
items.e: The knower has thoughts and is free of thought, has senses and is beyond them, has an intellect and is beyond it, has an 'I' and is free of it.

items.s: न सुखी न च वा दुःखी न विरक्तो न सङ्गवान्
items.p: na sukhi na cha va duhkhi na virakto na sangavan na mumukshurna va mukta na kinchinna cha kinchana
items.e: He is not happy and not unhappy, not detached and not attached, not one who wants freedom and not one who is free. He is not something and not...

items.s: विक्षेपेऽपि न विक्षिप्तः समाधौ न समाधिमान्
items.p: vikshepepi na vikshiptah samadhau na samadhiman jadyepi na jado dhanyah pandityepi na panditah
items.e: Distracted, he is not distracted. In samadhi, he is not in samadhi. In dullness, he is not dull. Learned, he is not learned. Blessed is he.

items.p: mukto yathasthitisvasthah kritakartavyanirvritah samah sarvatra vaitrishnyanna smaratyakritam kritam
items.e: The free one rests in himself in every state, at peace with what is done and what is to be done, the same everywhere. Free of thirst, he does not...

items.s: न प्रीयते वन्द्यमानो निन्द्यमानो न कुप्यति
items.p: na priyate vandyamano nindyamano na kupyati naivodvijati marane jivane nabhinandati
items.e: Praised, he is not pleased. Blamed, he is not angry. He does not shrink from death or cling to life.

items.p: na dhavati janakirnam naranyamupashantadhih yathatatha yatratatra sama evavatishthate
items.e: A mind at peace does not run to the crowd or to the forest. As it is, wherever it is, it stays the same.

items.p: tattvavigyanasandanshamadaya hridayodarat nanavidhaparamarshashalyoddharah krito maya
items.e: With the tongs of knowing the truth, I have pulled from deep inside my heart the thorn of many kinds of opinion.

items.s: क्व धर्मः क्व च वा कामः क्व चार्थः क्व विवेकिता
items.p: kva dharmah kva cha va kamah kva charthah kva vivekita kva dvaitam kva cha vadvaitam svamahimni sthitasya me
items.e: Where is dharma, where is pleasure, where is wealth, where is discernment, where is duality, where is even non-duality, for me who rest in my own...

items.s: क्व भूतं क्व भविष्यद् वा वर्तमानमपि क्व वा
items.p: kva bhutam kva bhavishyad va vartamanamapi kva va kva deshah kva cha va nityam svamahimni sthitasya me
items.e: Where is past, where is future, where is even the present, where is place, where is even the eternal, for me who rest in my own greatness?

items.s: क्व चात्मा क्व च वानात्मा क्व शुभं क्वाशुभं यथा
items.p: kva chatma kva cha vanatma kva shubham kvashubham yatha kva chinta kva cha vachinta svamahimni sthitasya me
items.e: Where is the Self, where the not-Self, where good and bad, where worry and freedom from worry, for me who rest in my own greatness?

items.s: क्व स्वप्नः क्व सुषुप्तिर्वा क्व च जागरणं तथा
items.p: kva svapnah kva sushuptirva kva cha jagaranam tatha kva turiyam bhayam vapi svamahimni sthitasya me
items.e: Where is dream, where is deep sleep, where is waking, where is the fourth state, where is even fear, for me who rest in my own greatness?

items.s: क्व दूरं क्व समीपं वा बाह्यं क्वाभ्यन्तरं क्व वा
items.p: kva duram kva samipam va bahyam kvabhyantaram kva va kva sthulam kva cha va sukshmam svamahimni sthitasya me
items.e: Where is far, where is near, where is outside, where is inside, where is gross, where is subtle, for me who rest in my own greatness?

items.s: क्व मृत्युर्जीवितं वा क्व लोकाः क्वास्य क्व लौकिकम्
items.p: kva mrityurjivitam va kva lokah kvasya kva laukikam kva layah kva samadhirva svamahimni sthitasya me
items.e: Where is death, where is life, where are the worlds and worldly ways, where is dissolution, where is samadhi, for me who rest in my own greatness?

items.p: alam trivargakathaya yogasya kathayapyalam alam vigyanakathaya vishrantasya mamatmani
items.e: Enough talk of the three aims of life. Enough talk of yoga. Enough talk of knowledge too. I rest in the Self.

items.s: क्व भूतानि क्व देहो वा क्वेन्द्रियाणि क्व वा मनः
items.p: kva bhutani kva deho va kvendriyani kva va manah kva shunyam kva cha nairashyam matsvarupe niranjane
items.e: Where are the elements, where is the body, where are the senses, where is the mind, where is emptiness, where is despair, in my own spotless nature?

items.s: क्व शास्त्रं क्वात्मविज्ञानं क्व वा निर्विषयं मनः
items.p: kva shastram kvatmavigyanam kva va nirvishayam manah kva triptih kva vitrishnatvam gatadvandvasya me sada
items.e: Where is scripture, where is knowledge of the Self, where is a mind without objects, where is contentment, where is freedom from thirst, for me who...

items.s: क्व विद्या क्व च वाविद्या क्वाहं क्वेदं मम क्व वा
items.p: kva vidya kva cha vavidya kvaham kvedam mama kva va kva bandha kva cha va mokshah svarupasya kva rupita
items.e: Where is knowledge, where is not knowing, where is 'I', where is 'this', where is 'mine', where is bondage, where is freedom? How could my own nature...

items.s: क्व प्रारब्धानि कर्माणि जीवन्मुक्तिरपि क्व वा
items.p: kva prarabdhani karmani jivanmuktirapi kva va kva tad videhakaivalyam nirvisheshasya sarvada
items.e: Where are the actions already bearing fruit, where is freedom while living, where even final freedom when the body falls, for me who am always...

items.s: क्व कर्ता क्व च वा भोक्ता निष्क्रियं स्फुरणं क्व वा
items.p: kva karta kva cha va bhokta nishkriyam sphuranam kva va kvaparoksham phalam va kva nihsvabhavasya me sada
items.e: Where is the doer, where the enjoyer, where is stillness, where is stirring, where is direct knowing, where is its fruit, for me who am always...

items.s: क्व लोकं क्व मुमुक्षुर्वा क्व योगी ज्ञानवान् क्व वा
items.p: kva lokam kva mumukshurva kva yogi gyanavan kva va kva baddhah kva cha va muktah svasvarupehamadvaye
items.e: Where is the world, where is the one who wants freedom, where is the yogi, where the knower, where the bound, where the free, in my own nature, which...

items.s: क्व सृष्टिः क्व च संहारः क्व साध्यं क्व च साधनम्
items.p: kva srishtih kva cha sanharah kva sadhyam kva cha sadhanam kva sadhakah kva siddhirva svasvarupehamadvaye
items.e: Where is creation, where is dissolution, where is the goal, where the means, where the one who strives, where success, in my own nature, which is one?

items.s: क्व प्रमाता प्रमाणं वा क्व प्रमेयं क्व च प्रमा
items.p: kva pramata pramanam va kva prameyam kva cha prama kva kinchit kva na kinchid va sarvada vimalasya me
items.e: Where is the knower, the means of knowing, the known, or knowing itself? Where is anything, or nothing, for me who am always spotless?

items.s: क्व विक्षेपः क्व चैकाग्र्यं क्व निर्बोधः क्व मूढता
items.p: kva vikshepah kva chaikagryam kva nirbodhah kva mudhata kva harshah kva vishado va sarvada nishkriyasya me
items.e: Where is distraction, where is focus, where is understanding, where is dullness, where is joy, where is sorrow, for me who am always without action?

items.s: क्व चैष व्यवहारो वा क्व च सा परमार्थता
items.p: kva chaisha vyavaharo va kva cha sa paramarthata kva sukham kva cha va dukham nirvimarshasya me sada
items.e: Where is this everyday world, where is the highest truth, where is happiness, where is sorrow, for me who am always beyond deliberation?

items.s: क्व माया क्व च संसारः क्व प्रीतिर्विरतिः क्व वा
items.p: kva maya kva cha sansarah kva pritirviratih kva va kva jivah kva cha tadbrahma sarvada vimalasya me
items.e: Where is maya, where is the world, where is liking or disliking, where is the separate self, where is that Brahman, for me who am always spotless?

items.s: क्व प्रवृत्तिर्निर्वृत्तिर्वा क्व मुक्तिः क्व च बन्धनम्
items.p: kva pravrittirnirvrittirva kva muktih kva cha bandhanam kutasthanirvibhagasya svasthasya mama sarvada
items.e: Where is activity or rest, where is freedom or bondage, for me who am always unchanging, undivided and at home in myself?

items.s: क्वोपदेशः क्व वा शास्त्रं क्व शिष्यः क्व च वा गुरुः
items.p: kvopadeshah kva va shastram kva shishyah kva cha va guruh kva chasti purushartho va nirupadheh shivasya me
items.e: Where is instruction, where is scripture, where is the disciple, where is the guru, where is the goal of life, for me, the auspicious one, free of...

items.s: क्व चास्ति क्व च वा नास्ति क्वास्ति चैकं क्व च द्वयम्
items.p: kva chasti kva cha va nasti kvasti chaikam kva cha dvayam bahunatra kimuktena kinchinnottishthate mama
items.e: Where is being, where is not-being, where is one, where is two? What more is there to say? Nothing at all rises in me.

items.s: श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज निज मनु मुकुरु सुधारि
items.p: shriguru charan saroj raj nij manu mukuru sudhari baranaun raghubar bimal jasu jo dayaku phal chari
items.e: With the dust of my guru's lotus feet I polish the mirror of my mind. Then I sing the spotless glory of Rama, best of the Raghus, which gives all...
items.h: गुरु के चरण-कमलों की धूल से अपने मन का दर्पण साफ़ करके मैं श्रीराम का निर्मल यश गाता हूँ...

items.p: buddhihin tanu janike sumiraun pavan kumar bal budhi bidya dehu mohin harahu kales bikar
items.e: Knowing myself to be short of understanding, I call to mind Hanuman, son of the Wind. Give me strength, understanding and knowledge, and take away my...
items.h: खुद को बुद्धिहीन जानकर मैं पवनपुत्र हनुमान जी को याद करता हूँ। मुझे बल, बुद्धि और विद्या...

items.p: jay hanuman gyan gun sagar jay kapis tihun lok ujagar
items.e: Victory to Hanuman, ocean of wisdom and virtue. Victory to the lord of the vanaras, whose glory lights up the three worlds.
items.h: ज्ञान और गुणों के सागर हनुमान जी की जय हो। तीनों लोकों में उजाला करने वाले वानरराज की जय...

items.p: ram dut atulit bal dhama anjani putra pavanasut nama
items.e: You are Rama's messenger, the home of strength beyond measure. You are known as Anjani's son and as the son of the Wind.
items.h: आप श्रीराम के दूत हैं और अपार बल के धाम हैं। आपको अंजनीपुत्र और पवनपुत्र के नाम से जाना...

items.p: mahabir bikram bajarangi kumati nivar sumati ke sangi
items.e: Great hero, valiant, with a body as strong as the thunderbolt, you clear away bad thinking and stay beside good sense.
items.h: आप महावीर हैं, पराक्रमी हैं, आपका शरीर वज्र जैसा है। आप बुरी सोच दूर करते हैं और अच्छी...

items.p: kanchan baran biraj subesa kanan kundal kunchit kesa
items.e: Your colour is gold and your dress is fine. Rings shine in your ears and your hair is curled.
items.h: आपका रंग सोने जैसा है और वेश सुंदर है। कानों में कुंडल हैं और बाल घुँघराले हैं।

items.p: hath bajra au dhvaja birajai kandhe munj janeu sajai
items.e: In your hands shine the thunderbolt and the flag. A sacred thread of munja grass sits on your shoulder.
items.h: आपके हाथों में वज्र और ध्वजा शोभा देते हैं, और कंधे पर मूँज का जनेऊ सजा है।

items.p: sankar suvan kesarinandan tej pratap maha jag bandan
items.e: You come from Shiva and are the son of Kesari. Your radiance and might are vast, and the whole world bows to you.
items.h: आप शंकर के अंश और केसरी के पुत्र हैं। आपका तेज और प्रताप महान है, सारा जगत आपको प्रणाम...

items.p: bidyavan guni ati chatur ram kaj karibe ko atur
items.e: Learned, full of virtue and very wise, you are always eager to do Rama's work.
items.h: आप विद्वान हैं, गुणी हैं, बहुत चतुर हैं, और श्रीराम का काम करने को हमेशा तत्पर रहते हैं।

items.p: prabhu charitra sunibe ko rasiya ram lakhan sita man basiya
items.e: You love to hear the Lord's story. Rama, Lakshmana and Sita live in your heart.
items.h: प्रभु की कथा सुनने में आपको आनंद आता है। श्रीराम, लक्ष्मण और सीता आपके मन में बसते हैं।

items.p: sukshma rup dhari siyahin dikhava bikat rup dhari lank jarava
items.e: Taking a tiny form, you showed yourself to Sita. Taking a fearsome form, you set Lanka on fire.
items.h: आपने छोटा रूप लेकर सीता जी को दर्शन दिए, और विकराल रूप लेकर लंका जला दी।

items.p: bhim rup dhari asur sanhare ramachandra ke kaj sanvare
items.e: Taking a terrible form, you destroyed the asuras and carried Rama's work through.
items.h: आपने भयंकर रूप लेकर राक्षसों का संहार किया और श्रीरामचंद्र के काम पूरे किए।

items.p: lay sajivan lakhan jiyaye shriraghubir harashi ur laye
items.e: You brought the sanjivani herb and revived Lakshmana. Rama, hero of the Raghus, held you to his heart with joy.
items.h: आपने संजीवनी लाकर लक्ष्मण जी के प्राण बचाए, और श्रीराम ने खुश होकर आपको गले लगा लिया।

items.p: raghupati kinhi bahut badai tum mam priy bharatahi sam bhai
items.e: Rama, lord of the Raghus, praised you greatly: "You are as dear to me as my brother Bharata."
items.h: श्रीराम ने आपकी बहुत प्रशंसा की और कहा, तुम मुझे भरत जैसे प्यारे भाई हो।

items.p: sahas badan tumharo jas gavain as kahi shripati kanth lagavain
items.e: "May the thousand-mouthed Shesha sing your glory," said Rama, lord of Shri, and he held you close.
items.h: हज़ार मुखों वाले शेषनाग तुम्हारा यश गाएँ, यह कहकर श्रीराम ने आपको गले लगा लिया।

items.p: sanakadik brahmadi munisa narad sarad sahit ahisa
items.e: Sanaka and his brothers, Brahma and the gods, the great sages, Narada and Saraswati, with Shesha, lord of serpents,
items.h: सनक आदि ऋषि, ब्रह्मा आदि देवता, बड़े-बड़े मुनि, नारद, सरस्वती और शेषनाग भी,

items.p: jam kuber digapal jahan te kabi kobid kahi sake kahan te
items.e: Yama, Kubera and the guardians of the directions cannot tell your glory in full. How could poets and scholars?
items.h: यम, कुबेर और दिशाओं के रक्षक भी आपका यश पूरा नहीं कह पाते, तो कवि और विद्वान कैसे कहें।

items.p: tum upakar sugrivahin kinha ram milay raj pad dinha
items.e: You did Sugriva a great kindness. You brought him to Rama and gave him back his kingdom.
items.h: आपने सुग्रीव पर उपकार किया। उन्हें श्रीराम से मिलाया और राजपद दिलाया।

items.p: tumharo mantra bibhishan mana lankesvar bhae sab jag jana
items.e: Vibhishana took your counsel and became king of Lanka, as the whole world knows.
items.h: विभीषण ने आपकी सलाह मानी और लंका के राजा बने, यह सारा संसार जानता है।

items.p: jug sahasra jojan par bhanu lilyo tahi madhur phal janu
items.e: The sun stood thousands upon thousands of yojanas away, and you swallowed it, taking it for a sweet fruit.
items.h: हज़ारों योजन दूर के सूरज को आपने मीठा फल समझकर निगल लिया।

items.p: prabhu mudrika meli mukh mahin jaladhi langhi gaye acharaj nahin
items.e: With the Lord's ring in your mouth you leapt over the ocean. That is no wonder.
items.h: प्रभु की अँगूठी मुँह में रखकर आपने समुद्र लाँघ लिया, इसमें कोई अचरज नहीं।

items.p: durgam kaj jagat ke jete sugam anugrah tumhare tete
items.e: However many hard tasks there are in the world, your grace makes every one of them easy.
items.h: संसार के जितने भी कठिन काम हैं, आपकी कृपा से सब आसान हो जाते हैं।

items.p: ram duare tum rakhavare hot na agya binu paisare
items.e: You guard Rama's door. No one enters without your leave.
items.h: आप श्रीराम के द्वार के रखवाले हैं। आपकी आज्ञा के बिना कोई भीतर नहीं जा सकता।

items.p: sab sukh lahai tumhari sarana tum rachchhak kahu ko dar na
items.e: Whoever takes refuge in you finds every happiness. With you as protector, there is nothing to fear.
items.h: जो आपकी शरण में आता है, उसे सब सुख मिलते हैं। आप रक्षक हों तो किसी का डर नहीं।

items.p: apan tej samharo apai tinon lok hank ten kampai
items.e: Only you can hold your own power. At your roar the three worlds tremble.
items.h: अपने तेज को आप ही सँभाल सकते हैं। आपकी एक हुंकार से तीनों लोक काँप उठते हैं।

items.p: bhut pisach nikat nahin avai mahabir jab nam sunavai
items.e: Ghosts and evil spirits do not come near when someone speaks the name of the great hero.
items.h: जब कोई महावीर का नाम लेता है, तो भूत-पिशाच पास नहीं आते।

items.p: nasai rog harai sab pira japat nirantar hanumat bira
items.e: Illness is destroyed and every pain taken away for one who repeats the name of brave Hanuman without a break.
items.h: वीर हनुमान का नाम लगातार जपने से रोग मिटते हैं और सारी पीड़ा दूर होती है।

items.p: sankat ten hanuman chhudavai man kram bachan dhyan jo lavai
items.e: Hanuman frees from trouble whoever keeps him in mind, in thought, in deed and in word.
items.h: जो मन, कर्म और वचन से हनुमान जी का ध्यान करता है, हनुमान जी उसे संकट से छुड़ाते हैं।

items.p: sab par ram tapasvi raja tin ke kaj sakal tum saja
items.e: Rama, the ascetic king, is above all, and you carried out every one of his tasks.
items.h: तपस्वी राजा श्रीराम सबसे ऊपर हैं, और उनके सारे काम आपने ही पूरे किए।

items.p: aur manorath jo koi lavai soi amit jivan phal pavai
items.e: Whoever brings you any other wish receives it, and with it the boundless fruit of life.
items.h: जो कोई भी आपके पास कोई और इच्छा लेकर आता है, वह उसे पाता है, और साथ में जीवन का असीम फल...

items.p: charon jug paratap tumhara hai parasiddha jagat ujiyara
items.e: Your glory runs through all four ages, and its fame lights up the world.
items.h: चारों युगों में आपका प्रताप है। आपकी कीर्ति से सारा जगत उजला है।

items.p: sadhu sant ke tum rakhavare asur nikandan ram dulare
items.e: You protect the good and the saints. You destroy the asuras, and Rama holds you dear.
items.h: आप साधु-संतों के रखवाले हैं, राक्षसों का नाश करने वाले हैं, और श्रीराम के दुलारे हैं।

items.s: अष्ट सिद्धि नौ निधि के दाता
items.p: ashta siddhi nau nidhi ke data as bar din janaki mata
items.e: You can give the eight siddhis and the nine treasures. Mother Janaki gave you this boon.
items.h: आप आठ सिद्धियाँ और नौ निधियाँ देने वाले हैं। माता जानकी ने आपको यह वरदान दिया है।

items.p: ram rasayan tumhare pasa sada raho raghupati ke dasa
items.e: You hold the elixir of devotion to Rama, and you remain forever the servant of the lord of the Raghus.
items.h: राम-भक्ति का रसायन आपके पास है, और आप सदा श्रीराम के सेवक बने रहते हैं।

items.p: tumhare bhajan ram ko pavai janam janam ke dukh bisaravai
items.e: By singing of you a person reaches Rama and leaves behind the sorrows of birth after birth.
items.h: आपका भजन करके मनुष्य श्रीराम को पाता है और जन्म-जन्म के दुख भूल जाता है।

items.p: ant kal raghubar pur jai jahan janma hari bhakta kahai
items.e: At the end that person goes to Rama's abode, and wherever they are born again they are known as a devotee of Hari.
items.h: अंत समय में वह श्रीराम के धाम जाता है, और जहाँ भी जन्म ले, हरिभक्त कहलाता है।

items.p: aur devata chitta na dharai hanumat sei sarba sukh karai
items.e: Even one who keeps no other deity in mind finds every happiness by serving Hanuman.
items.h: किसी और देवता को मन में न भी रखे, तो भी हनुमान जी की सेवा से सब सुख मिलते हैं।

items.p: sankat katai mitai sab pira jo sumirai hanumat balabira
items.e: Troubles are cut away and all pain ends for whoever remembers Hanuman, the strong hero.
items.h: जो बलवीर हनुमान जी को याद करता है, उसके संकट कट जाते हैं और सारी पीड़ा मिट जाती है।

items.p: jai jai jai hanuman gosain kripa karahu guru dev ki nain
items.e: Victory, victory, victory to you, Hanuman, my master. Be kind to me as a guru is kind.
items.h: हे स्वामी हनुमान जी, आपकी जय हो, जय हो, जय हो। गुरु की तरह मुझ पर कृपा कीजिए।

items.s: जो सत बार पाठ कर कोई
items.p: jo sat bar path kar koi chhutahi bandi maha sukh hoi
items.e: Whoever recites this a hundred times is freed from bondage and finds great joy.
items.h: जो कोई इसका सौ बार पाठ करे, वह बंधनों से छूट जाता है और उसे बड़ा सुख मिलता है।

items.p: jo yah padhai hanuman chalisa hoy siddhi sakhi gaurisa
items.e: Whoever reads this Hanuman Chalisa gains fulfilment. Shiva, lord of Gauri, is witness.
items.h: जो यह हनुमान चालीसा पढ़ता है, उसे सिद्धि मिलती है। इसके साक्षी स्वयं गौरीपति शिव हैं।

items.p: tulasidas sada hari chera kijai nath hriday mahan dera
